-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE

-- Child process for the lua-rate-limit golden check. check.sh starts this WITHOUT AETERNA_GOLDEN_NONCE.
-- Parent/child design: check.sh holds the nonce and never loads fixture/. This child loads fixture/ratelimit.lua
-- and runs the expectations. The success line goes to stdout only when every expectation held and the count is
-- exactly EXPECTED; every other outcome exits 1. The fixture runs in this process without the nonce in its
-- environment, so it never sees the nonce.
-- Builtins are captured as locals BEFORE the fixture is loaded, so a fixture that replaces globals (os.exit,
-- pcall, io.write, _G, ...) cannot change how failures are reported or counted.
local EXPECTED = 39

local pcall, next, tostring, type, require = pcall, next, tostring, type, require
local sformat, tconcat = string.format, table.concat
local exit = os.exit
local G, argv, pkg = _G, arg, package
local stdout, stderr = io.stdout, io.stderr
local writeOut, writeErr = stdout.write, stderr.write

local fixtureDir = argv and argv[1]
if not fixtureDir then
    writeErr(stderr, 'child: missing fixture directory argument\n')
    exit(1)
    return
end

-- Snapshot the globals before the fixture is loaded, to detect state kept in globals.
-- `next` is used directly so a metatable __pairs on _G cannot hide a leak.
local globalsBefore = {}
for k in next, G do globalsBefore[k] = true end

pkg.path = fixtureDir .. '/?.lua;' .. pkg.path
local okLoad, M = pcall(require, 'ratelimit')
if not okLoad or type(M) ~= 'table' or type(M.allow) ~= 'function' then
    writeErr(stderr, 'FAIL: fixture/ratelimit.lua must return a table with an allow() function\n')
    exit(1)
    return
end
local allow = M.allow

local passed, failed = 0, 0

local function expect(label, cond)
    if cond then
        passed = passed + 1
    else
        failed = failed + 1
        writeErr(stderr, 'FAIL: ' .. label .. '\n')
    end
end

local function expectResult(label, got, want)
    expect(label .. ' (want ' .. tostring(want) .. ', got ' .. tostring(got) .. ')', got == want)
end

-- Returns allow()'s result, or nil when it raises.
local function call(...)
    local ok, res = pcall(allow, ...)
    if ok then return res end
    return nil
end

-- True when allow() raises for these arguments.
local function raises(...)
    local ok = pcall(allow, ...)
    return not ok
end

-- A: max=2, windowMs=1000, one source (matches the example in task.md).
local s = {}
expectResult('A1 first call under max is allowed', call(s, 'a', 0, 2, 1000), true)
expectResult('A2 second call under max is allowed', call(s, 'a', 10, 2, 1000), true)
expectResult('A3 third call inside the window is rejected', call(s, 'a', 20, 2, 1000), false)
expectResult('A4 rejection at 999 (both allowed calls still count)', call(s, 'a', 999, 2, 1000), false)
expectResult('A5 at 1000 the call at 0 has expired', call(s, 'a', 1000, 2, 1000), true)
expectResult('A6 at 1009 the calls at 10 and 1000 both count', call(s, 'a', 1009, 2, 1000), false)
expectResult('A7 at 1010 the call at 10 has expired', call(s, 'a', 1010, 2, 1000), true)

-- B: sources are independent.
s = {}
expectResult('B1 source x first call allowed (max=1)', call(s, 'x', 0, 1, 500), true)
expectResult('B2 source y first call allowed (max=1)', call(s, 'y', 0, 1, 500), true)
expectResult('B3 source x second call rejected', call(s, 'x', 1, 1, 500), false)
expectResult('B4 source y second call rejected', call(s, 'y', 1, 1, 500), false)

-- C: separate state tables are independent.
local s1, s2 = {}, {}
expectResult('C1 state 1 allows the first call', call(s1, 'a', 0, 1, 500), true)
expectResult('C2 state 2 has its own history for the same source', call(s2, 'a', 0, 1, 500), true)

-- D: exact window boundary with max=1, windowMs=100.
s = {}
expectResult('D1 first call allowed', call(s, 'a', 0, 1, 100), true)
expectResult('D2 at 99 the call at 0 still counts', call(s, 'a', 99, 1, 100), false)
expectResult('D3 at 100 the call at 0 has expired', call(s, 'a', 100, 1, 100), true)

-- E: invalid arguments raise an error.
expect('E1 max=0 raises', raises({}, 'a', 0, 0, 1000))
expect('E2 max=1.5 raises', raises({}, 'a', 0, 1.5, 1000))
expect("E3 max='2' raises", raises({}, 'a', 0, '2', 1000))
expect('E4 max=-1 raises', raises({}, 'a', 0, -1, 1000))
expect('E5 windowMs=0 raises', raises({}, 'a', 0, 1, 0))
expect('E6 windowMs=-1 raises', raises({}, 'a', 0, 1, -1))
expect("E7 windowMs='1000' raises", raises({}, 'a', 0, 1, '1000'))

-- I: two sources interleaved in one state table (max=3, windowMs=500). Clock never goes backwards.
s = {}
expectResult('I1 g at 0 allowed', call(s, 'g', 0, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I2 h at 100 allowed (own history)', call(s, 'h', 100, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I3 g at 300 allowed', call(s, 'g', 300, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I4 g at 350 allowed (0 and 300 count)', call(s, 'g', 350, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I5 h at 350 allowed (only the call at 100 counts)', call(s, 'h', 350, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I6 g at 360 rejected (0, 300, 350 all count)', call(s, 'g', 360, 3, 500), false)
expectResult('I7 h at 400 allowed (100 and 350 count)', call(s, 'h', 400, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I8 g at 500 allowed (the call at 0 has expired)', call(s, 'g', 500, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I9 h at 520 rejected (100, 350, 400 count)', call(s, 'h', 520, 3, 500), false)
expectResult('I10 g at 800 allowed (300 expired; rejected 360 never counted)', call(s, 'g', 800, 3, 500), true)
expectResult('I11 g at 801 rejected (350, 500, 800 count)', call(s, 'g', 801, 3, 500), false)

-- N: an invalid call changes no state.
s = {}
expectResult('N1 first valid call allowed', call(s, 'a', 0, 2, 100), true)
expect('N2 invalid max=0 call raises', raises(s, 'a', 10, 0, 100))
expectResult('N3 next valid call sees only the call at 0', call(s, 'a', 20, 2, 100), true)
expectResult('N4 third call sees the calls at 0 and 20', call(s, 'a', 30, 2, 100), false)

-- F: no state leaked into globals.
local leaked = {}
for k in next, G do
    if not globalsBefore[k] then leaked[#leaked + 1] = tostring(k) end
end
expect('F1 no new globals (leaked: ' .. tconcat(leaked, ',') .. ')', #leaked == 0)

-- Success line only when every expectation held and the count is the one this child defines.
if failed == 0 and passed == EXPECTED then
    writeOut(stdout, sformat('GOLDEN_OK lua-rate-limit expectations=%d\n', passed))
else
    writeErr(stderr, sformat('lua-rate-limit: %d failed, ran %d expectations, want %d\n',
        failed, passed + failed, EXPECTED))
    exit(1)
end

-- aeterna_camera client: viewfinder (focus, base-game phone camera, overlay, capture and latent upload),
-- gallery panel, NUI bridge and the client side of the viewfinder self-test.

local Ids, ST, V = CameraLogic.ids, CameraLogic.selftests, CameraViewfinder
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local cfg = CameraLogic.settings.check(Config, AeternaCore.log.warn)

local LOCALE_KEYS = {
    'camera.app.gallery', 'camera.hint.shutter', 'camera.hint.switch', 'camera.hint.close',
    'camera.gallery.empty', 'camera.gallery.delete', 'camera.gallery.delete_confirm', 'camera.gallery.cancel',
}
local RESTORE_MS = 10000
local UPLOAD_BPS = 200000
local VIEWFINDER_TEST = 'aeterna_camera.viewfinder'
local SHOOT_TEST = 'aeterna_camera.shoot_and_view'

local vf = nil       -- { token, mode, count, cap, paused, capture = { ticket, hud, radar }?, session, test? }
local gallery = nil  -- { token, ids = { [id] = true }, paused }
local session = 0
local lastShot = nil
local pendingDelete = nil
local shootTest = nil -- { runId, refused = reason? } while shoot_and_view runs here

-- Focus and self-test events are trusted only from aeterna_core; any resource can fire a local event.
local function fromCore()
    return GetInvokingResource() == 'aeterna_core'
end

local function send(msg)
    SendNUIMessage(msg)
end

local function sendSetup()
    local strings = {}
    for i = 1, #LOCALE_KEYS do strings[LOCALE_KEYS[i]] = AeternaCore.t(LOCALE_KEYS[i]) end
    send(AeternaCore.themeMessage())
    send({ type = 'locale', strings = strings })
end

local function media(on)
    pcall(function() exports.aeterna_phonekit:activity('media', on) end)
end

local function hints()
    return {
        { bind = V.keyText('+aeterna_camera_shutter', V.CONTROL_SELECT), label = AeternaCore.t('camera.hint.shutter') },
        { bind = V.keyText('+aeterna_camera_switch', V.CONTROL_SELFIE), label = AeternaCore.t('camera.hint.switch') },
        { bind = V.keyText(nil, V.CONTROL_CANCEL), label = AeternaCore.t('camera.hint.close') },
    }
end

local function showOverlay()
    send({ type = 'vf:show', count = vf.count, cap = vf.cap, mode = vf.mode, hints = hints() })
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Viewfinder
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function restoreAfterCapture()
    if not vf or not vf.capture then return end
    local c = vf.capture
    vf.capture = nil
    if not c.hudHidden then DisplayHud(true) end
    if not c.radarHidden then DisplayRadar(true) end
    showOverlay()
end

local function closeViewfinder()
    if not vf then return end
    local v = vf
    restoreAfterCapture()
    vf = nil
    V.stop()
    media(false)
    send({ type = 'vf:hide' })
    if v.token then AeternaCore.releaseFocus(v.token) end
    if not v.test then TriggerServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:close') end
end

local function shutter()
    if not vf or vf.paused or vf.capture or vf.test then return end
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastShot and now - lastShot < cfg.cooldownMs then return end
    lastShot = now
    TriggerServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:shoot', { mode = vf.mode })
end

local function switchCamera()
    if not vf or vf.paused or vf.capture then return end
    vf.mode = vf.mode == 'back' and 'selfie' or 'back'
    V.setSelfie(vf.mode == 'selfie')
    send({ type = 'vf:mode', mode = vf.mode })
end

local function frameLoop(s)
    while vf and vf.session == s do
        V.frame()
        if not vf.paused and not vf.capture and not vf.test then
            local input = V.read()
            if input.close then
                closeViewfinder()
            elseif input.shutter then
                shutter()
            elseif input.switch then
                switchCamera()
            end
        end
        Wait(0)
    end
end

local function closeGallery()
    if not gallery then return end
    local g = gallery
    gallery = nil
    pendingDelete = nil
    send({ type = 'gallery:hide' })
    if g.token then AeternaCore.releaseFocus(g.token) end
end

-- opts = { count, cap, test }
local function openViewfinder(opts)
    if vf then
        vf.count, vf.cap = opts.count, opts.cap
        showOverlay()
        return true
    end
    closeGallery()
    local token = AeternaCore.requestFocus({ cursor = false, keyboard = true, keepGameInput = true })
    if not token then
        if not opts.test then TriggerServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:close') end
        return false
    end
    session = session + 1
    vf = { token = token, mode = 'back', count = opts.count, cap = opts.cap, session = session, test = opts.test }
    V.start()
    media(true)
    sendSetup()
    showOverlay()
    local s = session
    CreateThread(function() frameLoop(s) end)
    return true
end

local VF_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    count = { type = 'number', integer = true, min = 0, max = 100000 },
    cap = { type = 'number', integer = true, min = 1, max = 500 },
} }

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:viewfinder', function(payload)
    local ok, err, data = AeternaCore.validate(payload, VF_SCHEMA)
    if not ok then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('dropped aeterna_camera:cl:viewfinder', { err = err })
        return
    end
    openViewfinder({ count = data.count, cap = data.cap })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:capture', function(payload)
    if type(payload) ~= 'table' or not Ids.isId(payload.ticket) then return end
    if not vf or vf.capture or vf.test then return end
    local ticket = payload.ticket
    local s = vf.session
    vf.capture = { ticket = ticket, hudHidden = IsHudHidden(), radarHidden = IsRadarHidden() }
    send({ type = 'vf:hide' })
    DisplayHud(false)
    DisplayRadar(false)
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(0)
        Wait(0)
        if not vf or vf.session ~= s or not vf.capture or vf.capture.ticket ~= ticket then return end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            exports['screenshot-basic']:requestScreenshot({ encoding = 'jpg', quality = cfg.quality }, function(data)
                if type(data) ~= 'string' then return end
                TriggerLatentServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:upload', UPLOAD_BPS, { ticket = ticket, data = data })
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then restoreAfterCapture() end
    end)
    SetTimeout(RESTORE_MS, function()
        if vf and vf.session == s and vf.capture and vf.capture.ticket == ticket then restoreAfterCapture() end
    end)
end)

local SHOT_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    ok = { type = 'boolean' },
    id = { type = 'string', maxLen = 32, optional = true },
    reason = { type = 'string', maxLen = 32, optional = true },
} }

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:shot', function(payload)
    local ok, _, data = AeternaCore.validate(payload, SHOT_SCHEMA)
    if not ok then return end
    if data.reason == 'power_off' then
        closeViewfinder()
        closeGallery()
        return
    end
    if shootTest and not data.ok then shootTest.refused = data.reason or 'refused' end
    if not vf then return end
    restoreAfterCapture()
    if data.ok then
        vf.count = vf.count + 1
        showOverlay()
    end
end)

RegisterCommand('+aeterna_camera_shutter', function() shutter() end, false)
RegisterCommand('-aeterna_camera_shutter', function() end, false)
RegisterCommand('+aeterna_camera_switch', function() switchCamera() end, false)
RegisterCommand('-aeterna_camera_switch', function() end, false)
AeternaCore.key('+aeterna_camera_shutter', 'camera.key.shutter')
AeternaCore.key('+aeterna_camera_switch', 'camera.key.switch')

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Gallery
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- '<host>' from GetCurrentServerEndpoint() with any scheme:// and trailing / removed.
local function photoBase()
    local ok, endpoint = pcall(GetCurrentServerEndpoint)
    if not ok or type(endpoint) ~= 'string' or endpoint == '' then return nil end
    local host = endpoint:gsub('^%a[%w+.-]*://', ''):gsub('/+$', '')
    if host == '' or host:find('[%s/]') then return nil end
    return 'http://' .. host .. '/aeterna_camera/p/'
end

local ITEM_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    id = { type = 'string', minLen = 32, maxLen = 32, pattern = '^[0-9a-f]+$' },
    ts = { type = 'number', min = 0 },
    mode = { type = 'string', enum = { 'back', 'selfie' } },
    bytes = { type = 'number', integer = true, min = 0 },
} }
local GALLERY_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    items = { type = 'array', maxItems = 500, items = ITEM_SCHEMA },
} }

local function idSet(items)
    local set = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(items) do set[it.id] = true end
    return set
end

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:gallery', function(payload)
    local ok, err, data = AeternaCore.validate(payload, GALLERY_SCHEMA)
    if not ok then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('dropped aeterna_camera:cl:gallery', { err = err })
        return
    end
    local items = data.items
    if gallery then
        -- A refresh after a delete: tell the page which ids left.
        local now = idSet(items)
        for id in pairs(gallery.ids) do
            if not now[id] then send({ type = 'gallery:removed', id = id }) end
        end
        gallery.ids = now
        pendingDelete = nil
        return
    end
    if pendingDelete then
        pendingDelete = nil
        return
    end
    closeViewfinder()
    local token = AeternaCore.requestFocus({ cursor = true, keyboard = true })
    if not token then return end
    gallery = { token = token, ids = idSet(items) }
    sendSetup()
    send({ type = 'gallery:show', items = items, base = photoBase() })
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NUI callbacks: close {}, open {id}, delete {id}, escape {}. Ids must be in the list last sent.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local EMPTY_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {} }
local ID_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    id = { type = 'string', minLen = 32, maxLen = 32, pattern = '^[0-9a-f]+$' },
} }

local function knownId(data)
    local ok = AeternaCore.validate(data, ID_SCHEMA)
    return ok and gallery and not gallery.paused and Ids.isId(data.id) and gallery.ids[data.id] == true
end

local function closeAny()
    if gallery and not gallery.paused then closeGallery() end
    if vf and not vf.paused and not vf.capture and not vf.test then closeViewfinder() end
end

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(data, cb)
    cb({})
    if AeternaCore.validate(data, EMPTY_SCHEMA) then closeAny() end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('escape', function(data, cb)
    cb({})
    if AeternaCore.validate(data, EMPTY_SCHEMA) then closeAny() end
end)

RegisterNUICallback('open', function(data, cb)
    cb({ ok = knownId(data) and true or false })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('delete', function(data, cb)
    local ok = knownId(data)
    cb({ ok = ok and true or false })
    if not ok then return end
    pendingDelete = data.id
    TriggerServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:delete', { id = data.id })
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Focus: lost closes; an overlay pauses (input ignored, screen kept) until it resumes.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:focusLost', function(owner, token)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if owner ~= RES then return end
    if vf and vf.token == token then
        vf.token = nil
        closeViewfinder()
    end
    if gallery and gallery.token == token then
        gallery.token = nil
        closeGallery()
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:focusPaused', function(owner)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if owner ~= RES then return end
    if vf then vf.paused = true end
    if gallery then gallery.paused = true end
end)

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:focusResumed', function(owner, token)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if owner ~= RES then return end
    if vf and vf.token == token then vf.paused = false end
    if gallery and gallery.token == token then gallery.paused = false end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= RES then return end
    if vf then
        restoreAfterCapture()
        V.stop()
        media(false)
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Self-test (client): the viewfinder eye test opens, switches and closes the viewfinder, then asks the person.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local testRun = nil

local function report(runId, name, ok, detail)
    local sent, err = pcall(function() return exports.aeterna_core:reportSelftest(runId, name, ok, detail) end)
    if not sent then AeternaCore.log.warn('selftest report failed', { name = name, err = tostring(err) }) end
end

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftest', function(runId, name)
    if not fromCore() or name ~= VIEWFINDER_TEST then return end
    if vf or gallery then
        report(runId, name, false, 'viewfinder or gallery already open')
        return
    end
    testRun = runId
    CreateThread(function()
        local started = GetGameTimer()
        for _, step in ipairs(ST.VIEWFINDER_STEPS) do
            local waitMs = step.at - (GetGameTimer() - started)
            if waitMs > 0 then Wait(waitMs) end
            if testRun ~= runId then return end
            if step.action == 'open' then
                if not openViewfinder({ count = 0, cap = cfg.perCharacter, test = true }) then
                    report(runId, name, false, 'focus refused')
                    testRun = nil
                    return
                end
            elseif step.action == 'selfie' then
                if vf then
                    vf.mode = 'selfie'
                    V.setSelfie(true)
                    send({ type = 'vf:mode', mode = 'selfie' })
                end
            elseif step.action == 'close' then
                closeViewfinder()
            end
        end
        if testRun == runId then
            report(runId, name, 'ready', 'viewfinder opened, switched and closed')
        end
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftestEnd', function(runId, name)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if name == SHOOT_TEST and shootTest and shootTest.runId == runId then
        shootTest = nil
        closeViewfinder()
        closeGallery()
        return
    end
    if name ~= VIEWFINDER_TEST or testRun ~= runId then return end
    testRun = nil
    if vf and vf.test then closeViewfinder() end
end)

-- shoot_and_view: the server opened the viewfinder on selftestStarted. Shoot once, wait for the gallery the server
-- opens after the save, then hand over to the person. The server's write guard decides whether the photo is kept.
local function waitFor(check, ms)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + ms
    while not check() and GetGameTimer() < deadline do Wait(50) end
    return check()
end

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftest', function(runId, name)
    if not fromCore() or name ~= SHOOT_TEST then return end
    if GetResourceState('screenshot-basic') ~= 'started' then
        report(runId, name, 'skip', 'needs screenshot-basic')
        return
    end
    local mine = { runId = runId }
    shootTest = mine
    CreateThread(function()
        if not waitFor(function() return shootTest ~= mine or (vf ~= nil and not vf.paused) end,
            ST.SHOOT_WAIT_VIEWFINDER_MS) or shootTest ~= mine then
            if shootTest == mine then report(runId, name, false, 'viewfinder did not open') end
            return
        end
        lastShot = GetGameTimer()
        TriggerServerEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:shoot', { mode = vf.mode })
        waitFor(function() return gallery ~= nil or mine.refused ~= nil or shootTest ~= mine end, ST.SHOOT_WAIT_GALLERY_MS)
        if shootTest ~= mine then return end
        if gallery then
            report(runId, name, 'ready', 'photo taken, gallery open')
        else
            report(runId, name, false, 'no photo: ' .. tostring(mine.refused or 'timeout'))
        end
    end)
end)

-- A stopped core ends every run without a selftestEnd: drop both test halves and close what they opened.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= 'aeterna_core' then return end
    local hadShoot = shootTest ~= nil
    testRun = nil
    shootTest = nil
    if vf and (vf.test or hadShoot) then closeViewfinder() end
    if gallery and hadShoot then closeGallery() end
end)

-- aeterna_camera client: the base-game phone camera. Native names and control ids are constants here.
-- Which of them work on FXServer Enhanced is not verified yet (spec smoke step 1).

CameraViewfinder = {}
local V = CameraViewfinder

V.PHONE_TYPE = 0           -- CreateMobilePhone model
V.CONTROL_SELECT = 176     -- INPUT_CELLPHONE_SELECT: shutter
V.CONTROL_SELFIE = 184     -- INPUT_CELLPHONE_CAMERA_SELFIE: switch camera
V.CONTROL_CANCEL = 177     -- INPUT_CELLPHONE_CANCEL: close
V.CONTROL_PAUSE = 200      -- INPUT_FRONTEND_PAUSE_ALTERNATE (ESC): close instead of the pause menu

-- CELL_CAM_ACTIVATE_SELFIE_MODE (0x2491A93618B7D838); older runtimes name it CellFrontCamActivate.
function V.setSelfie(on)
    if type(CellCamActivateSelfieMode) == 'function' then
        CellCamActivateSelfieMode(on == true)
    elseif type(CellFrontCamActivate) == 'function' then
        CellFrontCamActivate(on == true)
    end
end

function V.start()
    CreateMobilePhone(V.PHONE_TYPE)
    CellCamActivate(true, true)
    V.setSelfie(false)
end

function V.stop()
    V.setSelfie(false)
    CellCamActivate(false, false)
    DestroyMobilePhone()
end

-- Called every frame while the viewfinder is up.
function V.frame()
    DisableControlAction(0, V.CONTROL_PAUSE, true)
end

function V.read()
    return {
        shutter = IsControlJustPressed(0, V.CONTROL_SELECT),
        switch = IsControlJustPressed(0, V.CONTROL_SELFIE),
        close = IsControlJustPressed(0, V.CONTROL_CANCEL) or IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, V.CONTROL_PAUSE),
    }
end

-- Key text for a hint: the player's binding of `command` (optional) when set, else the base-game control's button.
function V.keyText(command, control)
    local function text(hash)
        local ok, raw = pcall(GetControlInstructionalButton, 0, hash, true)
        if not ok or type(raw) ~= 'string' then return nil end
        local key = raw:gsub('^[tb]_', '')
        if key == '' or key == '-1' or key == 'NULL' then return nil end
        return key
    end
    return (command and text(GetHashKey(command) | 0x80000000)) or text(control) or ''
end

-- LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,

-- SOFTWARE.

-- aeterna_camera server: phone tiles, the shoot gate and upload tickets, photo files and index, the HTTP handler,
-- exports, the admin command and the server-side self-tests. Rules live in shared/logic/*.lua.

local Codec, Ids, Tickets, Store = CameraLogic.codec, CameraLogic.ids, CameraLogic.tickets, CameraLogic.store
local Service, Router, ST = CameraLogic.service, CameraLogic.router, CameraLogic.selftests

local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local PREFIX = RES .. '.'
local cfg = CameraLogic.settings.check(Config, AeternaCore.log.warn)

-- Lua 5.4 seeds math.random itself; mix the clock in without throwing that seed away.
math.randomseed(math.random(0, 0x7FFFFFFF) ~ os.time(), math.random(0, 0x7FFFFFFF) ~ GetGameTimer())

-- Tickets and photo ids come from two streams with their own seeds (ids.lua); every draw also mixes in
-- math.random, a counter, the game timer and os.clock. Hard to guess, not a secret.
local function rand(lo, hi) return math.random(lo, hi) end
local function newStream()
    return Ids.stream({ seed = math.random(0), rand = rand, now = GetGameTimer, clock = os.clock })
end
local ticketId = newStream()
local photoId = newStream()
local shootTests = {} -- src -> { runId, name } while shoot_and_view runs for that player

local function screenshotStarted()
    return GetResourceState('screenshot-basic') == 'started'
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Natives behind the pure logic
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local kv = {
    get = function(k) return GetResourceKvpString(k) end,
    set = function(k, v) SetResourceKvp(k, v) end,
    del = function(k) DeleteResourceKvp(k) end,
    keys = function(prefix)
        local out = {}
        local handle = StartFindKvp(prefix)
        if handle == nil or handle == -1 then return out end
        while true do
            local key = FindKvp(handle)
            if not key then break end
            out[#out + 1] = key
        end
        EndFindKvp(handle)
        return out
    end,
}

-- The only file writer. The path comes from an id that passed Ids.isId, inside photos/, which the package ships.
local function writePhoto(id, bytes)
    if not Ids.isId(id) or type(bytes) ~= 'string' then return false end
    -- FXServer Enhanced b177 returns the number 1 on success and false on failure (measured W3 2026-11-22).
    local wrote = SaveResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'photos/' .. id .. '.jpg', bytes, #bytes)
    return wrote == true or wrote == 1
end

local function loadPhoto(id)
    if not Ids.isId(id) then return nil end
    return LoadResourceFile(RES, 'photos/' .. id .. '.jpg')
end

-- The account behind a player: the license, shared by all characters of that player. Nil for source 0.
local function acctOf(src)
    if type(src) ~= 'number' or src <= 0 then return nil end
    local ok, license = pcall(GetPlayerIdentifierByType, src, 'license')
    if ok and type(license) == 'string' and license ~= '' then return license end
    return nil
end

local function newService(perCharacter, maxTotalBytes)
    local store = Store.new({ kv = kv, json = json, perCharacter = perCharacter, maxTotalBytes = maxTotalBytes,
        perAccountBytes = cfg.perAccountMB * 1024 * 1024 })
    local tickets = Tickets.new({ now = GetGameTimer, newId = ticketId })
    return Service.new({
        store = store,
        tickets = tickets,
        newId = photoId,
        now = GetGameTimer,
        clock = os.time,
        available = screenshotStarted,
        writePhoto = writePhoto,
        acctOf = acctOf,
        emit = function(name, ...) TriggerEvent(name, ...) end,
        warn = AeternaCore.log.warn,
        -- Only a photo taken inside shoot_and_view asks the self-test write guard.
        mayWrite = function(src)
            local t = shootTests[src]
            return t == nil or AeternaCore.selftest.mayWrite(t.runId, t.name)
        end,
    }, { cooldownMs = cfg.cooldownMs, maxBytes = cfg.maxBytes, perCharacter = perCharacter })
end

local svc = newService(cfg.perCharacter, cfg.maxTotalMB * 1024 * 1024)
local router = Router.new({
    now = GetGameTimer,
    has = function(id) return svc.deps.store:has(id) end,
    load = loadPhoto,
})

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity: cid:<citizenid> with qbx_core started, else lic:<license>. Server only.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function whoOf(src)
    if GetResourceState('qbx_core') == 'started' then
        local ok, player = pcall(function() return exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(src) end)
        local cid = ok and type(player) == 'table' and type(player.PlayerData) == 'table' and player.PlayerData.citizenid
        if type(cid) == 'string' and cid ~= '' then return 'cid:' .. cid end
        return nil
    end
    local ok, license = pcall(GetPlayerIdentifierByType, src, 'license')
    if ok and type(license) == 'string' and license ~= '' then return 'lic:' .. license end
    return nil
end

local function toast(src, key, kind, vars)
    pcall(function()
        exports.aeterna_notify:notify(src, { title = AeternaCore.t(key, vars), type = kind })
    end)
end

local function sendShot(src, payload)
    TriggerClientEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:shot', src, payload)
end

local function sendGallery(src, who)
    TriggerClientEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:gallery', src, { items = svc:gallery(who) })
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Phone tiles (phonekit App API)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function addTiles()
    if GetResourceState('aeterna_phonekit') ~= 'started' then return end
    pcall(function()
        exports.aeterna_phonekit:addTile({ id = 'camera', label = AeternaCore.t('camera.app.camera'), icon = 'camera', order = 40 })
        exports.aeterna_phonekit:addTile({ id = 'gallery', label = AeternaCore.t('camera.app.gallery'), icon = 'image', order = 41 })
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('aeterna_phonekit:app', function(src, data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or data.owner ~= RES then return end
    local who = whoOf(src)
    if not who then return end
    if data.id == 'camera' then
        TriggerClientEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:viewfinder', src, svc:openViewfinder(src, who))
    elseif data.id == 'gallery' then
        sendGallery(src, who)
    end
end)

-- Dead battery or lost device: close the viewfinder and the gallery on that client.
AddEventHandler('aeterna_phonekit:power', function(src, data)
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or data.on ~= false then return end
    svc:close(src)
    svc.deps.tickets:drop(src)
    sendShot(src, { ok = false, reason = 'power_off' })
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Net events
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local SHOOT_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    mode = { type = 'string', enum = { 'back', 'selfie' } },
} }
local DELETE_SCHEMA = { type = 'table', extra = false, fields = {
    id = { type = 'string', minLen = 32, maxLen = 32, pattern = '^[0-9a-f]+$' },
} }

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:shoot', function(payload)
    local src = source
    if not AeternaCore.rateLimit(src, 'camera:shoot', 1, 1000) then return end
    local ok, err, data = AeternaCore.validate(payload, SHOOT_SCHEMA)
    if not ok then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('dropped aeterna_camera:sv:shoot', { src = src, err = err })
        return
    end
    local who = whoOf(src)
    if not who then return end
    local allowed, ticketOrReason = svc:shoot(src, who, data.mode)
    if allowed then
        TriggerClientEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:capture', src, { ticket = ticketOrReason })
    else
        sendShot(src, { ok = false, reason = ticketOrReason })
        toast(src, ticketOrReason, 'warning')
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:close', function()
    local src = source
    if not AeternaCore.rateLimit(src, 'camera:close', 4, 1000) then return end
    svc:close(src)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:delete', function(payload)
    local src = source
    if not AeternaCore.rateLimit(src, 'camera:delete', 3, 1000) then return end
    local ok, err = AeternaCore.validate(payload, DELETE_SCHEMA)
    -- maxLen cuts a longer string before the pattern runs, so the raw id is checked too.
    if not ok or not Ids.isId(payload.id) then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('dropped aeterna_camera:sv:delete', { src = src, err = err or 'id: length' })
        return
    end
    local who = whoOf(src)
    if not who then return end
    local deleted, reason = svc:delete(src, who, payload.id)
    if deleted then
        sendGallery(src, who)
    elseif reason then
        toast(src, reason, 'warning')
    else
        AeternaCore.log.debug('dropped delete of a photo the character does not own', { src = src })
    end
end)

-- Latent upload from the client's own capture. The payload is checked in service.upload (shape, ticket first,
-- length cap before decoding); the image data never reaches a log line.
RegisterNetEvent('aeterna_camera:sv:upload', function(payload)
    local src = source
    if not AeternaCore.rateLimit(src, 'camera:upload', 1, 1000) then return end
    local who = whoOf(src)
    if not who then return end
    local status, a, b = svc:upload(src, who, payload)
    if status == 'saved' then
        sendShot(src, { ok = true, id = a.id })
        toast(src, 'camera.saved', 'success')
        if shootTests[src] then
            -- shoot_and_view: the person checks the new photo in the gallery.
            svc:close(src)
            sendGallery(src, who)
        end
    elseif status == 'refused' then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('refused photo upload', { src = src, reason = b })
        sendShot(src, { ok = false, reason = a })
        toast(src, a, 'error')
    else
        AeternaCore.log.warn('dropped photo upload', { src = src, reason = a })
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    shootTests[source] = nil
    svc:drop(source)
end)

AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', function(src)
    svc:drop(src)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HTTP: GET /aeterna_camera/p/<id>.jpg (router.lua). writeHead always gets at least one header.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function serve(r, req, res)
    local answer = r:handle({ method = req.method, path = req.path, address = req.address })
    res.writeHead(answer.status, answer.headers)
    res.send(answer.body)
end

SetHttpHandler(function(req, res)
    serve(router, req, res)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Exports and the admin command
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

exports('getPhoto', function(id)
    return svc:getPhoto(id)
end)

exports('listPhotos', function(who)
    return svc:listPhotos(who)
end)

exports('removePhoto', function(id, reason)
    if reason ~= nil then
        reason = type(reason) == 'string' and AeternaCore.text.clean(reason, 64) or nil
    end
    return svc:remove(id, reason)
end)

exports('available', function()
    return screenshotStarted()
end)

local function reply(src, key, vars)
    if src == 0 then
        print(AeternaCore.t(key, vars))
    else
        toast(src, key, 'info', vars)
    end
end

RegisterCommand('aeterna_camera_remove', function(src, args)
    if not AeternaCore.can(src, 'aeterna.camera.admin') then return end
    local id = args and args[1]
    if not Ids.isId(id) then
        reply(src, 'camera.admin.usage')
        return
    end
    if svc:remove(id, 'admin') then
        reply(src, 'camera.admin.removed', { id = id })
    else
        reply(src, 'camera.admin.unknown', { id = id })
    end
end, false)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Self-tests (server side). Mocks write only under the fake key test:camera and put the total back.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function report(runId, name, ok, detail, extra)
    exports.aeterna_core:reportSelftest(runId, name, ok, detail, extra)
end

local function fakeState(store)
    local left = 0
    for _, key in ipairs(kv.keys(Store.PHOTO)) do
        local raw = kv.get(key)
        if type(raw) == 'string' and raw:find(ST.FAKE_WHO, 1, true) then left = left + 1 end
    end
    return { total = store:total(), count = store:count(ST.FAKE_WHO), left = left }
end

local function mockReport(runId, name, ok, detail, before)
    local after = fakeState(svc.deps.store)
    if not ST.restored(before, after) then
        report(runId, name, false, 'state not restored')
        return
    end
    report(runId, name, ok and 'mock' or false, detail, ok and { restored = true } or nil)
end

local function cleanFake()
    for _, p in ipairs(svc:listPhotos(ST.FAKE_WHO)) do svc:remove(p.id, 'selftest') end
end

local tests = {}

tests.id_and_path_guard = function()
    return ST.guard(Ids.isId, photoId)
end

tests.http_router = function()
    local id = photoId()
    local bytes = Codec.tinyJpeg()
    local r = Router.new({
        now = GetGameTimer,
        has = function(x) return x == id end,
        load = function(x) return x == id and bytes or nil end,
    })
    local cases, answers = ST.httpCases(id), {}
    for i, c in ipairs(cases) do
        local seen = {}
        serve(r, c.req, {
            writeHead = function(code, headers) seen.status, seen.headers = code, headers end,
            send = function() end,
        })
        answers[i] = seen
    end
    return ST.judgeHttp(cases, answers)
end

tests.screenshot_detect = function()
    return ST.screenshotDetail(screenshotStarted())
end

tests.store_roundtrip = function()
    local photo, why = svc:save(0, ST.FAKE_WHO, 'back', Codec.tinyJpeg())
    if not photo then return false, 'save refused: ' .. tostring(why) end
    local back = svc:getPhoto(photo.id)
    local list = svc:listPhotos(ST.FAKE_WHO)
    local file = loadPhoto(photo.id)
    local okRemove = svc:remove(photo.id, 'selftest')
    if not back or back.bytes ~= photo.bytes then return false, 'index read-back differs' end
    if not list[1] or list[1].id ~= photo.id then return false, 'list does not start with the new photo' end
    if file ~= Codec.tinyJpeg() then return false, 'file read-back differs' end
    if not okRemove or svc:getPhoto(photo.id) then return false, 'remove failed' end
    if loadPhoto(photo.id) ~= '' then return false, 'removed file is not empty' end
    return true, 'file, index and list written, read and removed'
end

tests.caps = function()
    local store = svc.deps.store
    local small = Store.new({ kv = kv, json = json, perCharacter = 1, maxTotalBytes = store:total() + 30 })
    local capped = Service.new(setmetatable({ store = small }, { __index = svc.deps }),
        { cooldownMs = cfg.cooldownMs, maxBytes = cfg.maxBytes, perCharacter = 1 })
    local jpeg = Codec.tinyJpeg()
    local first = capped:save(0, ST.FAKE_WHO, 'back', jpeg)
    if not first then return false, 'first photo refused' end
    local okFull, reasonFull = small:check(ST.FAKE_WHO, 0)
    local okDisk, reasonDisk = small:check('test:camera2', #jpeg)
    capped:remove(first.id, 'selftest')
    if okFull or reasonFull ~= 'camera.full' then return false, 'per-character cap did not refuse' end
    if okDisk or reasonDisk ~= 'camera.disk_full' then return false, 'total cap did not refuse' end
    return true, 'camera.full and camera.disk_full refused at their caps'
end

tests.saved_hook = function()
    local caught = {}
    local handle = AddEventHandler('aeterna_camera:saved', function(src, photo)
        if type(photo) == 'table' and photo.who == ST.FAKE_WHO then caught[#caught + 1] = { src, photo } end
    end)
    local photo = svc:save(0, ST.FAKE_WHO, 'selfie', Codec.tinyJpeg())
    RemoveEventHandler(handle)
    if not photo then return false, 'save refused' end
    svc:remove(photo.id, 'selftest')
    return ST.checkSaved(caught, photo.id)
end

local MOCKS = { store_roundtrip = true, caps = true, saved_hook = true }

-- Self-test events are trusted only from aeterna_core; any resource can fire a local event.
local function fromCore()
    return GetInvokingResource() == 'aeterna_core'
end

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftest', function(runId, name, ctx)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or name:sub(1, #PREFIX) ~= PREFIX then return end
    if type(ctx) == 'table' and ctx.side == 'client' then return end
    local short = name:sub(#PREFIX + 1)
    local fn = tests[short]
    if not fn then return end
    local before = MOCKS[short] and fakeState(svc.deps.store) or nil
    local okRun, ok, detail = pcall(fn)
    if MOCKS[short] then
        cleanFake()
        if not okRun then
            report(runId, name, false, 'error: ' .. tostring(ok))
            return
        end
        mockReport(runId, name, ok, detail, before)
        return
    end
    if not okRun then
        report(runId, name, false, 'error: ' .. tostring(ok))
        return
    end
    report(runId, name, ok and true or false, detail)
end)

-- shoot_and_view (eye, destructive): core announces the client test on the server first. Open the viewfinder for
-- player A so the client half can shoot; the photo passes the write guard before it is written (mayWrite above).
local SHOOT_TEST = PREFIX .. 'shoot_and_view'

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftestStarted', function(runId, name, ctx)
    if not fromCore() then return end
    if name ~= SHOOT_TEST or type(ctx) ~= 'table' or type(ctx.a) ~= 'number' then return end
    local who = whoOf(ctx.a)
    if not who then return end
    shootTests[ctx.a] = { runId = runId, name = name }
    TriggerClientEvent('aeterna_camera:cl:viewfinder', ctx.a, svc:openViewfinder(ctx.a, who))
end)

local function endShootTests(runId)
    for src, t in pairs(shootTests) do
        if runId == nil or t.runId == runId then
            shootTests[src] = nil
            svc:close(src)
            svc.deps.tickets:drop(src)
        end
    end
end

AddEventHandler('aeterna_core:selftestEnd', function(runId, name)
    if not fromCore() or name ~= SHOOT_TEST then return end
    endShootTests(runId)
end)

-- A stopped core ends every run without a selftestEnd.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == 'aeterna_core' then endShootTests(nil) end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Start
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function registerSelftests()
    for _, row in ipairs(ST.rows(AeternaCore.t)) do
        local okAdd, err = pcall(function() return exports.aeterna_core:addSelftest(row.name, row.meta) end)
        if not okAdd then AeternaCore.log.warn('selftest registration failed', { name = row.name, err = tostring(err) }) end
    end
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
    if resource == 'aeterna_phonekit' then addTiles() end
end)

do
    local changed, before, after = svc.deps.store:repair()
    if changed then
        AeternaCore.log.warn('photo total did not match the index; corrected', { before = before, after = after })
    end
end
addTiles()
registerSelftests()

-- codec.lua -- aeterna_camera: base64 (RFC 4648, padded), JPEG start/end checks and the upload data check.
-- Pure Lua 5.4 (bit operators), no natives.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

M.PREFIX = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,'

local ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
local DEC = {}
for i = 1, 64 do DEC[ALPHABET:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
local ENC = {}
for i = 1, 64 do ENC[i - 1] = ALPHABET:sub(i, i) end

local PAD = 61 -- '='
local CHUNK = 4096

local byte, char, concat = string.byte, string.char, table.concat

-- Longest accepted data string for a decoded size: base64 grows by 4/3, plus the prefix and slack.
function M.maxDataLen(maxBytes)
    return math.ceil(maxBytes * 4 / 3) + 32
end

function M.encode(bytes)
    local out, o = {}, 0
    local n = #bytes
    for i = 1, n, 3 do
        local a, b, c = byte(bytes, i, i + 2)
        local v = (a << 16) | ((b or 0) << 8) | (c or 0)
        local s = ENC[(v >> 18) & 63] .. ENC[(v >> 12) & 63]
            .. (b and ENC[(v >> 6) & 63] or '=') .. (c and ENC[v & 63] or '=')
        o = o + 1
        out[o] = s
    end
    return concat(out)
end

-- Returns the bytes, or nil and a reason. Refuses any character outside the alphabet, padding anywhere but
-- the last one or two places, and a length that is not a multiple of 4.
function M.decode(s)
    if type(s) ~= 'string' then return nil, 'type' end
    local n = #s
    if n == 0 or n % 4 ~= 0 then return nil, 'length' end
    local pad = 0
    if byte(s, n) == PAD then
        pad = byte(s, n - 1) == PAD and 2 or 1
    end
    local out, o = {}, 0
    local buf, b = {}, 0
    local last = n - 3
    for i = 1, n, 4 do
        local c1, c2, c3, c4 = byte(s, i, i + 3)
        local d1, d2, d3, d4 = DEC[c1], DEC[c2], DEC[c3], DEC[c4]
        if i == last and pad > 0 then
            d4 = 0
            if pad == 2 then d3 = 0 end
        end
        if not (d1 and d2 and d3 and d4) then return nil, 'char' end
        local v = (d1 << 18) | (d2 << 12) | (d3 << 6) | d4
        local piece
        if i == last and pad == 2 then
            piece = char(v >> 16)
        elseif i == last and pad == 1 then
            piece = char(v >> 16, (v >> 8) & 255)
        else
            piece = char(v >> 16, (v >> 8) & 255, v & 255)
        end
        b = b + 1
        buf[b] = piece
        if b >= CHUNK then
            o = o + 1
            out[o] = concat(buf, '', 1, b)
            b = 0
        end
    end
    if b > 0 then
        o = o + 1
        out[o] = concat(buf, '', 1, b)
    end
    return concat(out)
end

-- Start bytes FF D8 FF and end bytes FF D9.
function M.isJpeg(bytes)
    if type(bytes) ~= 'string' or #bytes < 5 then return false end
    local a, b, c = byte(bytes, 1, 3)
    local y, z = byte(bytes, -2, -1)
    return a == 0xFF and b == 0xD8 and c == 0xFF and y == 0xFF and z == 0xD9
end

-- Checks an uploaded data URI in the spec's order. Returns true, bytes or false, reason
-- ('type', 'too long', 'prefix', 'base64', 'not jpeg', 'too large'). The reason never carries the data.
function M.checkUpload(data, maxBytes)
    if type(data) ~= 'string' then return false, 'type' end
    if #data > M.maxDataLen(maxBytes) then return false, 'too long' end
    if data:sub(1, #M.PREFIX) ~= M.PREFIX then return false, 'prefix' end
    local bytes = M.decode(data:sub(#M.PREFIX + 1))
    if not bytes then return false, 'base64' end
    if not M.isJpeg(bytes) then return false, 'not jpeg' end
    if #bytes > maxBytes then return false, 'too large' end
    return true, bytes
end

-- A minimal JPEG built at run time for the self-tests, one marker per piece.
function M.tinyJpeg()
    return char(0xFF, 0xD8)                    -- SOI
        .. char(0xFF, 0xE0, 0x00, 0x10)        -- APP0, segment length 16
        .. 'JFIF' .. char(0x00)                -- identifier
        .. char(0x01, 0x01, 0x00)              -- version 1.1, no density unit
        .. char(0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x01)        -- density 1 x 1
        .. char(0x00, 0x00)                    -- no thumbnail
        .. char(0xFF, 0xD9)                    -- EOI
end

CameraLogic.codec = M
return M

-- ids.lua -- aeterna_camera: photo ids and tickets (32 lowercase hex) and the paths built from them.
-- Ids are hard to guess, not a secret: each stream keeps its own xorshift state (seeded once at start) and mixes
-- math.random, a running counter, the game timer and os.clock into every draw. A path is only ever built from an
-- id that passed isId, so it cannot hold '/', '..' or upper case. No natives.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

local GOLDEN = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15     -- wraps to a 64-bit integer
local LCG_MUL = 6364136223846793005
local LCG_ADD = 1442695040888963407

-- opts = { seed (integer), rand(lo, hi), now() (ms), clock() (s, float) }. Returns next() -> id.
function M.stream(opts)
    local state = math.tointeger(opts.seed) or 0
    state = state ~ GOLDEN
    if state == 0 then state = GOLDEN end
    local counter = 0

    local function step()
        state = state ~ (state << 13)
        state = state ~ (state >> 7)
        state = state ~ (state << 17)
        return state
    end

    return function()
        counter = counter + 1
        local timer = math.tointeger(math.floor(tonumber(opts.now()) or 0)) or 0
        local micros = math.tointeger(math.floor((tonumber(opts.clock()) or 0) * 1000000)) or 0
        local mix = (counter * GOLDEN) ~ timer ~ (micros << 20)
        local parts = {}
        for i = 1, 8 do
            mix = mix * LCG_MUL + LCG_ADD
            local v = step() ~ mix ~ (opts.rand(0, 0xFFFF) << 32)
            parts[i] = string.format('%04x', (v >> 32) & 0xFFFF)
        end
        return table.concat(parts)
    end
end

function M.isId(s)
    return type(s) == 'string' and #s == 32 and s:find('^[0-9a-f]+$') ~= nil
end

function M.path(id)
    return 'photos/' .. id .. '.jpg'
end

function M.urlPath(id)
    return '/aeterna_camera/p/' .. id .. '.jpg'
end

CameraLogic.ids = M
return M

-- router.lua -- aeterna_camera HTTP answers for SetHttpHandler. Only GET p/<id>.jpg with an id in the index is
-- served; everything else is 404, and more than `limit` requests in `windowMs` from one address is 429.
-- Every answer carries at least one header: writeHead(code, {}) stops FXServer b177. No natives:
-- opts = { now() ms, has(id), load(id) -> bytes|nil, limit = 60, windowMs = 10000 }.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local Ids = CameraLogic.ids

local M = {}

local SWEEP_EVERY = 500

local function plain(status)
    return { status = status, headers = { ['Content-Type'] = 'text/plain' }, body = '' }
end

-- '1.2.3.4:5000' -> '1.2.3.4'; a bracketed IPv6 keeps its brackets; an unbracketed IPv6 stays whole.
local function addressKey(address)
    if type(address) ~= 'string' or address == '' then return '?' end
    local bracketed = address:match('^(%[[^%]]*%])')
    if bracketed then return bracketed end
    local _, colons = address:gsub(':', '')
    if colons == 1 then return (address:match('^([^:]*):')) end
    return address
end

-- Path relative to the resource ('/p/<id>.jpg'), with any query string split off first.
local function routeId(path)
    if type(path) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    path = path:match('^([^?]*)') or ''
    path = path:gsub('^/+', '')
    return path:match('^p/([^/]+)%.jpg$')
end

function M.new(opts)
    local r = {
        now = opts.now,
        has = opts.has,
        load = opts.load,
        limit = opts.limit or 60,
        windowMs = opts.windowMs or 10000,
        windows = {},
        seen = 0,
    }

    local function sweep(now)
        for key, list in pairs(r.windows) do
            if list[#list] == nil or now - list[#list] >= r.windowMs then r.windows[key] = nil end
        end
    end

    -- Sliding window per address. Returns false when this request is over the limit.
    local function admit(key, now)
        local list = r.windows[key] or {}
        local kept = {}
        for _, at in ipairs(list) do
            if now - at < r.windowMs then kept[#kept + 1] = at end
        end
        if #kept >= r.limit then
            r.windows[key] = kept
            return false
        end
        kept[#kept + 1] = now
        r.windows[key] = kept
        return true
    end

    function r:handle(req)
        req = type(req) == 'table' and req or {}
        local now = self.now()
        self.seen = self.seen + 1
        if self.seen % SWEEP_EVERY == 0 then sweep(now) end
        if not admit(addressKey(req.address), now) then return plain(429) end
        if req.method ~= 'GET' then return plain(404) end
        local id = routeId(req.path)
        if not Ids.isId(id) or not self.has(id) then return plain(404) end
        local bytes = self.load(id)
        if type(bytes) ~= 'string' or bytes == '' then return plain(404) end
        return {
            status = 200,
            headers = {
                ['Content-Type'] = 'image/jpeg',
                ['Cache-Control'] = 'private, max-age=86400',
                ['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff',
            },
            body = bytes,
        }
    end

    return r
end

CameraLogic.router = M
return M

-- selftests.lua -- aeterna_camera self-test rows (spec "Self-tests (0.2)") and what counts as a pass for each.
-- The server and client wrappers only gather results and report them. No natives.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

M.FAKE_WHO = 'test:camera'

function M.rows(t)
    return {
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.id_and_path_guard', meta = { kind = 'headless', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.http_router', meta = { kind = 'headless', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.store_roundtrip', meta = { kind = 'mock', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.caps', meta = { kind = 'mock', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.saved_hook', meta = { kind = 'mock', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.screenshot_detect', meta = { kind = 'headless', players = 1, destructive = false } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.viewfinder', meta = { kind = 'eye', players = 1, destructive = false,
            expect = t('camera.selftest.viewfinder') } },
        { name = 'aeterna_camera.shoot_and_view', meta = { kind = 'eye', players = 1, destructive = true,
            expect = t('camera.selftest.shoot_and_view'), skipWhen = { resources = { 'screenshot-basic' } },
            timeout = 15000 } },
    }
end

-- The eye test drives the viewfinder itself, then hands over to the person (ms from the test's start).
M.VIEWFINDER_STEPS = {
    { at = 0, action = 'open' },
    { at = 1500, action = 'selfie' },
    { at = 3000, action = 'close' },
}

-- shoot_and_view on the client: wait for the server's viewfinder, shoot, then wait for the gallery it opens
-- (capture plus a latent upload of a few hundred KB). Both fit inside the row's 15 s timeout.
M.SHOOT_WAIT_VIEWFINDER_MS = 5000
M.SHOOT_WAIT_GALLERY_MS = 8000

local BAD_IDS = {
    '../0123456789abcdef0123456789ab', '0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF', '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde',
    '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0', '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcd/x', '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdeg', '',
}

-- Generated ids match ^[0-9a-f]{32}$, never repeat, and the guard refuses every bad form.
function M.guard(isId, nextId)
    local seen = {}
    for i = 1, 200 do
        local id = nextId()
        if type(id) ~= 'string' or #id ~= 32 or not id:find('^[0-9a-f]+$') or not isId(id) then
            return false, 'generated id ' .. i .. ' does not match ^[0-9a-f]{32}$'
        end
        if seen[id] then return false, 'generated id ' .. i .. ' repeats' end
        seen[id] = true
    end
    for _, bad in ipairs(BAD_IDS) do
        if isId(bad) then return false, 'guard accepted a bad id' end
    end
    return true, '200 distinct ids, ' .. #BAD_IDS .. ' bad forms refused'
end

-- Requests for one router, in order; the last ones push a single address over the 60-in-10-s limit.
function M.httpCases(id)
    local addr = '192.0.2.1:1'
    local cases = {
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 200 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/../' .. id .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id:upper() .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id:sub(2) .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id .. '0.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id .. '.png', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. string.rep('0', 32) .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'POST', path = '/p/' .. id .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 404 },
        { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id .. '.jpg?v=1', address = addr }, status = 200 },
    }
    for _ = #cases + 1, 60 do
        cases[#cases + 1] = { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/', address = addr }, status = 404 }
    end
    cases[#cases + 1] = { req = { method = 'GET', path = '/p/' .. id .. '.jpg', address = addr }, status = 429 }
    return cases
end

-- answers[i] = { status, headers } as the fake response object saw them.
function M.judgeHttp(cases, answers)
    if type(answers) ~= 'table' or #answers ~= #cases then return false, 'missing answers' end
    for i, c in ipairs(cases) do
        local a = answers[i]
        if type(a.headers) ~= 'table' or next(a.headers) == nil then
            return false, 'case ' .. i .. ': writeHead without a header'
        end
        if a.status ~= c.status then
            return false, ('case %d: %s, expected %d'):format(i, tostring(a.status), c.status)
        end
    end
    return true, #cases .. ' requests answered as expected'
end

local PHOTO_FIELDS = {
    { 'id', 'string' }, { 'who', 'string' }, { 'ts', 'number' }, { 'mode', 'string' }, { 'bytes', 'number' },
    { 'path', 'string' }, { 'urlPath', 'string' },
}

-- events = { { src, photo }, … } caught for the test's own photo.
function M.checkSaved(events, id)
    if #events ~= 1 then return false, 'saved fired ' .. #events .. ' times' end
    local photo = events[1][2]
    if type(photo) ~= 'table' or photo.id ~= id then return false, 'saved carried another photo' end
    for _, f in ipairs(PHOTO_FIELDS) do
        if type(photo[f[1]]) ~= f[2] then return false, 'saved photo has no ' .. f[1] end
    end
    if photo.path ~= 'photos/' .. id .. '.jpg' or photo.urlPath ~= '/aeterna_camera/p/' .. id .. '.jpg' then
        return false, 'saved photo paths do not match its id'
    end
    return true, 'one saved event with every field'
end

-- before = { total }, after = { total, count = photos left under the fake key, left = records still in KVP }.
function M.restored(before, after)
    return after.total == before.total and after.count == 0 and after.left == 0
end

function M.screenshotDetail(started)
    if started then return true, 'screenshot-basic started: photos on' end
    return true, 'screenshot-basic not started: photos off, viewfinder only'
end

CameraLogic.selftests = M
return M

-- service.lua -- aeterna_camera server rules: viewfinder state, the shoot gate, tickets, upload checks, saving,
-- ownership and removal. Every native comes in through `deps`, so busted drives it with fakes:
--   store, tickets, newId(), now() ms, clock() s, available(), writePhoto(id, bytes) -> boolean,
--   emit(name, ...), warn(msg, fields), mayWrite(src) -> boolean (optional: the self-test write guard),
--   acctOf(src) -> account key or nil (optional: the per-account byte cap)
-- cfg = { cooldownMs, maxBytes, perCharacter }

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local Codec = CameraLogic.codec
local Ids = CameraLogic.ids

local M = {}

local DISK_WARN_MS = 3600000
local MODES = { back = true, selfie = true }
local REASON_MAX = 64
local GALLERY_MAX = 500
local MAX_DRAWS = 8

function M.view(id, rec)
    return {
        id = id, who = rec.who, ts = rec.ts, mode = rec.mode, bytes = rec.bytes,
        path = Ids.path(id), urlPath = Ids.urlPath(id),
    }
end

-- Upload payload: exactly { ticket, data }, ticket 32 lowercase hex, data a string. Returns ok, why.
local function payloadShape(p)
    if type(p) ~= 'table' then return false, 'payload' end
    for k in pairs(p) do
        if k ~= 'ticket' and k ~= 'data' then return false, 'payload' end
    end
    if not Ids.isId(p.ticket) then return false, 'ticket' end
    if type(p.data) ~= 'string' then return false, 'data' end
    return true
end

function M.new(deps, cfg)
    local svc = { deps = deps, cfg = cfg, open = {}, lastShot = {}, lastDelete = {}, lastDiskWarn = nil }

    local function refuseWarn(reason)
        if reason ~= 'camera.disk_full' then return end
        local now = deps.now()
        if svc.lastDiskWarn == nil or now - svc.lastDiskWarn >= DISK_WARN_MS then
            svc.lastDiskWarn = now
            deps.warn('photo disk cap reached', { total = deps.store:total(), cap = deps.store.maxTotalBytes })
        end
    end

    local function acctOf(src)
        if not deps.acctOf then return nil end
        local a = deps.acctOf(src)
        return type(a) == 'string' and a ~= '' and a or nil
    end

    function svc:openViewfinder(src, who)
        self.open[src] = true
        return { count = deps.store:count(who), cap = cfg.perCharacter }
    end

    function svc:close(src)
        self.open[src] = nil
    end

    function svc:isOpen(src)
        return self.open[src] == true
    end

    -- true, ticket  or  false, locale key. No ticket is issued on a refusal.
    function svc:shoot(src, who, mode)
        if not self.open[src] or not MODES[mode] then return false, 'camera.failed' end
        if not deps.available() then return false, 'camera.unavailable' end
        local now = deps.now()
        local last = self.lastShot[src]
        if last and now - last < cfg.cooldownMs then return false, 'camera.slow' end
        local ok, reason = deps.store:check(who, 0, acctOf(src))
        if not ok then
            refuseWarn(reason)
            return false, reason
        end
        self.lastShot[src] = now
        return true, deps.tickets:issue(src, who, mode)
    end

    -- Writes the file, then the index, then fires saved. Returns the photo view, or nil and a locale key.
    function svc:save(src, who, mode, bytes)
        local acct = acctOf(src)
        local ok, reason = deps.store:check(who, #bytes, acct)
        if not ok then
            refuseWarn(reason)
            return nil, reason
        end
        if deps.mayWrite and not deps.mayWrite(src) then
            deps.warn('photo refused by the self-test write guard', { src = src })
            return nil, 'camera.failed'
        end
        local id = deps.store.takeFree and deps.store:takeFree() or nil
        for _ = 1, id and 0 or MAX_DRAWS do
            local candidate = deps.newId()
            if not deps.store:has(candidate) then
                id = candidate
                break
            end
        end
        if not id then
            deps.warn('photo id draw failed')
            return nil, 'camera.failed'
        end
        if not deps.writePhoto(id, bytes) then
            deps.warn('photo file write failed', { id = id })
            return nil, 'camera.failed'
        end
        local rec = { who = who, ts = deps.clock(), mode = mode, bytes = #bytes, acct = acct }
        local added, why = deps.store:add(id, rec)
        if not added then
            deps.writePhoto(id, '')
            if deps.store.giveFree then deps.store:giveFree(id) end
            return nil, why
        end
        local photo = M.view(id, rec)
        deps.emit('aeterna_camera:saved', src, photo)
        return photo
    end

    -- 'saved', photo  |  'refused', locale key, detail  |  'dropped', why (no answer to the client).
    function svc:upload(src, who, payload)
        local shaped, why = payloadShape(payload)
        if not shaped then return 'dropped', why end
        local taken, entry = deps.tickets:take(payload.ticket, src, who)
        if not taken then return 'dropped', entry end
        local ok, bytesOrWhy = Codec.checkUpload(payload.data, cfg.maxBytes)
        if not ok then
            deps.warn('photo upload refused', { src = src, reason = bytesOrWhy })
            return 'refused', 'camera.failed', bytesOrWhy
        end
        local photo, key = self:save(src, who, entry.mode, bytesOrWhy)
        if not photo then return 'refused', key, key end
        return 'saved', photo
    end

    function svc:remove(id, reason)
        if not Ids.isId(id) then return false end
        local rec = deps.store:remove(id)
        if not rec then return false end
        if deps.writePhoto(id, '') and deps.store.giveFree then deps.store:giveFree(id) end
        if type(reason) ~= 'string' or reason == '' then reason = 'admin' end
        local stop = utf8.offset(reason, REASON_MAX + 1)
        if stop then reason = reason:sub(1, stop - 1) end
        deps.emit('aeterna_camera:removed', id, reason)
        return true
    end

    -- Only the owner's current character may delete, at most once per cooldownMs (each delete leaves an empty
    -- file on disk). Returns true, or false and 'camera.slow' inside the cooldown.
    function svc:delete(src, who, id)
        if not Ids.isId(id) then return false end
        local rec = deps.store:get(id)
        if not rec or rec.who ~= who then return false end
        local now = deps.now()
        local last = self.lastDelete[src]
        if last and now - last < cfg.cooldownMs then return false, 'camera.slow' end
        if not self:remove(id, 'owner') then return false end
        self.lastDelete[src] = now
        return true
    end

    function svc:getPhoto(id)
        if not Ids.isId(id) then return nil end
        local rec = deps.store:get(id)
        return rec and M.view(id, rec) or nil
    end

    function svc:listPhotos(who)
        local out = {}
        if type(who) ~= 'string' then return out end
        for _, id in ipairs(deps.store:list(who)) do
            local rec = deps.store:get(id)
            if rec then out[#out + 1] = M.view(id, rec) end
        end
        return out
    end

    function svc:gallery(who)
        local items = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(self:listPhotos(who)) do
            if #items >= GALLERY_MAX then break end
            items[#items + 1] = { id = p.id, ts = p.ts, mode = p.mode, bytes = p.bytes }
        end
        return items
    end

    function svc:drop(src)
        self.open[src] = nil
        self.lastShot[src] = nil
        self.lastDelete[src] = nil
        deps.tickets:drop(src)
    end

    return svc
end

CameraLogic.service = M
return M

-- settings.lua -- aeterna_camera: checks config.lua. A missing or out-of-range key falls back to its default
-- with one warn naming the key. No natives.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

local RULES = {
    { key = 'perCharacter', default = 60, min = 1, max = 500, integer = true },
    { key = 'maxBytes', default = 900000, min = 100000, max = 3000000, integer = true },
    { key = 'maxTotalMB', default = 1024, min = 1, max = 1048576, integer = true },
    { key = 'perAccountMB', default = 200, min = 1, max = 1048576, integer = true },
    { key = 'quality', default = 0.8, min = 0.5, max = 0.95 },
    { key = 'cooldownMs', default = 3000, min = 0, max = 600000, integer = true },
}

function M.check(raw, warn)
    raw = type(raw) == 'table' and raw or {}
    local cfg = {}
    for _, rule in ipairs(RULES) do
        local v = raw[rule.key]
        local ok = type(v) == 'number' and v >= rule.min and v <= rule.max
            and (not rule.integer or v == math.floor(v))
        if ok then
            cfg[rule.key] = v
        else
            if v ~= nil then warn('invalid config value; using the default', { key = rule.key }) end
            cfg[rule.key] = rule.default
        end
    end
    return cfg
end

CameraLogic.settings = M
return M

-- store.lua -- aeterna_camera: the photo index in server-side resource KVP and its caps.
--   aeterna_camera:photo:v1:<id>   { who, ts, mode, bytes }
--   aeterna_camera:photos:v1:<who> array of ids, newest first
--   aeterna_camera:total:v1        integer bytes of all photos
--   aeterna_camera:acct:v1:<acct>  integer bytes of all photos of one account (all its characters)
--   aeterna_camera:free:v1         array of ids whose file is empty (a deleted photo); the next photo reuses one
-- `kv` = { get(key), set(key, string), del(key), keys(prefix) } (GetResourceKvpString, SetResourceKvp,
-- DeleteResourceKvp, StartFindKvp/FindKvp on the server). No natives here.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

M.PHOTO = 'aeterna_camera:photo:v1:'
M.LIST = 'aeterna_camera:photos:v1:'
M.TOTAL = 'aeterna_camera:total:v1'
M.ACCT = 'aeterna_camera:acct:v1:'
M.FREE = 'aeterna_camera:free:v1'
M.FREE_MAX = 5000

function M.new(opts)
    local kv, json = opts.kv, opts.json
    local s = {
        perCharacter = opts.perCharacter,
        maxTotalBytes = opts.maxTotalBytes,
        perAccountBytes = opts.perAccountBytes,
    }

    local function decode(raw)
        if type(raw) ~= 'string' or raw == '' then return nil end
        local ok, v = pcall(json.decode, raw)
        if ok then return v end
        return nil
    end

    local function validRecord(rec)
        return type(rec) == 'table' and type(rec.who) == 'string' and type(rec.bytes) == 'number'
    end

    function s:get(id)
        local rec = decode(kv.get(M.PHOTO .. id))
        if not validRecord(rec) then return nil end
        return rec
    end

    function s:has(id)
        return self:get(id) ~= nil
    end

    function s:list(who)
        local ids = decode(kv.get(M.LIST .. who))
        if type(ids) ~= 'table' then return {} end
        local out = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            if type(id) == 'string' then out[#out + 1] = id end
        end
        return out
    end

    function s:count(who)
        return #self:list(who)
    end

    function s:total()
        local v = decode(kv.get(M.TOTAL))
        if type(v) ~= 'number' or v < 0 then return 0 end
        return math.floor(v)
    end

    -- 0 is stored as no key, so an empty index leaves nothing behind.
    local function setCount(key, n)
        n = math.max(0, math.floor(n))
        if n == 0 then
            kv.del(key)
        else
            kv.set(key, json.encode(n))
        end
    end

    local function setTotal(n) setCount(M.TOTAL, n) end

    function s:accountTotal(acct)
        if type(acct) ~= 'string' or acct == '' then return 0 end
        local v = decode(kv.get(M.ACCT .. acct))
        if type(v) ~= 'number' or v < 0 then return 0 end
        return math.floor(v)
    end

    local function freeIds()
        local ids = decode(kv.get(M.FREE))
        if type(ids) ~= 'table' then return {} end
        local out = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            if type(id) == 'string' then out[#out + 1] = id end
        end
        return out
    end

    local function setFree(ids)
        if #ids == 0 then kv.del(M.FREE) else kv.set(M.FREE, json.encode(ids)) end
    end

    -- An id whose file is empty, taken off the free list, or nil. A taken id that is still indexed is skipped.
    function s:takeFree()
        local ids = freeIds()
        while #ids > 0 do
            local id = table.remove(ids)
            if not self:has(id) then
                setFree(ids)
                return id
            end
        end
        setFree(ids)
        return nil
    end

    -- Puts an id whose file is now empty back on the free list (at most FREE_MAX; past that the file stays unused).
    function s:giveFree(id)
        local ids = freeIds()
        if #ids >= M.FREE_MAX then return false end
        for _, x in ipairs(ids) do
            if x == id then return true end
        end
        ids[#ids + 1] = id
        setFree(ids)
        return true
    end

    local function setList(who, ids)
        if #ids == 0 then
            kv.del(M.LIST .. who)
        else
            kv.set(M.LIST .. who, json.encode(ids))
        end
    end

    -- true, or false and the locale key of the refusal.
    function s:check(who, addBytes, acct)
        if self:count(who) >= self.perCharacter then return false, 'camera.full' end
        if self.perAccountBytes and type(acct) == 'string' and acct ~= ''
            and self:accountTotal(acct) + (addBytes or 0) > self.perAccountBytes then
            return false, 'camera.full'
        end
        local total = self:total()
        if total >= self.maxTotalBytes or total + (addBytes or 0) > self.maxTotalBytes then
            return false, 'camera.disk_full'
        end
        return true
    end

    function s:add(id, rec)
        local ok, reason = self:check(rec.who, rec.bytes, rec.acct)
        if not ok then return false, reason end
        local acct = type(rec.acct) == 'string' and rec.acct ~= '' and rec.acct or nil
        kv.set(M.PHOTO .. id, json.encode({ who = rec.who, ts = rec.ts, mode = rec.mode, bytes = rec.bytes, acct = acct }))
        if acct then setCount(M.ACCT .. acct, self:accountTotal(acct) + rec.bytes) end
        local ids = self:list(rec.who)
        table.insert(ids, 1, id)
        setList(rec.who, ids)
        setTotal(self:total() + rec.bytes)
        return true
    end

    -- Removes the record, the id from its owner's list and its bytes from the total. Returns the record or nil.
    function s:remove(id)
        local rec = self:get(id)
        if not rec then return nil end
        kv.del(M.PHOTO .. id)
        local ids, kept = self:list(rec.who), {}
        for _, x in ipairs(ids) do
            if x ~= id then kept[#kept + 1] = x end
        end
        setList(rec.who, kept)
        setTotal(self:total() - rec.bytes)
        if type(rec.acct) == 'string' and rec.acct ~= '' then
            setCount(M.ACCT .. rec.acct, self:accountTotal(rec.acct) - rec.bytes)
        end
        return rec
    end

    -- At start: total and every account total must equal the sums over photo:v1:*. Returns changed, before, after
    -- (before and after are the server total).
    function s:repair()
        local sum, perAcct = 0, {}
        for _, key in ipairs(kv.keys(M.PHOTO)) do
            local rec = decode(kv.get(key))
            if validRecord(rec) and rec.bytes > 0 then
                local b = math.floor(rec.bytes)
                sum = sum + b
                if type(rec.acct) == 'string' and rec.acct ~= '' then perAcct[rec.acct] = (perAcct[rec.acct] or 0) + b end
            end
        end
        local acctChanged = false
        for _, key in ipairs(kv.keys(M.ACCT)) do
            local acct = key:sub(#M.ACCT + 1)
            if perAcct[acct] == nil then kv.del(key) acctChanged = true end
        end
        for acct, b in pairs(perAcct) do
            if decode(kv.get(M.ACCT .. acct)) ~= b then setCount(M.ACCT .. acct, b) acctChanged = true end
        end
        local raw = decode(kv.get(M.TOTAL))
        local before = type(raw) == 'number' and raw or self:total()
        if raw == sum or (raw == nil and kv.get(M.TOTAL) == nil and sum == 0) then return acctChanged, before, sum end
        setTotal(sum)
        return true, before, sum
    end

    return s
end

CameraLogic.store = M
return M

local Adapter = {}
local framework_name = Config.Framework

local function resource_started(resource)
    return GetResourceState(resource) == 'started'
end

if framework_name == 'auto' then
    if resource_started('qbx_core') then
        framework_name = 'qbox'
    elseif resource_started('qb-core') then
        framework_name = 'qbcore'
    elseif resource_started('es_extended') then
        framework_name = 'esx'
    else
        error('secure-turn-in could not detect qbx_core, qb-core or es_extended')
    end
end

if framework_name == 'qbcore' then
    local qb_core = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

    function Adapter.get_player(src)
        return qb_core.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    end

    function Adapter.add_money(player, amount, reason)
        return player.Functions.AddMoney(Config.TurnIn.currency, amount, reason)
    end
elseif framework_name == 'esx' then
    local esx = exports['es_extended']:getSharedObject()

    function Adapter.get_player(src)
        return esx.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    end

    function Adapter.add_money(player, amount)
        if Config.TurnIn.currency == 'cash' then
            player.addMoney(amount)
            return true
        end

        player.addAccountMoney(Config.TurnIn.currency, amount)
        return true
    end
elseif framework_name == 'qbox' then
    function Adapter.get_player(src)
        return exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(src)
    end

    function Adapter.add_money(player, amount, reason)
        return player.Functions.AddMoney(Config.TurnIn.currency, amount, reason)
    end
else
    error(('secure-turn-in received unsupported framework "%s"'):format(framework_name))
end

Adapter.name = framework_name
