-- tickets.lua -- aeterna_camera: single-use upload tickets, one per player, bound to source and character,
-- valid ttlMs (30 s). No natives: the clock and the id generator are passed in.

CameraLogic = CameraLogic or {}

local M = {}

local TTL_MS = 30000

function M.new(opts)
    local t = {
        now = opts.now,
        newId = opts.newId,
        ttlMs = opts.ttlMs or TTL_MS,
        bySrc = {},
        byTicket = {},
    }

    local function forget(entry)
        t.byTicket[entry.ticket] = nil
        if t.bySrc[entry.src] == entry then t.bySrc[entry.src] = nil end
    end

    -- A new ticket replaces the player's old one.
    function t:issue(src, who, mode)
        local old = self.bySrc[src]
        if old then forget(old) end
        local ticket
        repeat ticket = self.newId() until not self.byTicket[ticket]
        local entry = { ticket = ticket, src = src, who = who, mode = mode, expires = self.now() + self.ttlMs }
        self.byTicket[ticket] = entry
        self.bySrc[src] = entry
        return ticket
    end

    -- Takes the ticket first, so it is gone whatever the checks say. Returns true, entry or false, reason
    -- ('unknown', 'expired', 'source', 'character').
    function t:take(ticket, src, who)
        local entry = self.byTicket[ticket]
        if not entry then return false, 'unknown' end
        forget(entry)
        if self.now() > entry.expires then return false, 'expired' end
        if entry.src ~= src then return false, 'source' end
        if entry.who ~= who then return false, 'character' end
        return true, entry
    end

    function t:peek(src)
        local entry = self.bySrc[src]
        return entry and entry.ticket or nil
    end

    function t:drop(src)
        local entry = self.bySrc[src]
        if entry then forget(entry) end
    end

    return t
end

CameraLogic.tickets = M
return M

local Adapter = require('server.adapter')

local function notify(src, message)
    TriggerClientEvent('secure-turn-in:client:notify', src, message)
end

local function near_turn_in(src)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if ped <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    return #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - Config.TurnIn.coords) <= Config.TurnIn.radius
end

RegisterNetEvent('secure-turn-in:server:start', function()
    local src = source
    if not Adapter.get_player(src) or not near_turn_in(src) then
        TriggerClientEvent('secure-turn-in:client:reset', src)
        return
    end
    if active_jobs[src] then
        notify(src, 'You already have an active job.')
        return
    end

    active_jobs[src] = { started_at = os.time() }
    notify(src, 'Job started. Return here after the timer.')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('secure-turn-in:server:turn_in', function()
    local src = source
    local player = Adapter.get_player(src)
    local job = active_jobs[src]
    if not player or not job or not near_turn_in(src) then
        TriggerClientEvent('secure-turn-in:client:reset', src)
        return
    end

    if os.time() - job.started_at < Config.TurnIn.minimumDurationSeconds then
        notify(src, 'The job is not complete yet.')
        return
    end

    active_jobs[src] = nil -- consume before payout: repeat events cannot pay twice
    local paid = Adapter.add_money(player, Config.TurnIn.reward, 'secure-turn-in')
    if not paid then
        notify(src, 'Payout failed. Contact staff.')
        return
    end

    notify(src, ('You received $%d.'):format(Config.TurnIn.reward))
    TriggerClientEvent('secure-turn-in:client:reset', src)
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    active_jobs[source] = nil
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        print(('[secure-turn-in] started with %s adapter'):format(Adapter.name))
    end
end)

-- Pure decision logic for nakara_cargen_fix. No natives: loadable by stock Lua 5.1+ for unit tests.
--
-- Native used by client/main.lua:
--   SET_ALL_VEHICLE_GENERATORS_ACTIVE_IN_AREA(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2, bActive, bNetworked)
-- The 8th argument is `bNetworked`, NOT "instantly" (this native has no such parameter). Passing true
-- publishes the change as network world state and allocates one CNetworkCarGenWorldStateData slot per
-- call from a pool fixed at 100 -- a re-assert loop would then fill the pool by itself. It must stay false.

local L = {}

L.DEFAULT_AREA = { -20000.0, -20000.0, -2000.0, 20000.0, 20000.0, 5000.0 }
L.DEFAULT_REASSERT_MS = 5000
L.MIN_REASSERT_MS = 1000

-- Never networked. Not configurable on purpose.
L.NETWORKED = false

--- Returns a valid area box: `area` when it is 6 numbers with min < max on every axis, else the default.
function L.resolveArea(area)
    if type(area) ~= 'table' then return L.DEFAULT_AREA end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        if type(area[i]) ~= 'number' or area[i] ~= area[i] then return L.DEFAULT_AREA end
    end
    for axis = 1, 3 do
        if area[axis] >= area[axis + 3] then return L.DEFAULT_AREA end
    end
    return { area[1], area[2], area[3], area[4], area[5], area[6] }
end

--- Returns a valid re-assert interval in ms: `ms` when it is a number >= MIN_REASSERT_MS, else the default.
function L.resolveInterval(ms)
    if type(ms) ~= 'number' or ms ~= ms or ms < L.MIN_REASSERT_MS then return L.DEFAULT_REASSERT_MS end
    return math.floor(ms)
end

--- bActive for the native: relief on -> generators inactive; relief off -> vanilla (active).
function L.activeFlag(reliefOn)
    return not reliefOn
end

--- Relief is lifted only when THIS resource stops (onResourceStop fires for every resource).
function L.shouldRestore(stoppedResource, selfResource)
    return stoppedResource == selfResource
end

CargenFixLogic = L
return L

-- client/main.lua — module-per-global: one global table, everything else local.
TemplateClient = {}

local isUiOpen = false

local function toggleUi(state)
    isUiOpen = state
    SetNuiFocus(state, state) -- Iron Rule 6: focus has a lifecycle
    SendNUIMessage({ action = state and 'open' or 'close' })
end

-- Iron Rule 6: every focus path gets a close path (ESC, button, stop, logout)
RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    toggleUi(false)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerUnload', function()
    if isUiOpen then
        toggleUi(false)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res == GetCurrentResourceName() and isUiOpen then
        toggleUi(false)
    end
end)

-- Iron Rule 3: no busy loops — adaptive wait, distance-gated work
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local wait = 1000
        local ped = PlayerPedId()
        local pos = GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local dist = #(pos - Config.Interact.coords)
        if dist < Config.Interact.radius then
            wait = 0
            -- prompt / draw marker here; request handled server-side
            if IsControlJustReleased(0, 38) then -- E
                toggleUi(true)
            end
        end
        Wait(wait)
    end
end)

-- NUI asks, server decides: forward the request, never the reward
RegisterNUICallback('claimReward', function(_, cb)
    TriggerServerEvent('template:server:claimReward')
    cb('ok')
end)

-- nakara_cargen_fix -- vehicle-generator pool relief (client-only).
--
-- Problem: the network pool CNetworkCarGenWorldStateData has a fixed size of 100. It cannot be raised: it
-- is not in gameconfig.xml <PoolSizes> and it is not on the `increase_pool_size` allow-list. On OneSync
-- maps with more than 100 vehicle generators (ambient parked cars) the pool can fill and the client logs
--     CNetworkCarGenWorldStateData Pool Full, Size == 100   (crash_hash net.dll+487A2)
-- repeatedly, which can escalate into a net.dll crash. (README: what has and has not been verified.)
--
-- Guard: disable vehicle generators map-wide, locally. No networked car-gen world state is created, so the
-- pool never fills. Player- and script-spawned vehicles are not generators and are not affected.
--
-- The decision logic lives in client/logic.lua (unit-tested); this file only calls natives.

local L = CargenFixLogic
local area = L.resolveArea(Config and Config.Area)
local reassertMs = L.resolveInterval(Config and Config.ReassertMs)

-- on = true  -> disable generators in the area
-- on = false -> restore vanilla (active) when the resource stops, so a reload does not leave them off
local function applyRelief(on)
    SetAllVehicleGeneratorsActiveInArea(
        area[1], area[2], area[3], area[4], area[5], area[6],
        L.activeFlag(on), -- bActive
        false             -- bNetworked: must never be true (allocates a slot from the fixed 100 pool per call)
    )
end

-- Relief can be paused on THIS client only (exports below), e.g. by an admin test tool that needs a
-- vanilla baseline. Never persisted: every (re)start of the resource begins with relief on.
local reliefOn = true

-- The engine re-enables generators on zone change / respawn, so re-assert periodically.
CreateThread(function()
    applyRelief(true)
    while true do
        Wait(reassertMs)
        if reliefOn then applyRelief(true) end
    end
end)

--- exports.nakara_cargen_fix:setRelief(on) -- client-side, affects only the calling client.
--- false = restore vanilla generators and stop re-asserting · true = disable them again right away.
exports('setRelief', function(on)
    reliefOn = on ~= false
    applyRelief(reliefOn)
    return reliefOn
end)

--- exports.nakara_cargen_fix:isRelief() -> boolean
exports('isRelief', function()
    return reliefOn
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if L.shouldRestore(res, GetCurrentResourceName()) then
        applyRelief(false)
    end
end)

-- server/main.lua — the server decides, the client only requests.
local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local cooldowns = {} -- src -> timestamp of last claim (rate limit)

RegisterNetEvent('template:server:claimReward', function()
    -- Iron Rule 5: capture source before any yield
    local src = source

    -- Iron Rule 1: client is never trusted — derive actor from source
    local Player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not Player then
        return
    end

    -- Rate limit: one claim per Config.Reward.cooldownMinutes
    local now = os.time()
    local last = cooldowns[src] or 0
    if now - last < Config.Reward.cooldownMinutes * 60 then
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Notify', src, 'Too soon. Come back later.', 'error')
        return
    end
    cooldowns[src] = now

    -- Iron Rule 2: one currency enum — amount comes from config, not the client
    Player.Functions.AddMoney(Config.Reward.currency, Config.Reward.amount, 'template-reward')

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Notify', src, ('You received $%d'):format(Config.Reward.amount), 'success')
end)

-- Clean up cooldowns on drop so rejoins aren't stuck
AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    cooldowns[source] = nil
end)

--[[
    Client: the panel (no NUI focus, the game keeps playing), rebindable keys and the Rockstar Editor
    natives. The recording state is read from the game (IsRecording), the panel only shows it.
]]

local abierto = false
local permitido = nil  -- nil = not asked yet
local esperando = nil  -- callback waiting for the server answer
local inicio = nil     -- GetGameTimer() when the recording started
local confirmarEditor = 0

local function textos()
    local t = {}
    for k in pairs(Locales.es) do if k:sub(1, 3) == 'ui_' then t[k] = L(k) end end
    return t
end

--- Key bound to one of our commands, as the player set it (e.g. "7"), or the config default.
local function teclaDe(comando, porDefecto)
    local boton = GetControlInstructionalButton(0, joaat(comando) | 0x80000000, true)
    if boton and boton:sub(1, 2) == 't_' then return boton:sub(3) end
    return porDefecto ~= '' and porDefecto or '—'
end

local function enviarEstado()
    if not abierto then return end
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'state', recording = IsRecording(), seconds = inicio and math.floor((GetGameTimer() - inicio) / 1000) or 0 })
end

local function abrir()
    abierto = true
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'open', texts = textos(), logo = Config.Branding.LogoUrl, position = Config.Position,
        version = GetResourceMetadata(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'version', 0),
        editor = Config.EditorButton,
        keys = {
            record = teclaDe('jvl_recorder_record', Config.Keys.record), save = teclaDe('jvl_recorder_save', Config.Keys.save),
            discard = teclaDe('jvl_recorder_discard', Config.Keys.discard), editor = teclaDe('jvl_recorder_editor', Config.Keys.editor),
        },
    })
    enviarEstado()
    CreateThread(function()
        while abierto do
            Wait(1000)
            enviarEstado()
        end
    end)
end

local function cerrar()
    abierto = false
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
end

--- Runs `fn` only when the server says this player may use the recorder (answer cached).
local function conPermiso(fn)
    if permitido ~= nil then
        if permitido then fn() else Notify(L('no_permission'), 'error') end
        return
    end
    esperando = fn
    TriggerServerEvent('jvl_recorder:permiso')
end

RegisterNetEvent('jvl_recorder:permiso', function(ok)
    permitido = ok
    local fn = esperando
    esperando = nil
    if fn then
        if ok then fn() else Notify(L('no_permission'), 'error') end
    end
end)

-- Jobs can change: ask again after a while
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(60000)
        permitido = nil
    end
end)

-- ─── ACTIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function grabar()
    if IsRecording() then return Notify(L('already'), 'info') end
    StartRecording(1) -- 1 = manual recording
    inicio = GetGameTimer()
    TriggerServerEvent('jvl_recorder:log', 'start')
    Notify(L('started'), 'success')
    enviarEstado()
end

local function guardar()
    if not IsRecording() then return Notify(L('not_recording'), 'error') end
    StopRecordingAndSaveClip()
    inicio = nil
    TriggerServerEvent('jvl_recorder:log', 'save')
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'flash', kind = 'save' })
    Notify(L('saved'), 'success')
    enviarEstado()
end

local function descartar()
    if not IsRecording() then return Notify(L('not_recording'), 'error') end
    StopRecordingAndDiscardClip()
    inicio = nil
    TriggerServerEvent('jvl_recorder:log', 'discard')
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'flash', kind = 'discard' })
    Notify(L('discarded'), 'info')
    enviarEstado()
end

local function editor()
    if not Config.EditorButton then return end
    -- Opening the editor leaves the server: ask for a second press within 4 seconds
    if GetGameTimer() > confirmarEditor then
        confirmarEditor = GetGameTimer() + 4000
        return Notify(L('editor_confirm'), 'info')
    end
    confirmarEditor = 0
    if IsRecording() then StopRecordingAndSaveClip() end
    TriggerServerEvent('jvl_recorder:log', 'editor')
    Notify(L('editor_opening'), 'info')
    cerrar()
    SetTimeout(500, function()
        NetworkSessionLeaveSinglePlayer()
        ActivateRockstarEditor()
    end)
end

-- ─── COMMANDS AND KEYS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RegisterCommand(Config.Command, function()
    if abierto then return cerrar() end
    conPermiso(abrir)
end, false)

local function tecla(nombre, accion, etiqueta, porDefecto)
    RegisterCommand(nombre, function()
        if Config.KeysOnlyWithPanel and not abierto then return end
        conPermiso(accion)
    end, false)
    RegisterKeyMapping(nombre, L(etiqueta), 'keyboard', porDefecto)
end

RegisterCommand('jvl_recorder_panel', function() ExecuteCommand(Config.Command) end, false)
RegisterKeyMapping('jvl_recorder_panel', L('key_panel'), 'keyboard', Config.Keys.panel)
tecla('jvl_recorder_record', grabar, 'key_record', Config.Keys.record)
tecla('jvl_recorder_save', guardar, 'key_save', Config.Keys.save)
tecla('jvl_recorder_discard', descartar, 'key_discard', Config.Keys.discard)
tecla('jvl_recorder_editor', editor, 'key_editor', Config.Keys.editor)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(nombre)
    if nombre ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    if IsRecording() then StopRecordingAndDiscardClip() end
end)

local Integrations = {}

local translations = {
    en = {
        title = 'Custom Plates',
        applied = { 'success', 'Registered %d plate texture replacement(s).' },
        failed = { 'error', 'Plate textures could not be loaded. See the F8 console for details.' },
        disabled = { 'info', 'Custom plate textures are disabled.' },
        stopped = { 'info', 'Custom plate textures have stopped.' },
        starting = { 'info', 'Plate textures are starting.' },
    },
    pl = {
        title = 'Tablice rejestracyjne',
        applied = { 'success', 'Zarejestrowano podmiany tekstur tablic: %d.' },
        failed = { 'error', 'Nie udało się wczytać tekstur tablic. Szczegóły w konsoli F8.' },
        disabled = { 'info', 'Podmiana tekstur tablic jest wyłączona.' },
        stopped = { 'info', 'Zatrzymano podmianę tekstur tablic.' },
        starting = { 'info', 'Trwa wczytywanie tekstur tablic.' },
    },
}

local frameworks = { auto = true, esx = true, qbcore = true, standalone = true }
local providerModes = { auto = true, framework = true, ox_lib = true, native = true }
local aliases = { ['es_extended'] = 'esx', ['qb-core'] = 'qbcore' }
local frameworkResources = { esx = 'es_extended', qbcore = 'qb-core' }
local order = { 'esx', 'qbcore' }
local duration = 4500

local providers = {
    ox_lib = function(title, message, severity)
        -- The ox_lib client registers this event. Local dispatch avoids
        -- @ox_lib/init.lua, which would make the library a hard dependency.
        local payload = { id = GetCurrentResourceName() .. ':status', title = title,
            description = message, duration = duration }
        -- Leave informational style to the library (different defaults across versions).
        if severity ~= 'info' then payload.type = severity end
        TriggerEvent('ox_lib:notify', payload)
    end,
    esx = function(title, message, severity)
        local core = exports['es_extended']:getSharedObject()
        if type(core) ~= 'table' or core.ShowNotification == nil then return false end
        -- Cfx can marshal cross-resource functions as callable tables.
        return core.ShowNotification(message, severity, duration, title)
    end,
    qbcore = function(title, message, severity)
        local core = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject({'Functions'})
        if type(core) ~= 'table' or type(core.Functions) ~= 'table'
            or core.Functions.Notify == nil then return false end
        return core.Functions.Notify({ text = message, caption = title },
            severity == 'info' and 'primary' or severity, duration)
    end,
    native = function(title, message)
        BeginTextCommandThefeedPost('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(title .. ': ' .. message)
        EndTextCommandThefeedPostTicker(false, false)
    end,
}

local function attempt(name, title, message, severity)
    local ok, result = pcall(providers[name], title, message, severity)
    return ok and result ~= false
end

function Integrations.create(config, log)
    if type(config) ~= 'table' then return nil end

    local function readOption(value, valid, default, label)
        if value == nil then return default end
        if type(value) == 'string' and valid[value] then return value end
        log(('Invalid Config.%s; using %s'):format(label, default))
        return default
    end

    local framework = readOption(aliases[config.Framework] or config.Framework, frameworks, 'auto', 'Framework')
    local mode = readOption(config.NotificationProvider, providerModes, 'auto', 'NotificationProvider')
    local locale = readOption(config.Locale, translations, 'en', 'Locale')
    local messages = translations[locale]
    local command = config.StatusCommand
    if command == nil then command = 'platestatus' end
    if command ~= false and (type(command) ~= 'string' or #command > 32 or not command:match('^[a-z0-9_%-]+$')) then
        log('Invalid Config.StatusCommand; command disabled')
        command = false
    end
    if config.NotifyOnStart ~= nil and type(config.NotifyOnStart) ~= 'boolean' then
        log('Invalid Config.NotifyOnStart; startup notifications disabled')
    end

    local function frameworkCandidates()
        local candidates = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(order) do
            if (framework == 'auto' or framework == name)
                and GetResourceState(frameworkResources[name]) == 'started' then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = name
            end
        end
        return candidates
    end

    return {
        command = command,
        notifyOnStart = config.NotifyOnStart == true,
        getFramework = function() return frameworkCandidates()[1] or 'standalone' end,
        notify = function(status, count)
            local entry = messages[status] or messages.starting
            local message = entry[2]:format(count or 0)
            local candidates = {}
            if (mode == 'auto' or mode == 'ox_lib') and GetResourceState('ox_lib') == 'started' then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = 'ox_lib'
            end
            if mode == 'auto' or mode == 'framework' then
                for _, name in ipairs(frameworkCandidates()) do candidates[#candidates + 1] = name end
            end
            candidates[#candidates + 1] = 'native'
            for _, name in ipairs(candidates) do
                if attempt(name, messages.title, message, entry[1]) then return name end
                if config.Debug == true then log('Notification provider unavailable: ' .. name) end
            end
            log(message)
            return 'console'
        end,
    }
end

CustomPlateIntegrations = Integrations

--[[
    JVL Recorder | Configuration
    Small panel to record clips with the Rockstar Editor without leaving the server: start, save, discard,
    and open the editor (that one disconnects you, it asks to press twice).

    Multiframework: Qbox, QBCore, ESX or standalone (auto-detected). No fxmanifest dependencies.
    Table (created on start): jvl_recorder_logs (only when Config.Log.database = true)
    Permission: Config.Permission.everyone = true (all players). ACE jvl_recorder.use only if everyone = false
    Convars (server only, "set"): set jvl_recorder_webhook "..."   Discord log ("" = off)
]]

Config = {}

Config.Framework = 'auto' -- 'auto' | 'qbox' | 'qb' | 'esx' | 'standalone'
Config.Locale = 'auto'    -- 'auto' (player's GTA language) | 'es' | 'en'

Config.Branding = {
    LogoUrl = 'https://r2.fivemanage.com/X1XK135fBbC6NDyRj5dwS/logomediacode.png', -- '' = icon
}

Config.Command = 'grabar' -- opens / closes the panel (was 'recorder': old ESX installs kept an F7 bind to it)

-- Keys (players can change them in Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM). '' = no default key.
Config.Keys = {
    panel   = '',   -- open / close the panel (besides /grabar)
    record  = '7',  -- start recording
    save    = '8',  -- stop and save the clip
    discard = '9',  -- stop and throw the clip away
    editor  = '0',  -- open the Rockstar Editor (press twice: it disconnects you)
}
Config.KeysOnlyWithPanel = true -- true = the record / save / discard / editor keys only work while the panel is open

-- Open the Rockstar Editor from the server (key 0). The panel shows a note: on servers with many streamed
-- resources FiveM may crash on the way to the editor, so edit the clips after closing FiveM and opening it again.
Config.EditorButton = true

-- Who can use it: ACE `jvl_recorder.use`, OR one of these jobs, OR everybody
Config.Permission = {
    everyone = true, -- everyone records: clips are saved in GTA (Rockstar Editor), nothing changes on the server
    jobs = {}, -- e.g. { 'reporter', 'weazel' }
}

Config.Position = 'bottom-right' -- 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left'

Config.Log = {
    database = true, -- jvl_recorder_logs (start / save / discard / editor)
}

-- ─── INTEGRATION ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
--- Client notification. kind: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'
function Notify(message, kind)
    if GetResourceState('jvl_notify') == 'started' then
        exports.jvl_notify:ShowNotification(kind or 'info', 'Recorder', message, 4000)
    elseif GetResourceState('ox_lib') == 'started' then
        TriggerEvent('ox_lib:notify', { title = 'Recorder', description = message, type = kind == 'info' and 'inform' or kind })
    else
        BeginTextCommandThefeedPost('STRING')
        AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(message)
        EndTextCommandThefeedPostTicker(false, true)
    end
    -- exports['okokNotify']:Alert('Recorder', message, 4000, kind or 'info')
    -- TriggerEvent('QBCore:Notify', message, kind == 'info' and 'primary' or kind, 4000)
    -- TriggerEvent('esx:showNotification', message)
    -- exports['wasabi_notify']:notify('Recorder', message, 4000, kind or 'info')
end

local config = Config
local validation = CustomPlateValidation
local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local dictionaryName = 'custom_plate_' .. resourceName
local state = { status = 'idle', replacements = {} }

local function log(message)
    print(('[%s] %s'):format(resourceName, message))
end

local integration = CustomPlateIntegrations and CustomPlateIntegrations.create(config, log)
local function notifyStatus()
    if integration then
        state.lastNotificationProvider = integration.notify(state.status, #state.replacements)
    end
end

if integration and integration.command then
    RegisterCommand(integration.command, notifyStatus, false)
end

local function notifyOnStart()
    if integration and integration.notifyOnStart and config.Enabled == true then
        notifyStatus()
    end
end

local function cleanup()
    local remaining = {}
    for index = #state.replacements, 1, -1 do
        local target = state.replacements[index]
        if not pcall(RemoveReplaceTexture, target.dictionary, target.texture) then
            remaining[#remaining + 1] = target
        end
    end
    state.replacements = remaining
    if #remaining > 0 then
        state.cleanupError = ('Could not remove %d replacement(s); reconnect the client if they persist'):format(#remaining)
        log(state.cleanupError)
    else
        state.cleanupError = nil
    end
end

local function fail(message)
    cleanup()
    state.status, state.error = 'failed', message
    log(message)
    notifyOnStart()
end

local function initialize()
    -- Both configuration and texture creation are synchronous. The queued thread
    -- can still start after a stop event, in which case it must not touch the game.
    if state.status ~= 'starting' then return end
    if not validation then
        fail('Validation script was not loaded; check fxmanifest.lua and the installed files')
        return
    end
    local settings, configError = validation.check(config, resourceName)
    if not settings then
        fail(configError)
        return
    end
    if not settings.enabled then
        state.status = 'disabled'
        log('Disabled. Set Config.Enabled = true only for in-game testing.')
        return
    end

    local stage = 'asset preflight'
    local ok, detail = pcall(function()
        for _, source in ipairs(settings.sources) do
            stage = source.name .. ' asset ' .. source.path
            local valid, imageError = validation.checkPng(LoadResourceFile(resourceName, source.path))
            if not valid then error(imageError, 0) end
        end
        stage = 'runtime texture dictionary'
        local dictionary = CreateRuntimeTxd(dictionaryName)
        if not dictionary or dictionary == 0 then error('Native returned no dictionary', 0) end

        -- Prepare all channels before modifying any texture in the game.
        for _, source in ipairs(settings.sources) do
            stage = source.name .. ' PNG decode ' .. source.path
            source.textureName = 'plate_' .. source.name
            local texture = CreateRuntimeTextureFromImage(dictionary, source.textureName, source.path)
            if not texture or texture == 0 then error('Native returned no texture', 0) end
        end
        for _, source in ipairs(settings.sources) do
            for _, target in ipairs(source.targets) do
                stage = 'replacement ' .. target.dictionary .. '/' .. target.texture
                -- Track attempts so a native exception can also roll back an earlier mutation.
                state.replacements[#state.replacements + 1] = target
                AddReplaceTexture(target.dictionary, target.texture, dictionaryName, source.textureName)
                if settings.debug then log('Registered ' .. target.dictionary .. '/' .. target.texture) end
            end
        end
    end)

    if not ok then
        local reason = type(detail) == 'string' and detail:gsub('[%c]', ' '):sub(1, 180) or 'Native error'
        fail(('Initialization failed at %s: %s'):format(stage, reason))
        return
    end
    state.status = 'applied'
    log(('Registered %d texture replacement(s); verify the result in-game'):format(#state.replacements))
    notifyOnStart()
end

AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStart', function(name)
    if name ~= resourceName or state.status ~= 'idle' then return end
    state.status = 'starting'
    CreateThread(initialize)
end)

AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStop', function(name)
    if name ~= resourceName then return end
    state.status = 'stopped'
    cleanup()
end)

local function configuredPath(pathKey, legacyKey)
    if type(config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    local value = config[pathKey]
    if value == nil then value = config[legacyKey] end
    return type(value) == 'string' and value or nil
end

exports('IsInitialized', function() return state.status == 'applied' end)
exports('GetPlateState', function()
    local diffuse = configuredPath('DiffuseImagePath', 'DiffuseImageUrl')
    local normal = configuredPath('NormalMapPath', 'NormalMapUrl')
    local applied = state.status == 'applied'
    return {
        status = state.status,
        initialized = applied,
        replacementsApplied = applied,
        diffusePath = diffuse,
        normalPath = normal,
        diffuseUrl = diffuse, -- compatibility alias; contains a local path in working configurations
        normalUrl = normal,
        initializing = state.status == 'starting',
        error = state.error,
        cleanupError = state.cleanupError,
        replacementCount = #state.replacements,
        framework = integration and integration.getFramework() or 'standalone',
        lastNotificationProvider = state.lastNotificationProvider,
    }
end)

local Validation = {}
local maxBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024
local maxPixels = 4 * 1024 * 1024
local pngSignature = '\137PNG\r\n\26\n'
local pngEnd = '\0\0\0\0IEND\174B`\130'

local channels = {
    { name = 'diffuse', path = 'DiffuseImagePath', legacy = 'DiffuseImageUrl', targets = 'PlateTextures' },
    { name = 'normal', path = 'NormalMapPath', legacy = 'NormalMapUrl', targets = 'PlateNormalTextures' },
}

local function safeIdentifier(name)
    return type(name) == 'string' and #name <= 128 and name:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_.%-]+$') ~= nil
end

local function localPng(path)
    if type(path) ~= 'string' or #path > 240 or not path:match('^assets/.+%.png$')
        or not path:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_./%-]+$') or path:find('//', 1, true) then
        return false
    end
    for part in path:gmatch('[^/]+') do
        if part == '.' or part == '..' or part:sub(-1) == '.' then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function Validation.checkPng(bytes)
    if type(bytes) ~= 'string' then return nil, 'file was not found in the client resource' end
    if #bytes > maxBytes then return nil, 'file exceeds 8 MiB' end
    if #bytes < 45 or bytes:sub(1, 8) ~= pngSignature or bytes:sub(9, 16) ~= '\0\0\0\13IHDR'
        or bytes:sub(-12) ~= pngEnd then
        return nil, 'file is not a complete PNG'
    end
    local width, height = string.unpack('>I4I4', bytes, 17)
    if width == 0 or height == 0 or width > 4096 or height > 4096 or width * height > maxPixels then
        return nil, 'PNG exceeds the supported dimensions (4096 per side, 4 Mi pixels total), or has a zero dimension'
    end
    -- The native decoder still validates the image data and creates the GPU texture.
    return true
end

function Validation.check(config, resourceName)
    if type(config) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'Config must be a table' end
    if config.Enabled ~= nil and type(config.Enabled) ~= 'boolean' then
        return nil, 'Config.Enabled must be true or false'
    end
    if config.Enabled ~= true then return { enabled = false, sources = {} } end
    if type(resourceName) ~= 'string' or not resourceName:match('^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_%-]*$') then
        return nil, 'Use a lowercase resource folder name, e.g. custom-plate'
    end
    if config.Debug ~= nil and type(config.Debug) ~= 'boolean' then
        return nil, 'Config.Debug must be true or false'
    end
    local sources, seen = {}, {}
    local total = 0
    for _, spec in ipairs(channels) do
        local path, legacy = config[spec.path], config[spec.legacy]
        if path == nil then path = legacy end
        if legacy ~= nil and legacy ~= '' and legacy ~= path then
            return nil, 'Conflicting settings: ' .. spec.path .. ' and ' .. spec.legacy
        end
        if path ~= nil and path ~= '' then
            if not localPng(path) then
                return nil, spec.path .. ' must be a local assets/ path to a .png; convert or download old remote artwork before deployment'
            end
            local entries, targets = config[spec.targets], {}
            if type(entries) ~= 'table' then return nil, spec.targets .. ' must be a non-empty array' end
            local count, highest = 0, 0
            for index, target in pairs(entries) do
                if type(index) ~= 'number' or index < 1 or index > 128 or index % 1 ~= 0 then
                    return nil, spec.targets .. ' must be a dense array of up to 128 targets'
                end
                if type(target) ~= 'table' or not safeIdentifier(target.dictionary) or not safeIdentifier(target.texture) then
                    return nil, ('%s[%d] needs a valid dictionary and texture name'):format(spec.targets, index)
                end
                local key = target.dictionary:lower() .. '\0' .. target.texture:lower()
                if seen[key] then
                    return nil, 'Duplicate texture target: ' .. target.dictionary .. '/' .. target.texture
                end
                seen[key] = true
                targets[index] = { dictionary = target.dictionary, texture = target.texture }
                count, highest = count + 1, math.max(highest, index)
            end
            if count == 0 or count ~= highest then return nil, spec.targets .. ' must be a non-empty dense array' end
            total = total + count
            if total > 128 then return nil, 'Configure at most 128 targets across both channels' end
            sources[#sources + 1] = { name = spec.name, path = path, targets = targets }
        end
    end
    if #sources == 0 then return nil, 'Configure a diffuse PNG, a normal-map PNG, or both' end
    return { enabled = true, sources = sources, debug = config.Debug == true }
end

-- The manifest executes this file before the client entry point. No module loader required.
CustomPlateValidation = Validation

--[[
    JVL TextUI - client
    exports.jvl_textui:Show(text, options)   options = { position, icon, iconColor, iconAnimation, duration }
    exports.jvl_textui:Hide()
    exports.jvl_textui:IsOpen()              -> boolean, text
    exports.jvl_textui:GetLocale()           -> 'es' | 'en' | ...

    `text` can be a string or a table of translations: { es = '[E] Abrir', en = '[E] Open' }.
    The one matching the player's language is shown (Config.Locale = 'auto').
]]

local isOpen, currentText = false, nil
local showId = 0 -- increases on every show, cancels old auto-hide timers

local positions = {
    ['left-center'] = true, ['right-center'] = true, ['top-center'] = true, ['bottom-center'] = true,
    ['top-left'] = true, ['top-right'] = true, ['bottom-left'] = true, ['bottom-right'] = true, ['center'] = true,
}

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Language (GTA V language of the player -> locales/<code>.lua)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- GetCurrentLanguage(): 0 en, 1 fr, 2 de, 3 it, 4 es, 5 pt-BR, 6 pl, 7 ru, 8 ko, 9 zh-TW, 10 ja, 11 es-MX, 12 zh-CN
local gameLanguages = { [0] = 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'es', 'pt', 'pl', 'ru', 'ko', 'zh', 'ja', 'es', 'zh' }

local function detectLocale()
    local wanted = Config.Locale
    if wanted == 'auto' then wanted = gameLanguages[GetCurrentLanguage()] or Config.FallbackLocale end
    if Locales[wanted] then return wanted end
    return Locales[Config.FallbackLocale] and Config.FallbackLocale or 'en'
end

local locale = detectLocale()

local function L(key, ...)
    local text = (Locales[locale] and Locales[locale][key]) or (Locales.en and Locales.en[key]) or key
    if select('#', ...) > 0 then return text:format(...) end
    return text
end

--- Picks the right translation when the caller sends a table of texts.
local function translate(text)
    if type(text) ~= 'table' then return text end
    return text[locale] or text[Config.FallbackLocale] or text.en or select(2, next(text))
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NUI setup (style from config.lua as CSS variables)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

local position = GetResourceKvpString('position')
if not Config.PlayersCanMove or not positions[position or ''] then position = Config.DefaultPosition end

local nuiReady = false

local function sendSetup()
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'setup',
        style = Config.Style,
        margins = Config.Margins,
        keyCaps = Config.KeyCaps,
        icon = Config.Icon,
        animation = Config.Animation,
    })
    nuiReady = true
end

CreateThread(function()
    Wait(500) -- let the NUI page load
    sendSetup()
end)

local function sound(kind)
    local s = Config.Sounds
    if not s.enabled or not s[kind] then return nil end
    return { file = s[kind], volume = s.volume, cooldown = s.cooldown }
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Show / hide
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function hide()
    if not isOpen then return end
    isOpen, currentText = false, nil
    showId = showId + 1
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'hide', sound = sound('hide') })
end

---@param text string|table Text, or { es = '...', en = '...' }
---@param options? table { position, icon, iconColor, iconAnimation, duration } or a duration in ms
local function show(text, options)
    text = translate(text)
    if type(text) ~= 'string' or text == '' then return end
    if type(options) == 'number' then options = { duration = options } end
    options = type(options) == 'table' and options or {}
    if not nuiReady then sendSetup() end

    if Config.PreventRepeat and isOpen and text == currentText then return end
    local wasOpen = isOpen
    isOpen, currentText = true, text
    showId = showId + 1
    local id = showId

    local icon = false
    if Config.Icon.enabled then
        icon = options.icon
        if icon == nil then icon = Config.Icon.default end
    end

    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'show',
        text = text,
        icon = icon or false,
        iconColor = options.iconColor or Config.Icon.color,
        iconAnimation = options.iconAnimation or Config.Icon.animation,
        position = positions[options.position or ''] and options.position or position,
        sound = not wasOpen and sound('show') or nil,
    })

    local duration = tonumber(options.duration)
    if duration and duration > 0 then
        SetTimeout(duration, function()
            if showId == id then hide() end
        end)
    end
end

local function setPosition(name)
    if not positions[name or ''] then return false end
    position = name
    SetResourceKvp('position', name)
    if isOpen then SendNUIMessage({ action = 'position', position = name }) end
    return name
end

exports('Show', show)
exports('Hide', hide)
exports('IsOpen', function() return isOpen, currentText end)
exports('GetLocale', function() return locale end)
-- ox_lib style names
exports('showTextUI', show)
exports('hideTextUI', hide)
exports('isTextUIOpen', function() return isOpen, currentText end)

RegisterNetEvent('jvl_textui:show', show) -- also usable from the server
RegisterNetEvent('jvl_textui:hide', hide)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Command
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

RegisterCommand(Config.Command, function(_, args)
    local action = args[1]
    if action == 'test' then
        show(L('test'), { duration = 5000 })
    elseif action == 'hide' then
        hide()
    elseif action == 'lang' then
        print(L('language', locale))
    elseif action == 'position' then
        if not Config.PlayersCanMove then return print(L('position_locked')) end
        local name = setPosition(args[2])
        print(name and L('position_changed', name) or L('invalid', tostring(args[2])))
        if name then
            hide()
            show(L('test'), { duration = 3000 })
        end
    else
        print(L('usage'))
    end
end, false)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then isOpen = false end
end)

local passed = 0
local function test(name, run)
    run()
    passed = passed + 1
    print('PASS ' .. name)
end

local function read(path)
    local file = assert(io.open(path, 'rb'))
    local bytes = file:read('*a')
    file:close()
    return bytes
end

local demo = read('assets/demo-plate.png')
local sourceScripts, packaged, metadata = {}, {}, {}
local manifest = {
    client_scripts = function(value) sourceScripts = value end,
    files = function(value) packaged = value end,
}
for _, key in ipairs({'fx_version', 'game', 'author', 'version', 'description', 'license'}) do
    manifest[key] = function(value) metadata[key] = value end
end
assert(loadfile('fxmanifest.lua', 't', manifest))()

local function boot(edit, options)
    options = options or {}
    local events, api, queue, logs = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local calls = {
        reads = {}, txds = 0, images = {}, added = {}, removed = {},
        commands = {}, notifications = {}, exportAttempts = {}, resources = options.resources or {},
    }
    local resource = options.resource or 'custom-plate'
    local env = setmetatable({}, {__index = _G})
    env.require = function() error('Local modules are unavailable in standalone CfxLua') end
    env.print = function(message) logs[#logs + 1] = message end
    env.GetCurrentResourceName = function() return resource end
    env.AddEventHandler = function(name, callback) events[name] = callback end
    local function record(provider, message, severity, duration, title)
        if options.broken == provider then error('Notification dependency unavailable') end
        calls.notifications[#calls.notifications + 1] = {provider, message, severity, duration, title}
    end
    local function ref(callback)
        return setmetatable({}, {__call = function(_, ...) return callback(...) end})
    end
    local external = {
        ['es_extended'] = {
            getSharedObject = function()
                calls.exportAttempts[#calls.exportAttempts + 1] = 'esx'
                if options.missingExport == 'esx' then error('No ESX export') end
                return { ShowNotification = ref(function(message, severity, duration, title)
                    return record('esx', message, severity, duration, title)
                end) }
            end,
        },
        ['qb-core'] = {
            GetCoreObject = function(_, filters)
                assert(filters[1] == 'Functions' and #filters == 1)
                calls.exportAttempts[#calls.exportAttempts + 1] = 'qbcore'
                if options.missingExport == 'qbcore' then return {} end
                return { Functions = { Notify = ref(function(payload, severity, duration)
                    return record('qbcore', payload.text, severity, duration, payload.caption)
                end) } }
            end,
        },
    }
    env.exports = setmetatable({}, {
        __call = function(_, name, callback) api[name] = callback end,
        __index = external,
    })
    env.GetResourceState = function(name) return calls.resources[name] or 'missing' end
    env.RegisterCommand = function(name, handler, restricted)
        assert(restricted == false and not calls.commands[name])
        calls.commands[name] = handler
    end
    env.TriggerEvent = function(name, payload)
        assert(name == 'ox_lib:notify' and calls.resources.ox_lib == 'started')
        assert(payload.id == resource .. ':status')
        record('ox_lib', payload.description, payload.type, payload.duration, payload.title)
    end
    local hudMessage
    env.BeginTextCommandThefeedPost = function(label) assert(label == 'STRING') end
    env.AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName = function(text) hudMessage = text end
    env.EndTextCommandThefeedPostTicker = function(first, second)
        assert(first == false and second == false)
        record('native', hudMessage)
    end
    env.CreateThread = function(fn) queue[#queue + 1] = fn end
    env.LoadResourceFile = function(name, path)
        assert(name == resource)
        calls.reads[#calls.reads + 1] = path
        if options.readFile then return options.readFile(path) end
        return demo
    end
    env.CreateRuntimeTxd = function(name)
        assert(name == 'custom_plate_' .. resource)
        calls.txds = calls.txds + 1
        if options.dictionaryFail then return 0 end
        return 123
    end
    env.CreateRuntimeTextureFromImage = function(dictionary, texture, path)
        assert(dictionary == 123)
        calls.images[#calls.images + 1] = {texture, path}
        if options.decodeFail == #calls.images then return nil end
        return 456
    end
    env.AddReplaceTexture = function(dictionary, texture, newDictionary, newTexture)
        assert(newDictionary == 'custom_plate_' .. resource)
        calls.added[#calls.added + 1] = {dictionary .. '/' .. texture, newTexture}
        if options.replaceFail == #calls.added then error('Native registration exception') end
    end
    env.RemoveReplaceTexture = function(dictionary, texture)
        calls.removed[#calls.removed + 1] = dictionary .. '/' .. texture
        if options.removeFails and options.removeFails(calls.removed) then error('Native removal exception') end
    end
    -- Load files in manifest order, in the same resource environment, without require.
    for _, file in ipairs(sourceScripts) do
        if not (options.skipValidation and file == 'script/validation.lua') then
            assert(loadfile(file, 't', env))()
        end
        if edit and file == 'config.lua' then edit(env.Config, env) end
    end
    local function run()
        while #queue > 0 do table.remove(queue, 1)() end
    end
    events.onClientResourceStart('unrelated')
    assert(api.GetPlateState().status == 'idle' and #queue == 0)
    events.onClientResourceStart(resource)
    if not options.defer then run() end
    return api, calls, events, run, logs
end

local function enabled(c)
    c.Enabled = true
    c.PlateTextures = {
        {dictionary = 'vehshare', texture = 'plate01'},
        {dictionary = 'vehshare', texture = 'plate02'},
    }
    c.PlateNormalTextures = {{dictionary = 'vehshare', texture = 'plate01_n'}}
end

local function twoChannels(c)
    enabled(c)
    c.NormalMapPath = 'assets/sub/normal.png'
end

test('manifest loads ordered client scripts and packages only local PNG assets', function()
    assert(metadata.game == 'gta5' and metadata.fx_version == 'cerulean')
    assert(metadata.version == '3.0.0-rc.2')
    assert(table.concat(sourceScripts, ',') == 'config.lua,script/validation.lua,script/integrations.lua,script/plate.lua')
    assert(#packaged == 1 and packaged[1] == 'assets/**/*.png')
    local width, height = string.unpack('>I4I4', demo, 17)
    assert(width == 540 and height == 300)
end)

test('default config is disabled and leaves the game unchanged', function()
    local api, calls = boot()
    assert(api.GetPlateState().status == 'disabled' and not api.IsInitialized())
    assert(api.GetPlateState().error == nil and #calls.reads == 0 and calls.txds == 0)
end)

test('explicitly enabled demo uses native image loading and registers five default targets', function()
    local api, calls = boot(function(c) c.Enabled = true end, {resource = 'renamed_plate_2'})
    local state = api.GetPlateState()
    assert(api.IsInitialized() and state.initialized and state.replacementsApplied and state.status == 'applied')
    assert(state.diffusePath == 'assets/demo-plate.png' and state.diffusePath == state.diffuseUrl)
    assert(state.normalPath == '' and state.normalUrl == '' and state.error == nil)
    assert(calls.txds == 1 and #calls.reads == 1 and #calls.images == 1 and #calls.added == 5)
    assert(state.replacementCount == 5 and calls.added[5][1] == 'vehshare/plate05')
    state.status = 'corrupted'
    assert(api.GetPlateState().status == 'applied')
end)

test('normal-only mode ignores diffuse targets', function()
    local api, calls = boot(function(c)
        twoChannels(c); c.DiffuseImagePath = ''; c.PlateTextures = false
    end)
    assert(api.IsInitialized() and #calls.images == 1)
    assert(calls.images[1][1] == 'plate_normal' and calls.added[1][2] == 'plate_normal')
end)

test('both channels decode once each; stop removes targets in reverse order', function()
    local api, calls, events = boot(twoChannels)
    assert(api.IsInitialized() and #calls.images == 2 and #calls.added == 3)
    events.onClientResourceStart('custom-plate')
    events.onClientResourceStop('other')
    assert(api.IsInitialized() and #calls.removed == 0)
    events.onClientResourceStop('custom-plate')

--[[
    Server: who can use the recorder (ACE / job / everyone) and the log (database + optional Discord).
]]

local webhook = GetConvar('jvl_recorder_webhook', '')

local QBCore, ESX
if Framework == 'qb' then QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()
elseif Framework == 'esx' then ESX = exports.es_extended:getSharedObject() end

local function jugador(source)
    if Framework == 'qbox' then return exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(source) end
    if Framework == 'qb' then return QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source) end
    if Framework == 'esx' then return ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source) end
end

local function trabajo(source)
    local p = jugador(source)
    if not p then return end
    if Framework == 'esx' then return p.getJob().name end
    return p.PlayerData.job and p.PlayerData.job.name
end

local function puedeUsar(source)
    if Config.Permission.everyone or IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, 'jvl_recorder.use') then return true end
    local job = trabajo(source)
    for _, j in ipairs(Config.Permission.jobs or {}) do
        if j == job then return true end
    end
    return false
end

RegisterNetEvent('jvl_recorder:permiso', function()
    local source = source
    TriggerClientEvent('jvl_recorder:permiso', source, puedeUsar(source))
end)

-- ─── LOG ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if Config.Log.database then
    CreateThread(function()
        MySQL.query.await([[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `jvl_recorder_logs` (
            `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
            `identifier` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
            `name` VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            `action` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4]])
    end)
end

local acciones = { start = true, save = true, discard = true, editor = true }
local ultimo = {} -- [source] = GetGameTimer(), simple anti spam

RegisterNetEvent('jvl_recorder:log', function(accion)
    local source = source
    if not acciones[accion] or not puedeUsar(source) then return end
    local ahora = GetGameTimer()
    if ultimo[source] and ahora - ultimo[source] < 1000 then return end
    ultimo[source] = ahora

    local nombre = GetPlayerName(source) or '?'
    local id = GetPlayerIdentifierByType(source, 'license') or '?'
    if Config.Log.database then
        MySQL.insert('INSERT INTO `jvl_recorder_logs` (`identifier`, `name`, `action`) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', { id, nombre:sub(1, 60), accion })
    end
    if webhook ~= '' then
        PerformHttpRequest(webhook, function() end, 'POST', json.encode({ username = 'JVL Recorder', embeds = { {
            title = 'Recorder: ' .. accion, description = ('%s (%s)'):format(nombre, source), color = 3447003,
            footer = { text = os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') },
        } } }), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() ultimo[source] = nil end)

--[[
    Shared: framework detection and translations.
]]

local frameworks = { { name = 'qbox', resource = 'qbx_core' }, { name = 'qb', resource = 'qb-core' }, { name = 'esx', resource = 'es_extended' } }

Framework = Config.Framework
if Framework == 'auto' then
    Framework = 'standalone'
    for _, f in ipairs(frameworks) do
        if GetResourceState(f.resource) == 'started' then Framework = f.name break end
    end
end

-- Client: the player's GTA language. Server: Spanish for console messages.
local locale = Config.Locale
if locale == 'auto' then
    if IsDuplicityVersion() then locale = 'es'
    else
        local gameLanguages = { [0] = 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'es', 'pt', 'pl', 'ru', 'ko', 'zh', 'ja', 'es', 'zh' }
        locale = gameLanguages[GetCurrentLanguage()] or 'en'
    end
end
if not Locales[locale] then locale = 'en' end

function L(key, ...)
    local text = (Locales[locale] and Locales[locale][key]) or (Locales.es and Locales.es[key]) or key
    if select('#', ...) > 0 then return text:format(...) end
    return text
end

-- add text entries for all the help types we have
AddTextEntry('FOUNTAIN_HELP', 'This fountain currently contains $~1~.~n~Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to obtain $~1~.~n~Press ~INPUT_DETONATE~ to place $~1~.')
AddTextEntry('FOUNTAIN_HELP_DRAINED', 'This fountain currently contains $~1~.~n~Press ~INPUT_DETONATE~ to place $~1~.')
AddTextEntry('FOUNTAIN_HELP_BROKE', 'This fountain currently contains $~1~.~n~Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to obtain $~1~.')
AddTextEntry('FOUNTAIN_HELP_BROKE_N_DRAINED', 'This fountain currently contains $~1~.')
AddTextEntry('FOUNTAIN_HELP_INUSE', 'This fountain currently contains $~1~.~n~You can use it again in ~a~.')

-- upvalue aliases so that we will be fast if far away
local Wait = Wait
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local PlayerPedId = PlayerPedId

-- timer, don't tick as frequently if we're far from any money fountain
local relevanceTimer = 500

CreateThread(function()
    local pressing = false

    while true do
        Wait(relevanceTimer)

        local coords = GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId())

        for _, data in pairs(moneyFountains) do
            -- if we're near this fountain
            local dist = #(coords - data.coords)

            -- near enough to draw
            if dist < 40 then
                -- ensure per-frame tick
                relevanceTimer = 0

                DrawMarker(29, data.coords.x, data.coords.y, data.coords.z, 0, 0, 0, 0.0, 0, 0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0, 150, 0, 120, false, true, 2, false, nil, nil, false)
            else
                -- put the relevance timer back to the way it was
                relevanceTimer = 500
            end

            -- near enough to use
            if dist < 1 then
                -- are we able to use it? if not, display appropriate help
                local player = LocalPlayer
                local nextUse = player.state['fountain_nextUse']

                -- GetNetworkTime is synced for everyone
                if nextUse and nextUse >= GetNetworkTime() then
                    BeginTextCommandDisplayHelp('FOUNTAIN_HELP_INUSE')
                    AddTextComponentInteger(GlobalState['fountain_' .. data.id])
                    AddTextComponentSubstringTime(math.tointeger(nextUse - GetNetworkTime()), 2 | 4) -- seconds (2), minutes (4)
                    EndTextCommandDisplayHelp(0, false, false, 1000)
                else
                    -- handle inputs for pickup/place
                    if not pressing then
                        if IsControlPressed(0, 38 --[[ INPUT_PICKUP ]]) then
                            TriggerServerEvent('money_fountain:tryPickup', data.id)
                            pressing = true
                        elseif IsControlPressed(0, 47 --[[ INPUT_DETONATE ]]) then
                            TriggerServerEvent('money_fountain:tryPlace', data.id)
                            pressing = true
                        end
                    else
                        if not IsControlPressed(0, 38 --[[ INPUT_PICKUP ]]) and 
                           not IsControlPressed(0, 47 --[[ INPUT_DETONATE ]]) then
                            pressing = false
                        end
                    end

                    -- decide the appropriate help message
                    local youCanSpend = (player.state['money_cash'] or 0) >= data.amount
                    local fountainCanSpend = GlobalState['fountain_' .. data.id] >= data.amount

                    local helpName

                    if youCanSpend and fountainCanSpend then
                        helpName = 'FOUNTAIN_HELP'
                    elseif youCanSpend and not fountainCanSpend then
                        helpName = 'FOUNTAIN_HELP_DRAINED'
                    elseif not youCanSpend and fountainCanSpend then
                        helpName = 'FOUNTAIN_HELP_BROKE'
                    else
                        helpName = 'FOUNTAIN_HELP_BROKE_N_DRAINED'
                    end

                    -- and print it
                    BeginTextCommandDisplayHelp(helpName)
                    AddTextComponentInteger(GlobalState['fountain_' .. data.id])

                    if fountainCanSpend then
                        AddTextComponentInteger(data.amount)
                    end

                    if youCanSpend then
                        AddTextComponentInteger(data.amount)
                    end

                    EndTextCommandDisplayHelp(0, false, false, 1000)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

--[[
    JVL Skillcheck (client). Same API as lib.skillCheck:
        local ok = exports.jvl_skillcheck:SkillCheck({ 'easy', 'medium' }, { 'w', 'a' })
]]

local activo = nil -- promise of the running skill check

local function depurar(mensaje, ...)
    if Config.Debug then print(('^3[jvl_skillcheck]^7 ' .. mensaje):format(...)) end
end

--- Turns 'easy' / { areaSize, speedMultiplier } (or a list of them) into a list of rounds.
local function normalizarRondas(dificultad)
    if type(dificultad) ~= 'table' or dificultad.areaSize then dificultad = { dificultad } end
    local rondas = {}
    for _, ronda in ipairs(dificultad) do
        local datos = type(ronda) == 'string' and Config.Difficulties[ronda] or ronda
        if type(datos) ~= 'table' then datos = Config.Difficulties.easy end
        rondas[#rondas + 1] = {
            areaSize = tonumber(datos.areaSize) or 50,
            speedMultiplier = tonumber(datos.speedMultiplier) or 1.0,
        }
    end
    return rondas
end

--- Runs the skill check. Blocks until it ends and returns true on success.
---@param dificultad string|table
---@param teclas? string[]
---@return boolean|nil
local function skillCheck(dificultad, teclas)
    if activo then return nil end
    activo = promise.new()

    local rondas = normalizarRondas(dificultad or 'easy')
    local lista = {}
    for _, tecla in ipairs(teclas or Config.DefaultKeys) do lista[#lista + 1] = tostring(tecla):lower() end
    if #lista == 0 then lista = { 'e' } end

    depurar('start: %s rounds, keys %s', #rondas, table.concat(lista, ','))
    SetNuiFocus(true, false)
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'start',
        rounds = rondas,
        keys = lista,
        baseTurnTime = Config.BaseTurnTime,
        position = Config.Position,
    })

    local resultado = Citizen.Await(activo)
    return resultado
end

--- Cancels the running skill check (counts as a fail).
local function cancelar()
    if activo then SendNUIMessage({ action = 'cancel' }) end
end

RegisterNUICallback('finish', function(datos, cb)
    cb(1)
    if not activo then return end
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    local exito = datos and datos.success == true
    if Config.Sounds then
        PlaySoundFrontend(-1, exito and 'PICK_UP' or 'CHECKPOINT_MISSED', 'HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET', true)
    end
    depurar('finish: %s', tostring(exito))
    local promesa = activo
    activo = nil
    promesa:resolve(exito)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('roundOk', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    if Config.Sounds then PlaySoundFrontend(-1, 'NAV_UP_DOWN', 'HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET', true) end
end)

exports('SkillCheck', skillCheck)
exports('Cancel', cancelar)
exports('IsActive', function() return activo ~= nil end)

-- Never leave the NUI focused if the resource restarts mid check.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(recurso)
    if recurso == GetCurrentResourceName() and activo then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
end)

if Config.TestCommand then
    RegisterCommand(Config.TestCommand, function(_, args)
        local dificultad = args[1] or 'easy'
        local veces = tonumber(args[2]) or 3
        local lista = {}
        for i = 1, veces do lista[i] = dificultad end
        local ok = skillCheck(lista, { 'w', 'a', 's', 'd' })
        print(('[jvl_skillcheck] result: %s'):format(tostring(ok)))
    end, false)
end

Config.Position = 'center'

-- Test command (false to disable): /testskill [easy|medium|hard] [rounds]
Config.TestCommand = 'testskill'

-- define the money fountain list (SHARED SCRIPT)
moneyFountains = {}

-- index to know what to remove
local fountainIdx = 1

AddEventHandler('getMapDirectives', function(add)
    -- add a 'money_fountain' map directive
    add('money_fountain', function(state, name)
        return function(data)
            local coords = data[1]
            local amount = data.amount or 100

            local idx = fountainIdx
            fountainIdx += 1

            moneyFountains[idx] = {
                id = name,
                coords = coords,
                amount = amount
            }

            state.add('idx', idx)
        end
    end, function(state)
        moneyFountains[state.idx] = nil
    end)
end)

-- track down what we've added to global state
local sentState = {}

-- money system
local ms = exports['money']

-- get the fountain content from storage
local function getMoneyForId(fountainId)
    return GetResourceKvpInt(('money:%s'):format(fountainId)) / 100.0
end

-- set the fountain content in storage + state
local function setMoneyForId(fountainId, money)
    GlobalState['fountain_' .. fountainId] = math.tointeger(money)

    return SetResourceKvpInt(('money:%s'):format(fountainId), math.tointeger(money * 100.0))
end

-- get the nearest fountain to the player + ID
local function getMoneyFountain(id, source)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(source))

    for _, v in pairs(moneyFountains) do
        if v.id == id then
            if #(v.coords - coords) < 2.5 then
                return v
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- generic function for events
local function handleFountainStuff(source, id, pickup)
    -- if near the fountain we specify
    local fountain = getMoneyFountain(id, source)

    if fountain then
        -- and we can actually use the fountain already
        local player = Player(source)

        local nextUse = player.state['fountain_nextUse']
        if not nextUse then
            nextUse = 0
        end

        -- GetGameTimer ~ GetNetworkTime on client
        if nextUse <= GetGameTimer() then
            -- not rate limited
            local success = false
            local money = getMoneyForId(fountain.id)

            -- decide the op
            if pickup then
                -- if the fountain is rich enough to get the per-use amount
                if money >= fountain.amount then
                    -- give the player money
                    if ms:addMoney(source, 'cash', fountain.amount) then
                        money -= fountain.amount
                        success = true
                    end
                end
            else
                -- if the player is rich enough
                if ms:removeMoney(source, 'cash', fountain.amount) then
                    -- add to the fountain
                    money += fountain.amount
                    success = true
                end
            end

            -- save it and set the player's cooldown
            if success then
                setMoneyForId(fountain.id, money)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(500)

        for _, fountain in pairs(moneyFountains) do
            if not sentState[fountain.id] then
                GlobalState['fountain_' .. fountain.id] = math.tointeger(getMoneyForId(fountain.id))

local progressActive = false -- varible to see if there is a progressbar active
local cancelRequested = false -- set by the cancelProgressbar export
local cancelKey = 322 -- ESC key

-- Controls blocked by each `disable` option.
local blockedControls = {
    move = { 21, 22, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 44 },             -- Sprint, jump, walk, duck, cover
    car = { 59, 60, 63, 64, 71, 72, 75, 76 },                      -- Steer, accelerate, brake, exit, handbrake
    combat = { 24, 25, 37, 45, 47, 58, 140, 141, 142, 143, 257, 263, 264 }, -- Attack, aim, weapon wheel, reload, melee
    mouse = { 1, 2, 106 },                                         -- Look around
}

--- Blocks the controls of every enabled option for this frame.
---@param disable table { move?, car?, combat?, mouse? }
local function blockControls(disable)
    for option, controls in pairs(blockedControls) do
        if disable[option] then
            for _, control in ipairs(controls) do DisableControlAction(0, control, true) end
        end
    end
    if disable.combat then DisablePlayerFiring(PlayerId(), true) end
end

-- Función principal de la barra de progreso
---@param disable? table { move?, car?, combat?, mouse? } What the player cannot do while the bar runs (defaults to Config.Default.disable).
function startProgressbar(duration, text, animDict, animName, onFinish, onCancel, disable)
    disable = disable or Config.Default.disable or {}
    if progressActive then   -- if there is a progressbar active
        if Config.Debug then -- if debug is enabled
            print("^3[JVL Progressbar] There's an active bar^7")
        end
        return 
    end

    local time = duration or Config.Default.duration -- duration of the progressbar
    local label = text or Config.Default.text -- text of the progressbar
    progressActive = true -- set the progressbar as active
    cancelRequested = false
    local canceled = false -- if the progressbar was canceled

    if Config.Debug then -- if debug is enabled
        print("^2[JVL Progressbar] Iniciando: " .. label .. " (" .. time .. "ms)^7") -- print the progressbar info
    end

    -- Load animation if specified
    if animDict and animName then -- if animation is specified
        RequestAnimDict(animDict) 
        local timeout = GetGameTimer() + 3000 -- timeout for animation to load
        while not HasAnimDictLoaded(animDict) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do  -- wait for animation to load
            Wait(10)  
        end
        
        if HasAnimDictLoaded(animDict) then -- if animation loaded successfully
            TaskPlayAnim(PlayerPedId(), animDict, animName, 8.0, 8.0, -1, 1, 0, false, false, false) -- play animation
        end
    end

    -- Send data to the NUI_status
    SendNUIMessage({ -- send data to the NUI
        type = "progressbar",   -- type of message
        action = "start",       -- action to perform
        time = time,            -- time of the progressbar
        text = label,           -- text of the progressbar
        style = Config.Style    -- style of the progressbar
    })

    -- Cancel progressbar if ESC key is pressed 
    CreateThread(function() 
        local startTime = GetGameTimer() -- get start time
        
        while progressActive do -- while progressbar is active
            -- Verificar cancelación (ESC or cancelProgressbar export)
            if IsControlJustReleased(0, cancelKey) or cancelRequested then -- if ESC key is pressed
                canceled = true      -- set canceled to true
                if Config.Debug then -- if debug is enabled
                    print("^1[JVL Progressbar] Cancel for user^7") -- print message
                end
                break -- break the loop
            end
            
            -- Verificar si terminó el tiempo
            if GetGameTimer() - startTime >= time then -- if time is over
                if Config.Debug then -- if debug is enabled
                    print("^2[JVL Progressbar] Completado^7") 
                end
                break -- break the loop
            end

            blockControls(disable)
            Wait(0)
        end

        progressActive = false -- set progressActive to false
        
        -- Limpiar animación
        if animDict and animName then -- if animation is specified
            ClearPedTasks(PlayerPedId()) 
            RemoveAnimDict(animDict) 
        end

        -- Cerrar interfaz
        SendNUIMessage({ -- send data to the NUI
            type = "progressbar", -- type of message
            action = "stop" -- action to perform
        })
        
        Wait(100)

        -- Ejecutar callbacks
        if canceled and onCancel then -- if canceled and onCancel is specified
            onCancel() 
        elseif not canceled and onFinish then -- if not canceled and onFinish is specified
            onFinish() 
        end 
    end)
end

-- Event to iniciate the progressbar
RegisterNetEvent('jvl_progressbar:start', function(text, duration) -- event to iniciate the progressbar
    startProgressbar(duration, text) -- call the function
end)

-- Export function to start the progressbar
exports('startProgressbar', function(duration, text, animDict, animName, onFinish, onCancel, disable) -- export function to start the progressbar
    startProgressbar(duration, text, animDict, animName, onFinish, onCancel, disable) -- call the function
end)

-- Cancels the running progressbar from another script (its onCancel callback runs).
exports('cancelProgressbar', function()
    if progressActive then cancelRequested = true end
end)

-- True while a progressbar is running.
exports('isProgressActive', function() return progressActive end)

-- Display only (no controls, no animation, no timer): used by ox_lib's lib.progressBar,
-- which keeps its own logic and only asks us to draw the bar.
exports('ShowBar', function(text, duration)
    SendNUIMessage({ type = 'progressbar', action = 'start', time = duration or Config.Default.duration, text = text or Config.Default.text, style = Config.Style })
end)

exports('HideBar', function(cancelled)
    SendNUIMessage({ type = 'progressbar', action = cancelled and 'cancel' or 'stop' })
end)

-- Command to test the progressbar
RegisterCommand('testprogress', function(source, args) 
    local duration = tonumber(args[1]) or 3000 -- default duration is 3000ms
    local text = table.concat(args, " ", 2) or "Test progressbar" -- default text is "Prueba de barra"
    
    startProgressbar(duration, text, nil, nil, function() 
        print("^2Prueba completada!^7") --  print when the progressbar is finished
    end, function() 
        print("^1Prueba cancelada!^7") -- print when the progressbar is canceled
    end)
end, false)

local playerData = exports['cfx.re/playerData.v1alpha1']

local validMoneyTypes = {
    bank = true,
    cash = true,
}

local function getMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType)
    return GetResourceKvpInt(('money:%s:%s'):format(playerId, moneyType)) / 100.0
end

local function setMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType, money)
    local s = playerData:getPlayerById(playerId)

    TriggerEvent('money:updated', {
        dbId = playerId,
        source = s,
        moneyType = moneyType,
        money = money
    })

    return SetResourceKvpInt(('money:%s:%s'):format(playerId, moneyType), math.tointeger(money * 100.0))
end

local function addMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType, amount)
    local curMoney = getMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType)
    curMoney += amount

    if curMoney >= 0 then
        setMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType, curMoney)
        return true, curMoney
    end

    return false, 0
end

exports('addMoney', function(playerIdx, moneyType, amount)
    amount = tonumber(amount)

    if amount <= 0 or amount > (1 << 30) then
        return false
    end

    if not validMoneyTypes[moneyType] then
        return false
    end

    local playerId = playerData:getPlayerId(playerIdx)
    local success, money = addMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType, amount)

    if success then
        Player(playerIdx).state['money_' .. moneyType] = money
    end

    return true
end)

exports('removeMoney', function(playerIdx, moneyType, amount)
    amount = tonumber(amount)

    if amount <= 0 or amount > (1 << 30) then
        return false
    end

    if not validMoneyTypes[moneyType] then
        return false
    end

    local playerId = playerData:getPlayerId(playerIdx)
    local success, money = addMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType, -amount)

    if success then
        Player(playerIdx).state['money_' .. moneyType] = money
    end

    return success
end)

exports('getMoney', function(playerIdx, moneyType)
    local playerId = playerData:getPlayerId(playerIdx)
    return getMoneyForId(playerId, moneyType)
end)

-- player display bits
AddEventHandler('money:updated', function(data)
    if data.source then
        TriggerClientEvent('money:displayUpdate', data.source, data.moneyType, data.money)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('money:requestDisplay')

AddEventHandler('money:requestDisplay', function()
    local source = source
    local playerId = playerData:getPlayerId(source)

    for type, _ in pairs(validMoneyTypes) do
        local amount = getMoneyForId(playerId, type)
        TriggerClientEvent('money:displayUpdate', source, type, amount)

        Player(source).state['money_' .. type] = amount
    end
end)

RegisterCommand('earn', function(source, args)
    local type = args[1]
    local amount = tonumber(args[2])

    exports['money']:addMoney(source, type, amount)
end, true)

RegisterCommand('spend', function(source, args)
    local type = args[1]

--[[
    Client: buyer NPCs, blips, target and the sale panel.
]]

local peds = {}
local current = nil -- buyer index while the panel is open

local function handle(result)
    result = result or { ok = false, msg = 'err_generic' }
    if result.msg then Notify(L(result.msg, table.unpack(result.args or {})), result.ok and 'success' or 'error') end
    return result
end

local function open(index)
    if current then return end
    local result = handle(lib.callback.await('jvl_sales:open', false, index))
    if not result.ok then return end
    current = index
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'open', data = result.data, image = Config.ImagePath,
        logo = Config.LogoUrl or '', icon = Config.Icon or 'fa-solid fa-recycle',
        version = GetResourceMetadata(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'version', 0),
        texts = {
            title = L('ui_title'), have = L('ui_have'), each = L('ui_each'), total = L('ui_total'), sell = L('ui_sell'),
            all = L('ui_all'), none = L('ui_none'), close = L('ui_close'), cash = L('ui_cash'), bank = L('ui_bank'),
        },
    })
end

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    current = nil
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('sell', function(data, cb)
    if not current then return cb({ ok = false }) end
    local result = handle(lib.callback.await('jvl_sales:sell', false, current, data.cart))
    if result.ok then
        -- Refresh what is left in the inventory
        local fresh = lib.callback.await('jvl_sales:open', false, current)
        if fresh and fresh.ok then SendNUIMessage({ action = 'update', data = fresh.data }) end
    end
    cb(result)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local target = Config.Target
    if target == 'auto' then
        target = GetResourceState('ox_target') == 'started' and 'ox_target' or GetResourceState('qb-target') == 'started' and 'qb-target' or nil
    end

    for index, buyer in ipairs(Config.Buyers) do
        local c = buyer.ped.coords
        local hash = joaat(buyer.ped.model)
        if pcall(lib.requestModel, hash, 10000) then
            local ped = CreatePed(4, hash, c.x, c.y, c.z - 1.0, c.w, false, true)
            SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
            FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
            SetEntityInvincible(ped, true)
            SetBlockingOfNonTemporaryEvents(ped, true)
            if buyer.ped.scenario then TaskStartScenarioInPlace(ped, buyer.ped.scenario, 0, true) end
            peds[#peds + 1] = ped
            local onSelect = function() open(index) end
            if target == 'ox_target' then
                exports.ox_target:addLocalEntity(ped, { { name = 'jvl_sales:' .. index, label = L('target_sell'), icon = 'fa-solid fa-dollar-sign', distance = Config.TargetDistance, onSelect = onSelect } })
            elseif target == 'qb-target' then
                exports['qb-target']:AddTargetEntity(ped, { options = { { label = L('target_sell'), icon = 'fa-solid fa-dollar-sign', action = onSelect } }, distance = Config.TargetDistance })
            end
        end

        if buyer.blip then
            local blip = AddBlipForCoord(c.x, c.y, c.z)
            SetBlipSprite(blip, buyer.blip.sprite or 365)
            SetBlipColour(blip, buyer.blip.colour or 2)
            SetBlipScale(blip, buyer.blip.scale or 0.8)
            SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, true)
            BeginTextCommandSetBlipName('STRING')
            AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(buyer.label)
            EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    for _, ped in ipairs(peds) do
        if DoesEntityExist(ped) then DeleteEntity(ped) end
    end
    if current then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
end)
