local goods = {}

local function say(src, text, kind) exports.whip_core:NotifyPlayer(src, text, kind or 'info') end

local function priceAt(_, item)
    local p = tonumber(Prices[item])
    return p and p >= 0 and math.floor(p) or nil
end

local function nameOf(item)
    local def = exports.whip_core:GetItemDef(item)
    return def and def.name or item
end

local function inStore(src, storeKey)
    local st = Rooms.store(storeKey)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not st or ped == 0 then return false end
    local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    return #(c - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) <= 15.0
end

local function priced(b)
    local lines, total, count = {}, 0, 0
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do
        local price = priceAt(b.store, item)
        if price then
            lines[#lines + 1] = { item = item, qty = qty, price = price }
            total = total + price * qty
            count = count + qty
        end
    end
    table.sort(lines, function(a, c) return a.item < c.item end)
    return lines, total, count
end

local TAG = 'basket'
local FULL_TAG = GetCurrentResourceName() .. ':' .. TAG

local function holdBasket(src)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B or not B.model then return end
    local ok, why = exports.whip_core:HoldProps(src, { { model = B.model, bone = B.bone, offset = B.offset, rot = B.rot } }, TAG)
    if not ok then print(('^3[pure-247] basket not put in the hand: %s^7'):format(tostring(why))) end
end

local HANDS_TAG = 'hands'
local FULL_HANDS = GetCurrentResourceName() .. ':' .. HANDS_TAG

local function units(b)
    local n = 0
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do n = n + qty * (Goods.isBig(item) and 2 or 1) end
    return n
end

local function handsOf(lines)
    local list = {}
    for item, qty in pairs(lines) do for _ = 1, qty do list[#list + 1] = item end end
    table.sort(list)
    if list[1] and Goods.isBig(list[1]) then return { right = list[1] } end
    return { left = list[1], right = list[2] }
end

local function holdHeld(src, held)
    local props = {}
    for _, hand in ipairs({ 'left', 'right' }) do
        local h = held[hand] and Goods.hold(held[hand], hand)
        if h then props[#props + 1] = h end
    end
    if #props > 0 then exports.whip_core:HoldProps(src, props, HANDS_TAG)
    elseif exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == FULL_HANDS then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, HANDS_TAG) end

    local fists = (held.left and 'L' or '') .. (held.right and 'R' or '')
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:fists', fists ~= '' and fists or nil, true)
end

local function holdHands(src, b) holdHeld(src, handsOf(b.lines)) end

local function letGoBasket(src)
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:fists', nil, true)
    local tag = exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src)
    if tag == FULL_TAG then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, TAG)
    elseif tag == FULL_HANDS then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, HANDS_TAG) end
end

local function finishAfter(src)
    local a = after[src]
    if not a then return end
    after[src] = nil
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', nil, true)
    letGoBasket(src)
end

local function showList(src)
    if not S.showList then return end
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) return end
    local lines, total = priced(b)
    local parts = {}
    for i, l in ipairs(lines) do
        if i > 4 then parts[#parts + 1] = ('+%d more'):format(#lines - 4) break end
        parts[#parts + 1] = ('%d× %s'):format(l.qty, nameOf(l.item))
    end
    local row = #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, '  ·  ') or 'empty: take goods off the racks'
    exports.whip_core:ShowPlayerText(src, ('%s  $%d | %s'):format(b.hand and 'In your hands' or 'Basket', total, row),
        { position = 'top', icon = 'pickup' })
end

local function syncGoods(src)
    local b = baskets[src]
    local list = nil
    if b and not b.hand then
        list = {}
        for item in pairs(b.lines) do list[#list + 1] = item end
        table.sort(list)
    end
    Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', list, true)
end

local function dropBasket(src, why)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then return end
    baskets[src] = nil
    syncGoods(src)
    if clerkPts[src] then RefreshClerk(src) end
    letGoBasket(src)
    if S.showList then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) end
    if why then say(src, why) end
end

local function listOf(lines)
    local parts = {}
    for i, l in ipairs(lines) do
        if i > 4 then parts[#parts + 1] = ('+%d more'):format(#lines - 4) break end
        parts[#parts + 1] = ('%d× %s'):format(l.qty, nameOf(l.item))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, ', ')
end

local function steal(src, b)
    local lines = priced(b)
    baskets[src] = nil
    syncGoods(src)
    if clerkPts[src] then RefreshClerk(src) end
    letGoBasket(src)
    if S.showList then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) end
    if #lines == 0 then return end
    local kept = {}
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
        if exports.whip_core:AddItem(src, l.item, l.qty, nil, { reason = '24/7 shoplifted', noDrop = true }) then
            kept[#kept + 1] = l
        end
    end
    if #kept == 0 then
        say(src, 'Your pockets are full: what you took went back on the shelves')
        return
    end
    CreateThread(function()
        Whip.core:LogActivity(src, 'pure-247_shoplift', { detail = ('%s: %d lines'):format(b.store, #kept) })
    end)
    local what = listOf(kept)
    local mode = ClerkReact(b.store, src, what)
    local P = Config.Shoplift.police
    if P and math.random() < (tonumber(P.chance) or 0) then
        Police.call(b.store, 'theft', (mode == 'chase' and 'The clerk is chasing someone who left without paying: '
            or 'The clerk saw someone leave without paying: ') .. what, P.delay and P.delay[mode] or 10)
    end
end

local pay

local function tillLabel(b)
    local _, total, count = priced(b)
    return ('Pay $%d · %d item%s'):format(total, count, count == 1 and '' or 's')
end

local function clerkMenu(src, store)
    local b = baskets[src]
    local opts, label = {}, 'Clerk'
    if b and b.store == store and next(b.lines) then
        label = tillLabel(b)
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'cash', label = 'Pay in cash' }
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'bank', label = 'Pay by card' }
        opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'empty', label = 'Put it all back' }
    end
    local brands = ClerkCounter and ClerkCounter() or {}
    if #brands > 0 then opts[#opts + 1] = { id = 'cigs', label = 'Ask for cigarettes', options = brands } end
    return label, opts
end

function RefreshClerk(src, store)
    local cur = clerkPts[src]
    store = store or (cur and cur.store)
    if not store then return end
    local clerk = Clerks and Clerks[store]
    local netId = clerk and clerk.netId and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(clerk.netId) ~= 0 and clerk.netId or nil
    local label, opts = clerkMenu(src, store)
    if cur and cur.store == store and cur.netId == netId and cur.pointId then
        exports.whip_core:UpdatePoint(cur.pointId, { label = label, options = opts })
        return
    end
    if cur and cur.pointId then exports.whip_core:RemovePoint(cur.pointId) end
    clerkPts[src] = nil
    local where
    if netId then
        where = { netId = netId, offset = vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.15) }
    else
        local at = Rooms.at(store, 'pay')
        if not at then return end
        where = { coords = at }
    end
    local id, why = exports.whip_core:AddPoint({
        at = where, label = label, talk = true, options = opts,
        audience = { people = { src } }, reach = 2.5, seeFrom = 8.0,
        onUse = function(source, use)
            if (use.path or ''):sub(1, 5) == 'cigs/' then return ClerkAsk(source, store, use.option) end
            return pay(source, use.option)
        end,
    })
    if id then clerkPts[src] = { store = store, pointId = id, netId = netId }
    else print(('^3[pure-247] clerk prompt not made: %s^7'):format(tostring(why))) end
end

local function dropClerk(src)
    local cur = clerkPts[src]
    if cur and cur.pointId then exports.whip_core:RemovePoint(cur.pointId) end
    clerkPts[src] = nil
end

function StoreClosed(store)
    for src, b in pairs(baskets) do
        if b.store == store then dropBasket(src, 'The clerk is down: the store is closed') end
    end
    for src, cur in pairs(clerkPts) do
        if cur.store == store then dropClerk(src) end
    end
end

local function showTill(src)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if b then RefreshClerk(src, b.store) end
end

pay = function(src, option)
    local b = baskets[src]
    if not b then return false, 'Your basket is empty' end
    if not StoreOpen(b.store) then return false, 'The store is closed: the clerk is down' end
    if option == 'empty' then
        dropBasket(src, 'You put everything back on the shelves')
        return true
    end
    local lines, total = priced(b)
    if #lines == 0 then dropBasket(src) return false, 'Nothing in your basket is for sale any more' end
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
        local fits, why = exports.whip_core:CanFitItem(src, l.item, l.qty)
        if not fits then return false, ('No room for %d %s: %s'):format(l.qty, nameOf(l.item), why or 'your pockets are full') end
    end
    local me = exports.whip_core:GetPlayer(src)
    local session = me and me.session
    local receipt, why = exports.whip_core:ChargePlayer(src, total, {
        method = option == 'bank' and 'bank' or 'cash', reason = ('24/7: %d items'):format(#lines),
    })
    if not receipt then return false, why end

    if not exports.whip_core:IsSessionCurrent(src, session) then
        exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt)
        return false, 'That did not go through'
    end

    local undelivered, bought = 0, {}
    for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
        local where = exports.whip_core:AddItem(src, l.item, l.qty, nil, { reason = '24/7 shelf purchase', noDrop = true })
        if where then
            bought[#bought + 1] = { itemKey = l.item, price = l.price, amount = l.qty }
        else
            undelivered = undelivered + l.price * l.qty
        end
    end
    if undelivered > 0 then exports.whip_core:RefundPlayer(receipt, undelivered) end
    local store = b.store

    local count, list = 0, {}
    for item, qty in pairs(b.lines) do count = count + qty list[#list + 1] = item end
    table.sort(list)
    baskets[src] = nil
    if clerkPts[src] then RefreshClerk(src) end
    if S.showList then exports.whip_core:HidePlayerText(src) end
    local held = b.hand and handsOf(b.lines) or nil
    after[src] = { store = store, hand = b.hand, list = list, held = held, stuffs = math.min(count, 4),
                   untilMs = GetGameTimer() + 40000 }
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:paid', src, { store = store, hand = b.hand == true, stuffs = math.min(count, 4),
        left = held and held.left ~= nil, right = held and held.right ~= nil })
    say(src, ('Paid $%d. Thanks for shopping at 24/7!'):format(total - undelivered), 'success')
    CreateThread(function()
        Whip.core:LogActivity(src, 'pure-247_shelf_purchase', { detail = ('%s: $%d'):format(store, total - undelivered) })
    end)

    TriggerEvent('pure-247:purchased', {
        source = src, shopKey = 'pure-247_' .. store, store = store, paymentMethod = receipt.method, items = bought,
    })
    return true
end

function AddToTab(src, store, item, checkOnly)
    local price = priceAt(store, item)
    if not price then return false, 'That is not for sale here' end
    local b = baskets[src]
    if b and b.store ~= store then
        if checkOnly then b = nil else dropBasket(src) b = nil end
    end
    if not checkOnly then finishAfter(src) end
    local fresh = false
    if not b then

        b = { store = store, lines = {}, hand = true }
        fresh = true
    end
    if b.hand and units(b) + (Goods.isBig(item) and 2 or 1) > (S.handUnits or 2) then
        return false, next(b.lines) and 'Your hands are full: take a basket from the stack by the door'
            or 'That is too big to carry: take a basket from the stack by the door'
    end
    local n = 0 for _ in pairs(b.lines) do n = n + 1 end
    if not b.lines[item] and n >= S.maxLines then return false, 'Your basket is full' end
    if (b.lines[item] or 0) >= S.maxEach then return false, ('That is all the %s you can take'):format(nameOf(item)) end
    if checkOnly then return true end
    if fresh then
        baskets[src] = b
        if not b.hand then holdBasket(src) end
    end
    b.lines[item] = (b.lines[item] or 0) + 1
    if b.hand then holdHands(src, b) end
    syncGoods(src)
    showTill(src)
    if S.showList then
        showList(src)
    else
        local _, total = priced(b)
        say(src, ('+1 %s · $%d, pay the clerk'):format(nameOf(item), total))
    end
    return true
end

Whip.register(function()

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:grab', {
        rateLimit = 300, burst = 5,
        params = { { 'store', 'string', 24 }, { 'index', 'id', 1, 200 } },
    }, function(src, _, store, index)
        if not Config.Rooms[store] or not inStore(src, store) then return false, 'You are not in that store' end
        if not StoreOpen(store) then return false, 'The store is closed: the clerk is down' end

        goods[store] = goods[store] or Rooms.goodsAt(store)
        local g = goods[store][index]
        if not g then return false, 'That is not for sale here' end
        local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
        if ped == 0 or #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - g.coords) > 3.0 then return false, 'Too far from the shelf' end
        return AddToTab(src, store, g.item)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:takeBasket', {
        rateLimit = 800,
        params = { { 'store', 'string', 24 } },
    }, function(src, _, store)
        if not Config.Rooms[store] or not inStore(src, store) then return false, 'You are not in that store' end
        if not StoreOpen(store) then return false, 'The store is closed: the clerk is down' end
        local b = baskets[src]
        finishAfter(src)
        if b and b.store == store then
            if b.hand then

                b.hand = nil
                holdBasket(src)
                syncGoods(src)
                showList(src)
                return
            end
            if next(b.lines) == nil then dropBasket(src, 'You put the basket back') return end
            return false, 'You already have a basket'
        end
        if b then dropBasket(src) end
        baskets[src] = { store = store, lines = {} }
        holdBasket(src)
        syncGoods(src)
        showList(src)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:stuffed', {
        rateLimit = 300, burst = 4,
        params = { { 'hand', 'string', 8 } },
    }, function(src, _, hand)
        local a = after[src]
        if not a then return end
        if a.hand then
            if hand ~= 'left' and hand ~= 'right' then return end
            a.held[hand] = nil
            holdHeld(src, a.held)
            if not a.held.left and not a.held.right then after[src] = nil end
            return
        end

        local take = math.ceil(#a.list / math.max(1, a.stuffs))
        for _ = 1, take do table.remove(a.list) end
        a.stuffs = math.max(0, a.stuffs - 1)
        Player(src).state:set('pure-247:goods', #a.list > 0 and a.list or nil, true)
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:returned', { rateLimit = 500 }, function(src)
        local a = after[src]
        if a and not a.hand then finishAfter(src) end
    end)

    Whip.core:SecureCallback('pure-247:prices', { rateLimit = 2000 }, function()
        local out = {}
        for key in pairs(Config.Rooms) do out[key] = Prices end
        return out
    end)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local SL = Config.Shoplift
    while true do
        Wait(next(baskets) and 1000 or 4000)
        for src, b in pairs(baskets) do
            local st = Rooms.store(b.store)
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
            if ped == 0 or not st then
                dropBasket(src)
            elseif SL and SL.enabled
                and #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) > (SL.doorMeters or 16.0)
                and Police.enough() then
                steal(src, b)
            elseif #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) > (S.leaveMeters or 25) then
                dropBasket(src, b.hand and 'You left the store: what you had not paid for went back on the shelves'
                    or 'You left the store: your basket went back on the shelves')
            elseif exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == nil then

                if b.hand then holdHands(src, b) elseif S.basket and S.basket.model then holdBasket(src) end
            end
        end

        local now = GetGameTimer()
        for src, a in pairs(after) do
            if GetPlayerPed(src) == 0 or now > a.untilMs then finishAfter(src) end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function() dropBasket(source) after[source] = nil dropClerk(source) end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(1500)
        local seen = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
            local src = tonumber(id)
            local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
            if ped ~= 0 then
                local c = GetEntityCoords(ped)
                for _, st in ipairs(Config.Stores) do
                    if #(c - vector3(st.pos.x, st.pos.y, st.pos.z)) < 15.0 and StoreOpen(st.key) then
                        seen[src] = true
                        local cur = clerkPts[src]

                        local clerk = Clerks and Clerks[st.key]
                        local live = clerk and clerk.netId and NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(clerk.netId) ~= 0 and clerk.netId or nil
                        if not cur or cur.store ~= st.key or cur.netId ~= live then RefreshClerk(src, st.key) end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for src in pairs(clerkPts) do
            if not seen[src] then dropClerk(src) end
        end
    end
end)

local POSE_KVP = 'pure-247:basketPose:v2'
local function applyPose(p)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B then return end
    if type(p) == 'table' then
        if type(p.offset) == 'table' then B.offset = p.offset end
        if type(p.rot) == 'table' then B.rot = p.rot end
        if tonumber(p.pose) then B.pose = math.floor(tonumber(p.pose)) end
    end
    GlobalState['pure-247:carryPose'] = B.pose or 1
end
do
    local ok, saved = pcall(json.decode, GetResourceKvpString(POSE_KVP) or 'null')
    applyPose(ok and saved or nil)
end

Whip.command('basketedit', { dev = true, console = false }, function(src)
    local B = S.basket
    if not B or not B.model then return say(src, 'Config.Shelves.basket has no model', 'error') end
    if exports.whip_core:GetHeldPropsTag(src) == FULL_TAG then exports.whip_core:DropHeldProps(src, TAG) end
    TriggerClientEvent('pure-247:basketEdit', src, { model = B.model, bone = B.bone, offset = B.offset, rot = B.rot, pose = B.pose or 1 })
end)

local function num3(t, lim)
    if type(t) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local v = tonumber(t[i])
        if not v or v ~= v or math.abs(v) > lim then return nil end
        out[i] = math.floor(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
    end
    return out
end

Whip.register(function()
    Whip.core:SecureEvent('pure-247:saveBasketPose', {
        rateLimit = 2000,
        params = { { 'offset', 'any' }, { 'rot', 'any' }, { 'pose', 'int', 1, 4 } },
    }, function(src, _, offset, rot, pose)
        if not IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'whip.devtools') then return false, 'Only staff place the basket' end
        local o, r = num3(offset, 1.0), num3(rot, 360.0)
        if not o or not r then return false, 'That placement could not be read' end
        local p = { offset = o, rot = r, pose = pose }
        SetResourceKvp(POSE_KVP, json.encode(p))
        applyPose(p)
        holdBasket(src)
        local line = ('offset = { %.3f, %.3f, %.3f }, rot = { %.1f, %.1f, %.1f }, pose = %d'):format(o[1], o[2], o[3], r[1], r[2], r[3], pose)
        print('[pure-247] basket hold saved (kept across restarts): ' .. line)
        say(src, 'Basket hold saved for everyone', 'success')
    end)
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tracer client: the traced resources hand their lines here (local event <tracer>:c) and this sends them to the
-- server: one network event per player instead of one per traced resource. /tracemark <text> puts a marker line in
-- every traced resource's log (to find a test again).
--
-- Gentle on the player's game and connection:
--   - plain TriggerServerEvent, never a latent event (latent batches sent from a busy client printed
--     "SendNetPacket ... called from multiple threads!");
--   - pieces of 16 KB at most (cut on line ends), 2 events a second at most (~32 KB/s), one event a second normally
--     (FiveM drops a player's events past ~50 a second, and anticheats flag fast senders);
--   - nothing is sent during the first minutes in game (loading, streaming): kept here until then.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local bufs, size = {}, 0
local MAX_QUEUE = 32 * 1024 * 1024 -- the server is not taking them: don't grow forever
local PIECE = 16000                 -- bytes per event at most

local startedAt = GetGameTimer()

-- what to record, from the server (a net event, not a state bag: those need OneSync); the traced resources ask
-- exports.<this resource>:switch() once a second
local SWITCH, WATCHED = nil, false
RegisterNetEvent(RES .. ':switch', function(s) if type(s) == 'table' then SWITCH = s end end)
RegisterNetEvent(RES .. ':watch', function(on) WATCHED = on == true end)
exports('switch', function()
    if not SWITCH then return nil end
    return { mode = SWITCH.mode, res = SWITCH.res, pass = SWITCH.pass, watched = WATCHED }
end)
CreateThread(function() TriggerServerEvent(RES .. ':hello') end)

-- a resource's chunk, cut into pieces of PIECE bytes at most, on line ends. A single line longer than that is cut
-- anywhere and its pieces carry m = true ("more of this line follows"): the server joins them back into one line
local function push(res, t, piece, more)
    bufs[#bufs + 1] = { r = res, t = t, c = piece, m = more }
    size = size + #piece
end

local function addPieces(res, t, chunk)
    local pos, n = 1, #chunk
    while pos <= n do
        local nl = chunk:find('\n', pos, true)
        local lineEnd = nl and nl - 1 or n -- the current line: pos..lineEnd
        if lineEnd - pos + 1 > PIECE then
            -- one long line: pieces, all but the last marked "more follows"
            while lineEnd - pos + 1 > PIECE do
                push(res, t, chunk:sub(pos, pos + PIECE - 1), true)
                pos = pos + PIECE
            end
            push(res, t, chunk:sub(pos, lineEnd), nil)
            pos = lineEnd + 2
        else
            -- as many whole lines as fit in one piece
            local stop = lineEnd
            while stop + 2 <= n do
                local nxt = chunk:find('\n', stop + 2, true)
                local e = nxt and nxt - 1 or n
                if e - pos + 1 > PIECE then break end
                stop = e
            end
            push(res, t, chunk:sub(pos, stop), nil)
            pos = stop + 2
        end
    end
end

AddEventHandler(RES .. ':c', function(res, t, chunk)
    if type(res) ~= 'string' or type(chunk) ~= 'string' then return end
    if GetInvokingResource() ~= res then return end -- a resource only sends its own lines
    if size > MAX_QUEUE then return end
    addPieces(res, t, chunk)
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local function quietMs()
        return type(SWITCH) == 'table' and tonumber(SWITCH.quiet) or 120000
    end
    while GetGameTimer() - startedAt < quietMs() do Wait(1000) end
    while true do
        -- one event a second, two when a backlog is waiting
        Wait(size > PIECE * 4 and 500 or 1000)
        if #bufs > 0 then
            local list, bytes = {}, 0
            while #bufs > 0 and (bytes == 0 or bytes + #bufs[1].c <= PIECE) do
                local e = table.remove(bufs, 1)
                list[#list + 1] = e
                bytes = bytes + #e.c
            end
            size = size - bytes
            TriggerServerEvent(RES .. ':push', list, GetGameTimer())
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent(RES .. ':netmark', function(text)
    TriggerEvent(RES .. ':mark', text)
end)

RegisterCommand('tracemark', function(_, args)
    TriggerEvent(RES .. ':mark', 'player: ' .. table.concat(args, ' '))
end, false)

Shopper = {}

local list = {}
local aisles = {}
local COWER = { dict = 'mp_am_hold_up', clip = 'cower_loop' }

local function cfg() return Config.Shopper or {} end

local function facesGoods(p, goods, gap)
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    for _, g in ipairs(goods) do
        local d = math.sqrt((g.coords.x - p.x) ^ 2 + (g.coords.y - p.y) ^ 2)
        if d < bd then best, bd = g, d end
    end
    if not best or bd < gap * 0.85 then return false end
    local h = math.rad(p.w)
    return ((best.coords.x - p.x) * -math.sin(h) + (best.coords.y - p.y) * math.cos(h)) / bd >= 0.7
end

local function aislesOf(storeKey)
    if aisles[storeKey] then return aisles[storeKey] end
    local room, st = Config.Rooms[storeKey], Rooms.store(storeKey)
    local out = {}
    if room and st and Racks then
        local gap = tonumber(cfg().rackGap) or 0.75
        local goods = Rooms.goodsAt(storeKey)
        for _, rack in ipairs(Racks.rooms[room.kind] or {}) do
            local sides = {}
            for _, g in ipairs(Racks.models[rack.model] or {}) do
                local side = g.at.x >= 0 and 1 or -1
                local s = sides[side] or { far = 0.0, y = 0.0, n = 0 }
                s.far, s.y, s.n = math.max(s.far, math.abs(g.at.x)), s.y + g.at.y, s.n + 1
                sides[side] = s
            end
            local r = math.rad(rack.yaw)
            local c, n = math.cos(r), math.sin(r)
            for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                local s = sides[side]
                if s then
                    local sx, sy = side * (s.far + gap), s.y / s.n
                    local p = Rooms.world(storeKey, vector3(rack.at.x + sx * c - sy * n, rack.at.y + sx * n + sy * c, 0.0))
                    local spot = vector4(p.x, p.y, st.pos.z, (rack.yaw + room.yaw + (side == 1 and 180.0 or 0.0) - 90.0) % 360.0)
                    if facesGoods(spot, goods, gap) then out[#out + 1] = spot end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    aisles[storeKey] = out
    return out
end
Shopper.aislesOf = aislesOf

function Shopper.reset() list = {} end

local function pause()
    local p = cfg().pauseSeconds or { 8, 20 }
    local lo = math.max(3, math.floor(tonumber(p[1]) or 8))
    return math.random(lo, math.max(lo, math.floor(tonumber(p[2]) or 20)))
end

function Shopper.ensure(st)
    local S = cfg()
    if not S.enabled then return end
    local s = list[st.key]
    if s and exports.whip_core:GetNpc(s.npcId) then return end
    list[st.key] = nil
    local pts, models = aislesOf(st.key), S.models or {}
    if #pts == 0 or #models == 0 then return end
    local at = math.random(#pts)
    local npcId, netId = Whip.core:SpawnNpc({
        model = models[math.random(#models)], coords = pts[at], behaviour = 'stand',
        conditions = { invincible = true, canMove = true, reacts = false, flees = false },
        interior = true,
    }, { fightBack = false })
    if npcId then
        list[st.key] = { npcId = npcId, netId = netId, at = at, next = os.time() + pause() }
    else
        print(('^3[pure-247] shopper of %s not made: %s^7'):format(st.key, tostring(netId)))
    end
end

function Shopper.startle(storeKey, seconds, leave)
    local s = list[storeKey]
    if not s then return end
    s.hold, s.leave = os.time() + seconds, leave
    Whip.core:SetNpcState(s.npcId, { anim = COWER })
end

local function walkOut(storeKey, s)
    list[storeKey] = nil
    local door = Rooms.at(storeKey, 'stand')
    if door then Whip.core:SetNpcState(s.npcId, { anim = false, post = door, pace = 'walk' }) end
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(door and 12000 or 0)
        exports.whip_core:DespawnNpc(s.npcId)
    end)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(3000)
        local now = os.time()
        for key, s in pairs(list) do
            if s.hold then
                if now >= s.hold then
                    s.hold = nil
                    if s.leave then
                        walkOut(key, s)
                    else
                        Whip.core:SetNpcState(s.npcId, { anim = false })
                        s.next = now + 2
                    end
                end
            elseif now >= s.next then
                local pts = aislesOf(key)
                local i = math.random(#pts)
                if i == s.at and #pts > 1 then i = i % #pts + 1 end
                s.at, s.next = i, now + pause()
                Whip.core:SetNpcState(s.npcId, { post = pts[i], pace = 'walk' })
            end
        end
    end
end)

    -- console command (server console / txAdmin live console only)
    command = 'tracer',

    -- what one player's log file keeps about the player in its first line (#PLAYER):
    --   'hash'    a short hash of the Rockstar license: the same player is recognisable across sessions, the license
    --             itself is not stored (default)
    --   'license' the license as it is
    --   'none'    nothing

    -- the player's name in the file name of his session (<date>-<id>-<name>.log); false = <date>-<id>.log

    limits = {
        fileMB = 80,              -- one file: then it goes on in <name>.p2.log, .p3.log...
        resourceMB = 2048,        -- one resource, per start of the tracer
        totalMB = 5120,           -- everything, per start of the tracer: tracing switches itself off there
        playerMBPerMinute = 30,   -- what one player may send in a minute (after his first minutes, see below)
        joinGraceSeconds = 180,   -- no per-minute limit during a player's first 3 minutes (resources loading)
    },

    -- client side: nothing is sent during a player's first seconds in game (loading, streaming); kept until then
    clientQuietSeconds = 120,

    -- resources whose exports are never wrapped when a traced resource calls them (an anticheat that checks which
    -- file called it, a resource that compares the functions it is given...). ox_lib and the tracer are always here
    passThrough = {
        -- 'my_anticheat',
    },
}

function Goods.model(item)
    if MODELS[item] then return MODELS[item] end
    local d = defs[item]
    if d and d.prop then return d.prop end

    if d and d.picture and not d.picture:find('^v_ret_247_') then return d.picture end
    return nil
end

function Goods.isBig(item) return BIG[item] == true end

function Goods.hold(item, hand)
    local m = Goods.model(item)
    local h = m and Goods.HOLD[m] and Goods.HOLD[m][hand == 'left' and 'L' or 'R']
    if not h then return nil end
    return { model = m, bone = PH[hand] or PH.right, offset = h.offset, rot = h.rot }
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tracer - records what a FiveM resource really does at runtime (natives, events, callbacks, NUI, SQL, exports,
-- framework calls), with its arguments and results, for debugging, auditing and analysis (docs/log-format.md).
--
-- Canonical copy: <tracer>/early.lua. `tracer add <resource>` (server console) or tools/install.py copies it into the
-- traced resource as tracer_early.lua and adds `shared_script 'tracer_early.lua'` before the manifest's first script:
-- it runs before ox_lib and before the resource's own files, so every global the resource looks up is the wrapped one.
-- It is a file OF the traced resource, so the resource still starts when the tracer resource is missing.
--
-- One line per thing seen, tab separated, first field = GetGameTimer() on that side:
--   N    native: name(all args) => all results @where #calls ("esc" = escrowed code, else file:line) [src= on server]
--   L    one of the resource's own global functions        F  a function in one of its global tables (Framework...)
--   O    ox_lib API          X  ESX / QBCore object, player objects, anything callable another resource handed over
--   CBX  a function the resource handed to someone else (ox_target onSelect, menu option, ESX callback...) being called
--   CB / CBA / CBR  ox_lib callbacks (sent / awaited / served)        E  event received (src = sender)
--   TS   event sent to the server (client)    TE TriggerEvent    TC TriggerClientEvent (server)
--   U/UR NUI callback and its answer          NUI SendNUIMessage SB state bag write   SBC state bag change seen
--   XI   export called by another resource    XO export of another resource called
--   SQL> / SQL<  query and result (oxmysql, mysql-async, ghmattimysql)  CMD command    P  print()    R registrations
--   T    Citizen.Trace: the resource's SCRIPT ERRORs and traces   (R alias: a global that pointed to a wrapped original)
--   W    player / camera / screen / props the resource created, while something happens (client)   C call counts
--   V    new values of a known pattern     S  how a known pattern is used (rate, values)     ~  a known pattern ran (burst)
-- Volume: what is already known is not written again (see "patterns" below). A call is written in full while its
-- pattern (name + shape of its arguments and results) is new: 3 examples, then only the values never seen before (V),
-- one "~" line per pattern during the 8 s burst after anything the resource reacts to (its events, NUI, callbacks,
-- commands, exports), and an S line once it repeated 100 times (then hourly). A function called fast (> 32/s) is only
-- looked at every 4th call. Lines of a pattern end in "\tp=<id>"; the collector (server.lua) drops the examples and
-- values an earlier session already wrote.
-- On/off: exports[COLLECTOR]:switch(), asked every second (tracer stopped = no answer = nothing is logged). Not a
-- state bag: those need OneSync.
-- The real function always runs with the same arguments; the logging is pcall'd. Functions handed to other code are
-- replaced by a logging wrapper that calls them unchanged.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if rawget(_G, '__TRACER_LOADED') then return end
rawset(_G, '__TRACER_LOADED', true)

local TRACER_VERSION = '1.0.0'
local COLLECTOR = 'tracer' --@collector (the installer writes the tracer resource's real name here)
local EXPORTS0 = exports -- the scheduler's own, before this file wraps it

local G = _G
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local SERVER = IsDuplicityVersion()
local getinfo = debug and debug.getinfo
-- this file as the traced resource knows it ("tracer_early.lua"): its own frames are never the caller of anything
local SELF_SRC = getinfo and getinfo(1, 'S').source or ''
local SELF_FILE = ((SELF_SRC:gsub('^@+', '')):gsub('^[^/]+/', ''))
local fmt, type, tostring, select, pairs, ipairs, pcall, next = string.format, type, tostring, select, pairs, ipairs, pcall, next
local rawget, rawset, rawlen, getmetatable, setmetatable = rawget, rawset, rawlen, getmetatable, setmetatable
local concat, pack, unpack = table.concat, table.pack, table.unpack
local mtype, mabs = math.type, math.abs
local ssub, sgsub, sfind, sbyte = string.sub, string.gsub, string.find, string.byte
local tsort = table.sort
local corunning = coroutine.running
local jsonEncode = json and json.encode
local jsonDecode = json and json.decode
local mpUnpack = msgpack and msgpack.unpack

local LIM = {
    str = 4096, depth = 6, keys0 = 500, keys = 200,          -- one value
    -- known patterns are skipped (see "patterns"): a cap per name alone still writes the same HUD update in every
    -- session (one HUD resource wrote 400 MB a day that way)
    examples = 3,                                             -- full lines per pattern (1 when a line is over bigLine)
    bigLine = 4096,
    enumMax = 12,                                             -- distinct values of a field before it counts as data
    novelMax = 48,                                            -- V lines per pattern
    patsPerName = 48, pats = 20000,                           -- patterns per name (then one "*" pattern) and in all
    shapeNodes = 64, walkNodes = 160, fields = 48,            -- work per call (tables visited, fields followed)
    summaryAt = 100, summaryMs = 3600000,                     -- S line after 100 skipped calls, then hourly
    hotDistinct = 1000,                                       -- fast function: lines written before it is left alone
    burstMs = 8000,
    big = 262144, mid = 131072, small = 32768,               -- json payloads
    lines = SERVER and 10000000 or 2000000,                   -- per resource start / player session
}

-- taken before anything is wrapped: the tracer's own calls never show in the trace
local now = GetGameTimer
local CreateThread, Wait = Citizen.CreateThread, Citizen.Wait
local rawTriggerEvent = TriggerEvent
local rawAddEventHandler = AddEventHandler
local rawGetResourceState = GetResourceState
local rawGetInvokingResource = GetInvokingResource
local rawGetResourceMetadata = GetResourceMetadata
local rawGetPlayerServerId, rawPlayerId = GetPlayerServerId, PlayerId
local LoadNative = Citizen.LoadNative
local rawPrint = print

local W = {} -- client state watch (raw natives)
if not SERVER then
    for _, n in ipairs({ 'PlayerPedId', 'GetEntityCoords', 'GetEntityHeading', 'GetVehiclePedIsIn', 'GetEntityModel',
        'IsScreenFadedOut', 'IsScreenFadingOut', 'IsScreenFadingIn', 'GetRenderingCam', 'GetFinalRenderedCamCoord',
        'GetFinalRenderedCamRot', 'GetFinalRenderedCamFov', 'IsNuiFocused', 'GetInteriorFromEntity', 'IsEntityVisible',
        'IsEntityPositionFrozen', 'IsPauseMenuActive', 'DoesEntityExist', 'GetEntityRotation', 'IsEntityAttached',
        'GetEntityAttachedTo', 'GetEntityAlpha' }) do
        W[n] = G[n]
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- buffer
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ON, INTERNAL = false, false
local total, buf, nbuf = 0, {}, 0
local regs, nregs = {}, 0 -- registrations: sent again each time tracing switches on

local function emit(line)
    if total >= LIM.lines then return end
    total = total + 1
    nbuf = nbuf + 1
    buf[nbuf] = now() .. '\t' .. line
end

local function reg(line)
    if nregs < 6000 then
        nregs = nregs + 1
        regs[nregs] = line
    end
    if ON then emit(line) end
end

-- the 8 s after anything the resource reacts to: known patterns leave a "~" line, the client watch runs
local BURST, burstUntil, burstNo, burstStart = false, 0, 0, 0
local function activity()
    if not ON then return end
    local t = now()
    -- a new burst, or one that has gone on for a minute (a busy server never stops): "~" lines again
    if not BURST or t - burstStart > 60000 then BURST, burstNo, burstStart = true, burstNo + 1, t end
    burstUntil = t + LIM.burstMs
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- serialisation (one line: no raw newline or tab)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function num(v)
    if mtype(v) == 'integer' then return tostring(v) end
    if v ~= v then return 'nan' end
    if v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return tostring(v) end
    local s = fmt('%.4f', v)
    s = sgsub(s, '0+$', '')
    s = sgsub(s, '%.$', '')
    return s
end

local function isFnRef(v)
    return type(v) == 'table' and rawget(v, '__cfx_functionReference') ~= nil
end

-- string / number bytes left for the call line being written (natives / functions: args and results 6 KB each, a whole state
-- table copied around by a helper would otherwise be serialised in full on every call); math.huge = no limit
local serLeft = math.huge
local ser
ser = function(v, d)
    if serLeft <= 0 then return '...' end
    local tv = type(v)
    if tv == 'number' then
        local s = num(v)
        serLeft = serLeft - #s
        return s
    elseif tv == 'string' then
        if #v > LIM.str then v = ssub(v, 1, LIM.str) .. '...(' .. #v .. ')' end
        local s = (sgsub(fmt('%q', v), '\n', 'n'))
        serLeft = serLeft - #s
        return s
    elseif tv == 'boolean' or tv == 'nil' then return tostring(v)
    elseif tv == 'vector3' then return fmt('v3(%s,%s,%s)', num(v.x), num(v.y), num(v.z))
    elseif tv == 'vector4' then return fmt('v4(%s,%s,%s,%s)', num(v.x), num(v.y), num(v.z), num(v.w))
    elseif tv == 'vector2' then return fmt('v2(%s,%s)', num(v.x), num(v.y))
    elseif tv == 'quat' then return fmt('q(%s,%s,%s,%s)', num(v.x), num(v.y), num(v.z), num(v.w))
    elseif tv == 'table' then
        d = d or 0
        if d >= LIM.depth then return '{...}' end
        if isFnRef(v) then return 'fnref' end
        local lim = d == 0 and LIM.keys0 or LIM.keys
        local parts, n = {}, 0
        local len = rawlen(v)
        for i = 1, len do
            n = n + 1
            if n > lim then parts[n] = '...+' .. (len - lim) break end
            parts[n] = ser(rawget(v, i), d + 1)
            if serLeft <= 0 then parts[n + 1] = '...' break end
        end
        if n <= lim then
            for k, x in next, v do
                if not (mtype(k) == 'integer' and k >= 1 and k <= len) then
                    n = n + 1
                    if n > lim then parts[n] = '...' break end
                    parts[n] = (type(k) == 'string' and k or ('[' .. ser(k, LIM.depth - 1) .. ']')) .. '=' .. ser(x, d + 1)
                    if serLeft <= 0 then parts[n + 1] = '...' break end
                end
            end
        end
        return '{' .. concat(parts, ',') .. '}'
    elseif tv == 'function' then return 'fn'
    end
    return tv
end

-- full content (NUI payloads, events, callback results, SQL rows) as json when it can be, cut at `cap` bytes
local function jser(v, cap)
    local s
    if type(v) == 'table' and jsonEncode and not isFnRef(v) then
        local ok, r = pcall(jsonEncode, v)
        if ok and type(r) == 'string' then s = r end
    end
    if not s then
        if type(v) == 'string' then
            s = (sgsub(fmt('%q', v), '\n', 'n'))
        else
            local saved = LIM.str
            LIM.str = cap
            s = ser(v)
            LIM.str = saved
        end
    end
    if #s > cap then s = ssub(s, 1, cap) .. '...(' .. #s .. ')' end
    return (sgsub(s, '[\t\r\n]', ' '))
end

local function serList(n, t, cap)
    serLeft = cap or math.huge
    local p = {}
    for i = 1, n do p[i] = ser(t[i]) end
    serLeft = math.huge
    return concat(p, ', ')
end

local function jserArgs(cap, ...)
    local n = select('#', ...)
    if n == 0 then return '' end
    local p = {}
    for i = 1, n do p[i] = jser((select(i, ...)), cap) end
    return concat(p, ', ')
end

-- "esc" = escrowed code (no debug info), else the file (without this resource's name) and line
local function siteStr(info)
    if not info then return '?' end
    local src = info.source
    if src == '=?' then return 'esc' end
    if info.what == 'C' then return 'C' end
    src = sgsub(tostring(src or '?'), '^@+', '')
    if ssub(src, 1, #RES + 1) == RES .. '/' then src = ssub(src, #RES + 2) end
    -- the tracer itself: the caller tail-called ("return Native()"), its frame is gone (see the line before)
    if src == SELF_FILE then return 'tail' end
    return src .. ':' .. tostring(info.currentline or -1)
end

-- server: the player whose event / callback / command is running in this coroutine (lines name him)
local ctx = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
local function ctxEnd(co, prev, ...)
    ctx[co] = prev
    return ...
end
local function withCtx(src, fn, ...)
    local co = corunning()
    if not co then return fn(...) end
    local prev = ctx[co]
    ctx[co] = src
    return ctxEnd(co, prev, fn(...))
end
local function srcTag()
    if not SERVER then return '' end
    local co = corunning()
    local s = co and ctx[co]
    return s ~= nil and ('\tsrc=' .. tostring(s)) or ''
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- patterns: what is already known is not written again
--   A pattern = kind + name + shape of the arguments (and results): the types and the table keys, not the values. Two
--   things count as part of the shape because they select what a call does: a short word given as an argument
--   (SetVehicleHandlingFloat(veh, "CHandlingData", "fInitialDriveForce", x), GetResourceState("ox_inventory")) and
--   the type / action / event... field of a table (SendNUIMessage({ type = "pedData", ... })).
--   - the first LIM.examples calls of a pattern: full lines ending in "\tp=<id>:ex" (one, ":eb", when over LIM.bigLine)
--   - then a call is written only when a value in it was never seen: a V line with just the new values, ending in
--     "\tp=<id>:nv". Booleans, integers and short strings are followed up to LIM.enumMax values per field;
--     past that, and for floats, the field is data (coords, health, plates): only its range is kept
--   - anything else is skipped: one "~" line per pattern and burst keeps the order of what an action does, and an
--     S line (after LIM.summaryAt skipped calls, then hourly) says how often it runs and which values it takes
--   The collector keeps the ids across sessions and restarts (logs/<res>/known.tsv): an example or a value an earlier
--   session already wrote is not written again.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function hashId(s)
    local h = 0xcbf29ce484222325 -- FNV-1a 64, cut to 48 bits
    for i = 1, #s do h = (h ~ sbyte(s, i)) * 0x100000001b3 end
    return fmt('%012x', h & 0xffffffffffff)
end

local SHAPE = { number = 'n', string = 's', boolean = 'b', ['nil'] = '-', ['function'] = 'fn' }
local SEL_KEY = { type = true, action = true, event = true, method = true, cmd = true, kind = true, op = true }
-- a generated token (16+ characters mixing digits, lower and upper case: a per-start random key) is data, not a name
local function isToken(s) return #s >= 16 and sfind(s, '%d') ~= nil and sfind(s, '%l') ~= nil and sfind(s, '%u') ~= nil end
local function isWord(k)
    return type(k) == 'string' and #k <= 40 and sfind(k, '^[%a_][%w_%-]*$') ~= nil and not isToken(k)
end
local function isSel(s) return #s <= 32 and sfind(s, '^[%a_][%w_%.%-]*$') ~= nil and not isToken(s) end

-- raw access only (next, rawget, rawlen): no metamethod of the caller's tables ever runs
local shapeLeft = 0
local shapeOf
shapeOf = function(v, d)
    local tv = type(v)
    if tv ~= 'table' then return SHAPE[tv] or tv end
    if isFnRef(v) then return 'fn' end
    shapeLeft = shapeLeft - 1
    if d >= 2 or shapeLeft <= 0 then return 't' end
    local len = rawlen(v)
    local keys, nk, dict = {}, 0, false
    for k in next, v do
        if not (mtype(k) == 'integer' and k >= 1 and k <= len) then
            nk = nk + 1
            -- keys that are data (plates, identifiers, 33+ keys): a dictionary, its keys are not part of the shape
            if nk > 32 or not isWord(k) then dict = true break end
            keys[nk] = k
        end
    end
    local s = len > 0 and ('[' .. shapeOf(rawget(v, 1), d + 1) .. ']') or ''
    if dict then return s .. '{*}' end
    if nk == 0 then return len > 0 and s or '{}' end
    tsort(keys)
    for i = 1, nk do
        local k = keys[i]
        local x = rawget(v, k)
        if SEL_KEY[k] and type(x) == 'string' and isSel(x) then
            keys[i] = k .. '=' .. x
        else
            keys[i] = k .. ':' .. shapeOf(x, d + 1)
        end
    end
    return s .. '{' .. concat(keys, ',') .. '}'
end

-- the values of every field (path a1.pedData.job, r1 = first result, [] = any array element, * = any dictionary key)
local walkLeft = 0
local function see(p, path, v, novel)
    local f = p.vals[path]
    if not f then
        if p.nf >= LIM.fields then return novel end
        p.nf = p.nf + 1
        f = { set = {}, ns = 0 }
        p.vals[path] = f
    end
    local tv = type(v)
    if tv == 'number' then
        if v == v then
            if f.lo == nil or v < f.lo then f.lo = v end
            if f.hi == nil or v > f.hi then f.hi = v end
        end
        if mtype(v) ~= 'integer' then f.float = true return novel end
    elseif tv == 'string' then
        if #v > 40 then f.long = true return novel end
    elseif tv ~= 'boolean' then
        return novel
    end
    local set = f.set
    if not set or set[v] then return novel end
    f.ns = f.ns + 1
    if f.ns > LIM.enumMax then
        f.set = nil -- data from now on
        return novel
    end
    set[v] = true
    if p.ex >= LIM.examples then
        novel = novel or {}
        novel[#novel + 1] = path .. '=' .. ser(v)
    end
    return novel
end

local walk
walk = function(p, path, v, d, novel)
    if type(v) ~= 'table' then return see(p, path, v, novel) end
    if d >= 4 or isFnRef(v) then return novel end
    local len = rawlen(v)
    for i = 1, len < 4 and len or 4 do
        walkLeft = walkLeft - 1
        if walkLeft <= 0 then return novel end
        novel = walk(p, path .. '[]', rawget(v, i), d + 1, novel)
    end
    for k, x in next, v do
        if not (mtype(k) == 'integer' and k >= 1 and k <= len) then
            walkLeft = walkLeft - 1
            if walkLeft <= 0 then return novel end
            novel = walk(p, path .. '.' .. (isWord(k) and k or '*'), x, d + 1, novel)
        end
    end
    return novel
end

local pats, npats, perName = {}, 0, {}

-- returns the pattern and why the call is worth a line: 'ex' (an example), 'nv' (new values, listed) or nil (known)
local function learn(kind, name, args, res)
    shapeLeft = LIM.shapeNodes
    local parts, n = { kind, name }, 2
    for i = 1, args.n do
        local v = args[i]
        n = n + 1
        parts[n] = (type(v) == 'string' and isSel(v)) and ('"' .. v .. '"') or shapeOf(v, 0)
    end
    if res then
        n = n + 1
        parts[n] = '=>'
        for i = 1, res.n do -- results are data ("missing" / "started"): followed as values, not part of the shape
            n = n + 1
            parts[n] = shapeOf(res[i], 0)
        end
    end
    local key = concat(parts, '\1', 1, n)
    local p = pats[key]
    if not p then
        local nk = kind .. '\1' .. name
        local c = perName[nk] or 0
        if c >= LIM.patsPerName or npats >= LIM.pats then
            key = nk .. '\1*' -- too many shapes for one name: the rest share one pattern
            p = pats[key]
        end
        if not p then
            p = { id = hashId(key), kind = kind, name = name, n = 0, ex = 0, nv = 0, nf = 0, vals = {}, skipped = 0,
                summed = 0, sumT = 0, t = 0, gapN = 0, gapSum = 0, gapMin = nil, gapMax = 0, burst = -1 }
            pats[key] = p
            npats = npats + 1
            perName[nk] = c + 1
        end
    end
    local t = now()
    if p.n > 0 then
        local g = t - p.t
        p.gapN, p.gapSum = p.gapN + 1, p.gapSum + g
        if p.gapMin == nil or g < p.gapMin then p.gapMin = g end
        if g > p.gapMax then p.gapMax = g end
    end
    p.t = t
    p.n = p.n + 1
    walkLeft = LIM.walkNodes
    local novel
    for i = 1, args.n do novel = walk(p, 'a' .. i, args[i], 0, novel) end
    if res then
        for i = 1, res.n do novel = walk(p, 'r' .. i, res[i], 0, novel) end
    end
    if p.ex < LIM.examples then
        p.ex = p.ex + 1
        return p, 'ex'
    end
    if novel and p.nv < LIM.novelMax then
        p.nv = p.nv + 1
        return p, 'nv', novel
    end
    p.skipped = p.skipped + 1
    return p
end

-- an example: the line ends in "\tp=<id>:ex". One example of a big payload is enough: ":eb", the collector keeps it
-- only when the pattern has no example yet
local function emitEx(line, p)
    if #line > LIM.bigLine then
        p.ex = LIM.examples
        return emit(line .. '\tp=' .. p.id .. ':eb')
    end
    emit(line .. '\tp=' .. p.id .. ':ex')
end

-- new values: "V <kind> <name> <path=value>... p=<id>:nv" (the collector keeps each value once, across sessions)
local function emitNovel(p, novel)
    emit('V\t' .. p.kind .. '\t' .. p.name .. '\t' .. concat(novel, '\t', 1, #novel < 8 and #novel or 8) .. '\tp=' .. p.id .. ':nv')
end

-- how a known pattern is used: calls, time between two calls, the values each field took (or their range)
local function summary(p)
    p.summed, p.sumT = p.skipped, now()
    local parts, n, size = {}, 0, 0
    for path, f in next, p.vals do
        local s
        if f.set and next(f.set) ~= nil and not f.float then
            local vs, k = {}, 0
            for v in next, f.set do
                k = k + 1
                vs[k] = ser(v)
            end
            tsort(vs)
            s = '{' .. concat(vs, '|') .. '}'
        elseif f.lo ~= nil then
            s = f.lo == f.hi and num(f.lo) or (num(f.lo) .. '..' .. num(f.hi))
        else
            s = 'data'
        end
        s = path .. '=' .. s
        size = size + #s
        if size > 1800 then break end
        n = n + 1
        parts[n] = s
    end
    tsort(parts)
    emit(fmt('S\t%s\t%s\tcalls=%d\tskipped=%d\tevery=%sms\tmin=%sms\tmax=%sms\t%s\tp=%s', p.kind, p.name, p.n, p.skipped,
        p.gapN > 0 and tostring(p.gapSum // p.gapN) or '-', tostring(p.gapMin or '-'), tostring(p.gapMax),
        concat(parts, '\t'), p.id))
end

local function skipped(p)
    if BURST and p.burst ~= burstNo then
        p.burst = burstNo
        emit('~\t' .. p.kind .. '\t' .. p.name .. '\tp=' .. p.id)
    end
    if p.skipped - p.summed >= LIM.summaryAt and (p.summed == 0 or now() - p.sumT >= LIM.summaryMs) then summary(p) end
end

-- a line with no answer (events, triggers, prints...): returns its pattern when the line is worth writing (an example,
-- written with emitEx), else nil (new values went out as a V line). Always called with INTERNAL set, inside a pcall
local counts = {}
local function worthLine(kind, name, args)
    local ck = kind .. '\1' .. name
    local c = (counts[ck] or 0) + 1
    counts[ck] = c
    local p, why, novel = learn(kind, name, args)
    if why == 'ex' then return p, c end
    if why == 'nv' then emitNovel(p, novel) else skipped(p) end
    return nil, c
end

-- a request and its answer (callbacks, NUI callbacks, SQL): each has its own pattern. A known request is held back;
-- when its answer turns out to be new, the request goes out with it (marked "late")
local function pairStart(kind, name, args, line)
    local pat, c = worthLine(kind, name, args)
    if pat then
        emitEx(line(c), pat)
        return { sent = true, c = c }
    end
    return { sent = false, c = c, line = line }
end
local function pairEnd(req, kind, name, res, line)
    local pat = worthLine(kind, name, res)
    if not pat then return end
    if not req.sent then emit(req.line(req.c) .. '\tlate') end
    emitEx(line(), pat)
end

local EMPTY = { n = 0 }

-- prints / script errors: one pattern per message, numbers left out ("took 12 ms" = "took # ms")
local function normText(s)
    return ssub((sgsub(sgsub(s, '[%c]', ' '), '%-?%d[%d%.]*', '#')), 1, 80)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- generic function wrapper (natives, the resource's functions, ox_lib API, objects from other resources)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local stats = {}
local ours = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' }) -- every wrapper made here: never wrapped twice
local function statOf(kind, name)
    local key = kind .. '\0' .. name
    local st = stats[key]
    if not st then
        st = { kind = kind, name = name, n = 0, logged = 0, tried = 0, hot = false, win = now(), distinct = 0, last = 0, dup = 0 }
        stats[key] = st
    end
    return st
end

-- 1 = look at this call, 2 = look at it (fast function, sampled), nil = count only
local function want(st)
    local n = st.n + 1
    st.n = n
    if not st.hot and n % 64 == 0 then
        local t = now()
        if t - st.win < 2000 then
            st.hot = true
            emit('HOT\t' .. st.kind .. '\t' .. st.name)
        end
        st.win = t
    end
    if st.hot then
        -- sampled: every 2nd call in a burst, else every 4th; every 16th / 32nd once nothing new came for a while
        if st.distinct < LIM.hotDistinct then
            local every = BURST and 2 or 4
            if st.dup > 64 then every = every * 8 end
            if n % every == 0 then return 2 end
        end
        return nil
    end
    return 1
end

local wrapArgFns, wrapObject -- below

local function logCall(st, mode, info, args, nr, ...)
    local res = nr > 0 and pack(...) or nil
    local p, why, novel = learn(st.kind, st.name, st.shapefmt and st.shapefmt(args) or args, res)
    if not why then
        st.dup = st.dup + 1
        return skipped(p)
    end
    st.dup = 0
    if mode == 2 then st.distinct = st.distinct + 1 end
    if why == 'nv' then return emitNovel(p, novel) end
    local a = st.argfmt and st.argfmt(args) or serList(args.n, args, 6144)
    local r = res and (st.resfmt and st.resfmt(res) or serList(nr, res, 6144)) or ''
    st.logged = st.logged + 1
    local line = st.kind .. '\t' .. st.name .. '(' .. a .. ')\t=> ' .. r .. '\t@' .. siteStr(info) .. '\t#' .. st.n .. srcTag()
    emitEx(line, p)
end

local function ret(...) return ... end

local function after(st, mode, info, args, ...)
    INTERNAL = true
    if mode then pcall(logCall, st, mode, info, args, select('#', ...), ...) end
    if st.onResult then pcall(st.onResult, args, ...) end
    INTERNAL = false
    return ...
end

-- never a tail call into the real function: code that looks at who called a native (anticheats, debug tools) must
-- still find the resource's own file, and a tail call would leave it no caller at all
local function wrapFunction(kind, name, orig, opts)
    local st = statOf(kind, name)
    if opts then
        st.argfmt, st.resfmt, st.activity, st.onResult = opts.argfmt, opts.resfmt, opts.activity, opts.onResult
        st.shapefmt = opts.shapefmt
        st.wrapArgs, st.objResult, st.level = opts.wrapArgs, opts.objResult, opts.level
    end
    local level = st.level or 2
    local w = function(...)
        if not ON or INTERNAL then return ret(orig(...)) end
        if st.activity then activity() end
        local mode = want(st)
        if st.wrapArgs or st.objResult then
            -- functions inside the arguments are wrapped on every call (they are called later), results scanned
            local args = pack(...)
            if st.wrapArgs then
                INTERNAL = true
                pcall(wrapArgFns, st.name, args)
                INTERNAL = false
            end
            local info = mode and getinfo and getinfo(level, 'Sl')
            if st.objResult then
                return after(st, mode, info, args, st.objResult(st.name, orig(unpack(args, 1, args.n))))
            end
            return after(st, mode, info, args, orig(unpack(args, 1, args.n)))
        end
        if not mode then
            if st.onResult then return after(st, nil, nil, pack(...), orig(...)) end
            return ret(orig(...))
        end
        local info = getinfo and getinfo(level, 'Sl')
        return after(st, mode, info, pack(...), orig(...))
    end
    ours[w] = true
    return w
end

-- functions the resource hands to other code (option tables, callbacks): wrapped in place, called unchanged
local function cbWrap(name, fn)
    if ours[fn] then return fn end
    return wrapFunction('CBX', name, fn, { activity = true })
end

-- framework callbacks registered through a framework object (ESX.RegisterServerCallback, QBCore.Functions
-- .CreateCallback, lib-less bridges...): an R line like ox_lib's, so coverage counts them
local function isCbRegister(name)
    return sfind(name, 'RegisterServerCallback', 1, true) ~= nil or sfind(name, 'CreateCallback', 1, true) ~= nil
        or sfind(name, 'RegisterClientCallback', 1, true) ~= nil
end
local cbSeen = {}

-- tables in the arguments are COPIED with their functions wrapped: the caller's own tables are never touched (code
-- compares its functions: ox_lib finds its zones / points with `entry.remove == removeZone`). Only used for calls that
-- go to another resource (exports, ESX functions): their arguments are serialised anyway, a copy changes nothing there
local function copyFns(t, path, depth, budget)
    if depth > 3 or getmetatable(t) ~= nil or isFnRef(t) then return t, budget end
    local c = {}
    for k, v in next, t do
        budget = budget - 1
        if budget <= 0 then return t, 0 end -- too big: the original, untouched
        if type(v) == 'function' then
            c[k] = cbWrap(path .. '.' .. tostring(k), v)
        elseif type(v) == 'table' then
            c[k], budget = copyFns(v, path .. '.' .. tostring(k), depth + 1, budget)
        else
            c[k] = v
        end
    end
    return c, budget
end

wrapArgFns = function(name, args)
    local budget = 600
    -- a short name first ("shop:buy" in RegisterServerCallback("shop:buy", fn)) names the functions handed over
    local a1 = args[1]
    if type(a1) == 'string' and #a1 <= 64 and sfind(a1, '^[%w_%.%-:/]+$') ~= nil and not isToken(a1) then
        if isCbRegister(name) and not cbSeen[a1] then
            cbSeen[a1] = true
            reg(fmt('R\tcallback\t%s\tvia=%s', a1, name))
        end
        name = name .. '("' .. a1 .. '")'
    end
    for i = 1, args.n do
        local v = args[i]
        if type(v) == 'function' then
            args[i] = cbWrap(name .. '>' .. i, v)
        elseif type(v) == 'table' and budget > 0 then
            args[i], budget = copyFns(v, name .. '>' .. i, 1, budget)
        end
    end
end

-- objects another resource hands over (ESX, xPlayer...): their functions get a logging wrapper, in place
local OBJ_NAMES = {
    ['es_extended:getSharedObject'] = 'ESX', ['qb-core:GetCoreObject'] = 'QBCore', ['qbx_core:GetCoreObject'] = 'QBCore',
}
local function objName(name)
    if sfind(name, 'GetPlayerFrom', 1, true) or sfind(name, 'GetExtendedPlayers', 1, true) then return 'xPlayer' end
    -- QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer / GetPlayerByCitizenId..., exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer
    if sfind(name, '.GetPlayer', 1, true) or sfind(name, ':GetPlayer', 1, true) then return 'Player' end
    return OBJ_NAMES[name] or (name .. '()')
end

local function hasCallable(t)
    local n = 0
    for _, v in next, t do
        n = n + 1
        if n > 300 then return false end
        if type(v) == 'function' or isFnRef(v) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local objResultFn
local function wrapObj(name, obj, depth)
    if type(obj) ~= 'table' or isFnRef(obj) or depth > 2 or getmetatable(obj) ~= nil then return end
    local keys = {}
    for k in next, obj do
        keys[#keys + 1] = k
        if #keys > 600 then break end
    end
    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
        local v = rawget(obj, k)
        if type(k) == 'string' and (type(v) == 'function' or isFnRef(v)) and not ours[v] then
            rawset(obj, k, wrapFunction('X', name .. '.' .. k, v, { wrapArgs = true, objResult = objResultFn }))
        elseif type(v) == 'table' and not isFnRef(v) and hasCallable(v) then
            wrapObj(name .. '.' .. tostring(k), v, depth + 1)
        end
    end
end

-- results of a call: any table holding functions is wrapped (arrays of them only when short: GetExtendedPlayers)
objResultFn = function(name, ...)
    local n = select('#', ...)
    if n == 0 then return ... end
    INTERNAL = true
    pcall(function(...)
        for i = 1, n do
            local v = select(i, ...)
            if type(v) == 'table' and not isFnRef(v) and getmetatable(v) == nil then
                if hasCallable(v) then
                    wrapObj(objName(name), v, 0)
                elseif rawlen(v) > 0 and rawlen(v) <= 8 and type(rawget(v, 1)) == 'table' and hasCallable(rawget(v, 1)) then
                    for j = 1, rawlen(v) do wrapObj(objName(name), rawget(v, j), 0) end
                end
            end
        end
    end, ...)
    INTERNAL = false
    return ...
end
wrapObject = wrapObj

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- natives: the ones already loaded now, and every other one when the resource first asks for it (FiveM's native
-- loader is _G's __index: natives_loader.lua; any other loader hook already there stays in the chain)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local SKIP_NATIVE = {
    GetGameTimer = true, GetFrameCount = true, GetFrameTime = true, GetNetworkTime = true, GetGameName = true,
    IsDuplicityVersion = true, GetCurrentResourceName = true, GetInvokingResource = true,
    TriggerEventInternal = true, TriggerServerEventInternal = true, TriggerLatentServerEventInternal = true,
    TriggerClientEventInternal = true, TriggerLatentClientEventInternal = true, RegisterResourceAsEventHandler = true,
    WasEventCanceled = true, ProfilerEnterScope = true, ProfilerExitScope = true, ProfilerIsRecording = true,
    RegisterNuiCallbackType = true, PerformHttpRequestInternal = true,
    -- the scheduler's bookkeeping of function references (every function crossing resources: hundreds per ESX object)
    DuplicateFunctionReference = true, DeleteFunctionReference = true, CanonicalizeRef = true,
    InvokeFunctionReference = true, MakeFunctionReference = true,
}

-- props / peds / vehicles the resource creates: followed by the client watch while something happens
local tracked, ntracked = {}, 0
local function track(args, handle)
    if mtype(handle) == 'integer' and handle ~= 0 and ntracked < 300 and not tracked[handle] then
        tracked[handle] = tostring(args[1])
        ntracked = ntracked + 1
    end
end
local function trackPed(args, handle)
    if mtype(handle) == 'integer' and handle ~= 0 and ntracked < 300 and not tracked[handle] then
        tracked[handle] = tostring(args[2])
        ntracked = ntracked + 1
    end
end

-- the client watch runs while this resource has the NUI focus or one of its own cameras is rendering (not on ANY
-- focus: the phone or the inventory would make every traced resource write the ped every 100 ms)
local ownFocus, ownCams = false, {}
local function camMade(_, h) if mtype(h) == 'integer' and h ~= 0 and h ~= -1 then ownCams[h] = true end end

local NATIVE_OPTS = {
    SendNuiMessage = { argfmt = function(a) return (sgsub(ssub(tostring(a[1]), 1, LIM.mid), '[\t\r\n]', ' ')) end,
        -- the shape of the message, not of the json string
        shapefmt = function(a)
            local ok, v = false, nil
            if type(a[1]) == 'string' and jsonDecode then ok, v = pcall(jsonDecode, a[1]) end
            return { n = 1, ok and v or a[1] }
        end },
    SetStateBagValue = { argfmt = function(a)
        local ok, v = pcall(mpUnpack, a[3])
        return ser(a[1]) .. ', ' .. ser(a[2]) .. ', ' .. (ok and jser(v, LIM.small) or '?') .. ', repl=' .. tostring(a[5])
    end, shapefmt = function(a) -- the key and the value (the bag name is data: entity:123, player:5)
        local ok, v = pcall(mpUnpack, a[3])

if not SERVER then
    for _, n in ipairs({ 'CreateObject', 'CreateObjectNoOffset', 'CreateVehicle' }) do NATIVE_OPTS[n] = { onResult = track } end
    for _, n in ipairs({ 'CreatePed', 'CreatePedInsideVehicle' }) do NATIVE_OPTS[n] = { onResult = trackPed } end

local CUSTOM = {} -- natives that take a handler: the handler is wrapped too (filled below)
local nativeDone = {}

local function wrapNative(name, v)
    if SKIP_NATIVE[name] or type(v) ~= 'function' then return v end

    if CUSTOM[name] then w = CUSTOM[name](v) else w = wrapFunction('N', name, v, NATIVE_OPTS[name]) end

-- events, NUI, commands, state bags, exports, print
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local QUIET = {
    gameEventTriggered = true, populationPedCreating = true, CEventNetworkEntityDamage = true, entityCreating = true,
    entityCreated = true, entityRemoved = true, playerEnteredScope = true, playerLeftScope = true,
    ['ox_lib:validateCallback'] = true,
}
local OWN_PREFIX = COLLECTOR .. ':'
local function quietEvent(ev)
    return QUIET[ev] or ssub(ev, 1, 10) == '__cfx_nui:' or ssub(ev, 1, 13) == '__cfx_export_' or ssub(ev, 1, 8) == '__ox_cb_'
        or ssub(ev, 1, #OWN_PREFIX) == OWN_PREFIX
end
-- the resource's own events start an action burst: its name in the event, or the vendor's prefix (the first word of the
-- resource name: "myvendor_garage" -> "myvendor"), any case (a resource called myvendor_heists may send
-- MYVENDOR_HEISTS:... or myvendor_contracts:...)
local resLower = string.lower(RES)
local vendor = resLower:match('^(%w+)[_%-]')
local function mineEvent(ev)
    local e = string.lower(ev)
    if sfind(e, resLower, 1, true) then return true end
    if not vendor then return false end
    local c = ssub(e, #vendor + 1, #vendor + 1)
    return ssub(e, 1, #vendor) == vendor and (c == '_' or c == '-' or c == ':')
end

local handled = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })

local function logEvent(kind, ev, ...)
    local pat, c = worthLine('E', ev, pack(...))
    if pat then
        emitEx(fmt('E\t%s\t%s\tsrc=%s\t%s\t#%d', kind, ev, tostring(rawget(G, 'source')), jserArgs(LIM.mid, ...), c), pat)
    end
end

local function wrapHandler(kind, ev, fn)
    if type(fn) ~= 'function' or handled[fn] then return fn end
    ev = tostring(ev)
    local quiet, mine = quietEvent(ev), mineEvent(ev)
    local w = function(...)
        if ON and not quiet and not INTERNAL then
            if mine then activity() end
            INTERNAL = true
            pcall(logEvent, kind, ev, ...)
            INTERNAL = false
        end
        if SERVER then return withCtx(rawget(G, 'source'), fn, ...) end
        return fn(...)
    end
    handled[w] = true
    return w
end

-- the functions replaced below, as they were: any other global name pointing to one of them (an alias: the server's
-- RegisterServerEvent IS RegisterNetEvent, RconPrint IS Citizen.Trace) is pointed at the wrapper too, so a script
-- using the alias is traced as well (many scripts still register their server events with RegisterServerEvent)
local ORIG, EXTRA = {}, {} -- EXTRA: [original] = wrapper, for the ones that are not plain globals (Citizen.Trace)
for _, n in ipairs({ 'RegisterNetEvent', 'AddEventHandler', 'TriggerEvent', 'TriggerClientEvent', 'TriggerLatentClientEvent',
    'TriggerServerEvent', 'TriggerLatentServerEvent', 'RegisterNUICallback', 'RegisterNuiCallback', 'SendNUIMessage', 'print' }) do
    ORIG[n] = rawget(G, n)
end

do
    local rawNet, rawAdd = RegisterNetEvent, AddEventHandler
    rawset(G, 'RegisterNetEvent', function(ev, fn, ...)
        reg(fmt('R\tnet\t%s', tostring(ev)))
        if type(fn) == 'function' then return rawNet(ev, wrapHandler('net', ev, fn), ...) end
        return rawNet(ev, fn, ...)
    end)
    rawset(G, 'AddEventHandler', function(ev, fn, ...)
        if handled[fn] then return rawAdd(ev, fn, ...) end
        reg(fmt('R\tev\t%s', tostring(ev)))
        return rawAdd(ev, wrapHandler('ev', ev, fn), ...)
    end)

    local rawTE = TriggerEvent
    rawset(G, 'TriggerEvent', function(ev, ...)
        if ON and not INTERNAL and type(ev) == 'string' and not quietEvent(ev) then
            INTERNAL = true
            pcall(function(...)
                local pat, c = worthLine('TE', ev, pack(...))
                if pat then emitEx(fmt('TE\t%s\t%s\t#%d%s', ev, jserArgs(LIM.mid, ...), c, srcTag()), pat) end
            end, ...)
            INTERNAL = false
        end
        return ret(rawTE(ev, ...))
    end)

    if SERVER then
        for _, nm in ipairs({ 'TriggerClientEvent', 'TriggerLatentClientEvent' }) do
            local raw = rawget(G, nm)
            if type(raw) == 'function' then
                local latent = nm == 'TriggerLatentClientEvent'
                rawset(G, nm, function(ev, target, ...)
                    if ON and not INTERNAL and type(ev) == 'string' and not quietEvent(ev) then
                        INTERNAL = true
                        -- latent: the first extra argument is the rate. The target player is data, not shape
                        pcall(function(...)
                            local pat, c = worthLine('TC', ev, pack(...))
                            if pat then
                                emitEx(fmt('TC\t%s\tto=%s\t%s\t#%d%s%s', ev, tostring(target), jserArgs(LIM.mid, ...), c,
                                    latent and '\tlatent' or '', srcTag()), pat)
                            end
                        end, ...)
                        INTERNAL = false
                    end
                    return ret(raw(ev, target, ...))
                end)
            end
        end
    else
        -- what the client sends to the server, to any resource (dispatch, inventory...). The local keeps the name
        -- "TriggerServerEvent" on the calling line, for code that checks which line sent an event
        local rawTriggerServerEvent, rawTriggerLatentServerEvent = TriggerServerEvent, TriggerLatentServerEvent
        local function logSend(latent, ev, ...)
            if ON and not INTERNAL and type(ev) == 'string' and not quietEvent(ev) then
                INTERNAL = true
                pcall(function(...)
                    local pat, c = worthLine('TS', ev, pack(...))
                    if pat then
                        emitEx(fmt('TS\t%s\t%s\t#%d%s', ev, jserArgs(LIM.mid, ...), c, latent and '\tlatent' or ''), pat)
                    end
                end, ...)
                INTERNAL = false
            end
        end
        if type(rawTriggerServerEvent) == 'function' then
            rawset(G, 'TriggerServerEvent', function(ev, ...)
                logSend(false, ev, ...)
                return ret(rawTriggerServerEvent(ev, ...))
            end)
        end
        if type(rawTriggerLatentServerEvent) == 'function' then
            rawset(G, 'TriggerLatentServerEvent', function(ev, bps, ...)
                logSend(true, ev, ...)
                return ret(rawTriggerLatentServerEvent(ev, bps, ...))
            end)
        end

        for _, nm in ipairs({ 'RegisterNUICallback', 'RegisterNuiCallback' }) do
            local raw = rawget(G, nm)
            if type(raw) == 'function' then
                rawset(G, nm, function(name, fn, ...)
                    reg(fmt('R\tnui\t%s', tostring(name)))
                    if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return raw(name, fn, ...) end
                    return raw(name, function(data, cb, ...)
                        activity()
                        local nm = tostring(name)
                        local req
                        if ON and not INTERNAL then
                            INTERNAL = true
                            local ok, r = pcall(pairStart, 'U', nm, { n = 1, data }, function(c)
                                return fmt('U\t%s\t%s\t#%d', nm, jser(data, LIM.mid), c)
                            end)
                            INTERNAL = false
                            if ok then req = r end
                        end
                        local wcb = cb
                        if req and (type(cb) == 'function' or type(cb) == 'table') then
                            wcb = function(resp, ...)
                                if ON then
                                    INTERNAL = true
                                    pcall(pairEnd, req, 'UR', nm, { n = 1, resp }, function()
                                        return fmt('UR\t%s\t%s', nm, jser(resp, LIM.mid))
                                    end)
                                    INTERNAL = false
                                end
                                return cb(resp, ...)
                            end
                        end
                        return fn(data, wcb, ...)
                    end, ...)
                end)
            end
        end
        -- SendNUIMessage is scheduler code calling its own copy of SendNuiMessage: wrapped on its own
        local rawSend = rawget(G, 'SendNUIMessage')
        if type(rawSend) == 'function' then
            rawset(G, 'SendNUIMessage', wrapFunction('NUI', 'SendNUIMessage', rawSend,
                { argfmt = function(a) return jser(a[1], LIM.mid) end }))
        end
    end

    -- print(): debug output of the resource (and errors it prints itself)
    rawset(G, 'print', function(...)
        if ON and not INTERNAL then
            INTERNAL = true
            pcall(function(...)
                local n = select('#', ...)
                local p = {}
                for i = 1, n do p[i] = tostring((select(i, ...))) end
                local s = concat(p, ' ')
                if #s > LIM.str then s = ssub(s, 1, LIM.str) .. '...' end
                local pat = worthLine('P', normText(s), EMPTY)
                if pat then emitEx('P\t' .. sgsub(s, '[%c]', ' ') .. srcTag(), pat) end
            end, ...)
            INTERNAL = false
        end
        return rawPrint(...)
    end)

    -- Citizen.Trace: the scheduler prints this resource's script errors with it ("SCRIPT ERROR"... lines), RconPrint too
    local rawTrace = Citizen.Trace
    if type(rawTrace) == 'function' then
        local wTrace = function(...)
            if ON and not INTERNAL then
                INTERNAL = true
                pcall(function(...)
                    local n = select('#', ...)
                    local p = {}
                    for i = 1, n do p[i] = tostring((select(i, ...))) end
                    local s = concat(p, ' ')
                    if #s > LIM.str then s = ssub(s, 1, LIM.str) .. '...' end
                    local pat = worthLine('T', normText(s), EMPTY)
                    if pat then emitEx('T\t' .. sgsub(s, '[%c]', ' ') .. srcTag(), pat) end
                end, ...)
                INTERNAL = false
            end
            return rawTrace(...)
        end
        Citizen.Trace = wTrace
        EXTRA[rawTrace] = wTrace
    end
end

-- aliases: every global still holding an original gets its wrapper
do
    local repl = {}
    for orig, w in pairs(EXTRA) do repl[orig] = w end
    for n, orig in pairs(ORIG) do
        local w = rawget(G, n)
        if type(orig) == 'function' and type(w) == 'function' and w ~= orig then repl[orig] = w end
    end
    local aliases = {}
    for k, v in next, G do
        if type(k) == 'string' and repl[v] then aliases[#aliases + 1] = k end
    end
    for _, k in ipairs(aliases) do
        reg(fmt('R\talias\t%s', k))
        rawset(G, k, repl[rawget(G, k)])
    end
end

CUSTOM.RegisterCommand = function(orig)
    return function(name, handler, restricted, ...)
        reg(fmt('R\tcmd\t%s\trestricted=%s', tostring(name), tostring(restricted)))
        local h = handler

            handler = function(src, args, raw, ...)
                activity()

                    INTERNAL = true
                    pcall(function() emit(fmt('CMD\t%s\tsrc=%s\t%s\t%s', tostring(name), tostring(src), ser(args), ser(raw))) end)
                    INTERNAL = false
                end

CUSTOM.AddStateBagChangeHandler = function(orig)
