-- SQL: every query this resource sends to oxmysql, mysql-async or ghmattimysql, through any of their APIs (the MySQL
-- libraries of oxmysql and mysql-async end in these exports too, so each query is seen once). One pattern per query
-- text (whitespace folded) and shape of its parameters / rows
local SQL_RES = { oxmysql = true, ['mysql-async'] = true, ghmattimysql = true }
local sqlId = 0
local function sqlStart(method, query, params)
    if not ON or INTERNAL then return nil end
    INTERNAL = true
    local ok, req = pcall(function()
        local q = type(query) == 'string' and query or ser(query)
        sqlId = sqlId + 1
        local id, sTag = sqlId, srcTag()
        local name = method .. ' ' .. ssub((sgsub(q, '%s+', ' ')), 1, 300)
        local r = pairStart('SQL>', name, { n = 1, params }, function(c)
            return fmt('SQL>\t%d\t%s\t%s\t%s\t#%d%s', id, method, jser(q, LIM.small), jser(params, LIM.small), c, sTag)
        end)
        r.id, r.name = id, name
        return r
    end)
    INTERNAL = false
    return ok and req or nil
end
local function sqlEnd(req, t, ...)
    if req and ON and not req.done then
        req.done = true
        INTERNAL = true
        local res, ms = pack(...), now() - t
        pcall(pairEnd, req, 'SQL<', req.name, res, function()
            return fmt('SQL<\t%d\t%dms\t%s', req.id, ms, jserArgs(LIM.mid, unpack(res, 1, res.n)))
        end)
        INTERNAL = false
    end
    return ...
end
local function callable(v) return type(v) == 'function' or isFnRef(v) end

-- exports.oxmysql:query(query, params, cb), (query, cb), query_async(query, params) -> rows, MySQL.query.await...
local function sqlExport(res, fnName, f, real)
    local method = tostring(res) .. ':' .. tostring(fnName)
    -- (self, ...) like the scheduler's own export functions; the arguments go on exactly as given (same count)
    return function(_, ...)
        local query = ...
        if not ON or INTERNAL or (type(query) ~= 'string' and type(query) ~= 'table') then return ret(f(real, ...)) end
        local args = pack(...)
        local req = sqlStart(method, query, (not callable(args[2])) and args[2] or nil)
        local t = now()
        if req then
            local function wrapCb(fn)
                return function(...)
                    sqlEnd(req, t, ...)
                    return fn(...)
                end
            end
            -- the answer comes through the callback: what the call returns is not the rows
            if callable(args[2]) then args[2], req.viaCb = wrapCb(args[2]), true
            elseif callable(args[3]) then args[3], req.viaCb = wrapCb(args[3]), true end
        end
        if req and not req.viaCb then return sqlEnd(req, t, f(real, unpack(args, 1, args.n))) end
        return ret(f(real, unpack(args, 1, args.n)))
    end
end

-- exports: registrations (and every call another resource makes to them), and the calls this resource makes to
-- other resources' exports (functions in the arguments wrapped, objects in the results too). The tracer, ox_lib (its
-- API is traced on its own) and the resources of the collector's `passThrough` list pass straight through
local PASS_EXTRA = {} -- filled by readSwitch from the collector's passThrough list
do
    local rawExports = exports
    local PASS = { [COLLECTOR] = true, ox_lib = true }
    local proxies = {}
    local function resProxy(res)
        local real = rawExports[res]
        if PASS[res] or PASS_EXTRA[res] then return real end
        local p = proxies[res]
        if p then return p end
        local sql = SQL_RES[res]
        p = setmetatable({}, {
            __index = function(_, fnName)
                local f = real[fnName]
                if type(f) ~= 'function' then return f end
                if sql then return sqlExport(res, fnName, f, real) end
                -- a new wrapper per lookup, like the scheduler's own (its stats are kept by name)
                local inner = wrapFunction('XO', tostring(res) .. ':' .. tostring(fnName),
                    function(...) return ret(f(real, ...)) end, { wrapArgs = true, objResult = objResultFn, level = 3 })
                return function(self, ...) return ret(inner(...)) end
            end,
            __newindex = function() error('cannot set values on an export resource', 2) end,
        })
        proxies[res] = p
        return p
    end
    exports = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, res) return resProxy(res) end,
        __newindex = function() error('cannot set values on exports', 2) end,
        __call = function(_, name, fn)
            reg(fmt('R\texport\t%s', tostring(name)))
            if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return rawExports(name, fn) end
            return rawExports(name, function(...)
                if ON and not INTERNAL then
                    activity()
                    INTERNAL = true
                    pcall(function(...)
                        local pat, c = worthLine('XI', tostring(name), pack(...))
                        if pat then
                            emitEx(fmt('XI\t%s\tfrom=%s\t%s\t#%d', tostring(name), tostring(rawGetInvokingResource()),
                                jserArgs(LIM.small, ...), c), pat)
                        end
                    end, ...)
                    INTERNAL = false
                end
                return fn(...)
            end)
        end,
    })
end

-- natives called by hash. If the natives themselves go through Citizen.InvokeNative (they normally keep their own
-- copy), every native would show twice: probed once, and put back in that case
do
    local rawInvoke = Citizen.InvokeNative
    local probing, hit = false, false
    local st = statOf('NI', 'InvokeNative')
    Citizen.InvokeNative = function(hash, ...)
        if probing then hit = true return rawInvoke(hash, ...) end
        if not ON or INTERNAL then return ret(rawInvoke(hash, ...)) end
        local mode = want(st)
        if not mode then return ret(rawInvoke(hash, ...)) end
        local info = getinfo and getinfo(2, 'Sl')
        return after(st, mode, info, pack(hash, ...), rawInvoke(hash, ...))
    end
    st.argfmt = function(a)
        local h = a[1]
        local hs = mtype(h) == 'integer' and fmt('0x%X', h) or ser(h)
        if a.n <= 1 then return hs end
        local rest = { n = a.n - 1 }
        for i = 2, a.n do rest[i - 1] = a[i] end
        return hs .. ', ' .. serList(rest.n, rest)
    end
    -- the hash selects the native: part of the shape
    st.shapefmt = function(a)
        local c = { n = a.n }
        for i = 2, a.n do c[i] = a[i] end
        c[1] = mtype(a[1]) == 'integer' and fmt('N_%X', a[1]) or a[1]
        return c
    end
    probing = true
    pcall(function() return G.GetFrameCount() end)
    probing = false
    if hit then Citizen.InvokeNative = rawInvoke end
end

-- ox_lib (lib is assigned by @ox_lib/init.lua after this file: caught by the _G hook below)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local cbId = 0
local function hookCallback(cb)
    if type(cb) ~= 'table' then return cb end
    local mt = getmetatable(cb)
    local rawCall = mt and mt.__call
    local rawAwait, rawRegister = rawget(cb, 'await'), rawget(cb, 'register')
    local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = cb,
        __call = function(_, event, target, fn, ...)
            -- client: (event, delay, cb, ...)   server: (event, playerId, cb, ...)
            activity()
            cbId = cbId + 1
            local id, ev = cbId, tostring(event)
            local req
            if ON and not INTERNAL then
                INTERNAL = true
                local args, sTag = pack(...), srcTag()
                local ok, r = pcall(pairStart, 'CB>', ev, args, function()
                    return fmt('CB>\t%s\t%d\t%s\t%s%s', ev, id, tostring(target), jserArgs(LIM.mid, unpack(args, 1, args.n)), sTag)
                end)
                INTERNAL = false
                if ok then req = r end
            end
            local wfn = fn
            if type(fn) == 'function' and req then
                wfn = function(...)
                    if ON then
                        INTERNAL = true
                        local res = pack(...)
                        pcall(pairEnd, req, 'CB<', ev, res, function()
                            return fmt('CB<\t%s\t%d\t%s', ev, id, jserArgs(LIM.big, unpack(res, 1, res.n)))
                        end)
                        INTERNAL = false
                    end
                    return fn(...)
                end
            end
            return rawCall(cb, event, target, wfn, ...)
        end,
    })
    if type(rawAwait) == 'function' then
        rawset(proxy, 'await', function(event, target, ...)
            activity()
            cbId = cbId + 1
            local id, t, ev = cbId, now(), tostring(event)
            local req
            if ON and not INTERNAL then
                INTERNAL = true
                local args, sTag = pack(...), srcTag()
                local ok, r = pcall(pairStart, 'CBA>', ev, args, function()
                    return fmt('CBA>\t%s\t%d\t%s\t%s%s', ev, id, tostring(target), jserArgs(LIM.mid, unpack(args, 1, args.n)), sTag)
                end)
                INTERNAL = false
                if ok then req = r end
            end
            return (function(...)
                if ON and req then
                    INTERNAL = true
                    local res, ms = pack(...), now() - t
                    pcall(pairEnd, req, 'CBA<', ev, res, function()
                        return fmt('CBA<\t%s\t%d\t%dms\t%s', ev, id, ms, jserArgs(LIM.big, unpack(res, 1, res.n)))
                    end)
                    INTERNAL = false
                end
                return ...
            end)(rawAwait(event, target, ...))
        end)
    end
    if type(rawRegister) == 'function' then
        rawset(proxy, 'register', function(name, fn, ...)
            reg(fmt('R\tcallback\t%s', tostring(name)))
            if type(fn) ~= 'function' then return rawRegister(name, fn, ...) end
            local nm = tostring(name)
            return rawRegister(name, function(...)
                activity()
                local req, id
                if ON and not INTERNAL then
                    cbId = cbId + 1
                    id = cbId
                    INTERNAL = true
                    local args = pack(...)
                    local ok, r = pcall(pairStart, 'CBR>', nm, args, function(c)
                        return fmt('CBR>\t%s\t%d\t%s\t#%d', nm, id, jserArgs(LIM.mid, unpack(args, 1, args.n)), c)
                    end)
                    INTERNAL = false
                    if ok then req = r end
                end
                local function done(...)
                    if req and ON then
                        INTERNAL = true
                        local res = pack(...)
                        pcall(pairEnd, req, 'CBR<', nm, res, function()
                            return fmt('CBR<\t%s\t%d\t%s', nm, id, jserArgs(LIM.big, unpack(res, 1, res.n)))
                        end)
                        INTERNAL = false
                    end
                    return ...
                end
                if SERVER then return done(withCtx((...), fn, ...)) end
                return done(fn(...))
            end, ...)
        end)
    end
    return proxy
end

local LIB_SKIP = { name = true, context = true, class = true, array = true, print = true, locale = true, logger = true,
    math = true, string = true, table = true, cron = true, onCache = true, waitFor = true, cache = true, timer = true,
    grid = true,
    -- these find the calling resource by walking up the call stack (ox_lib require/shared.lua getModuleInfo): a wrapper
    -- in between makes ox_lib look for its own modules in the traced resource (lib.logger then fails with
    -- "module 'imports.logger.providers.datadog' not found")
    require = true, load = true, loadJson = true }

local function wrapLibModule(k, m)
    if k == 'callback' then return hookCallback(m) end
    if LIB_SKIP[k] then return m end
    -- logged only: ox_lib runs in this runtime and keeps the very tables it is given (zones, points), so neither the
    -- arguments nor the results are touched
    if type(m) == 'function' then return wrapFunction('O', 'lib.' .. k, m) end
    if type(m) == 'table' and getmetatable(m) == nil then
        -- lib.zones.box, lib.points.new, lib.raycast.cam...: every function field
        for f, fn in pairs(m) do
            if type(fn) == 'function' then
                rawset(m, f, wrapFunction('O', 'lib.' .. k .. '.' .. tostring(f), fn))
            end
        end
    end
    return m
end

local function hookLib(lib)
    if type(lib) ~= 'table' then return end
    local mt = getmetatable(lib)
    local idx = type(mt) == 'table' and rawget(mt, '__index')
    local done = {}
    for k, v in pairs(lib) do
        if not done[k] then
            done[k] = true
            rawset(lib, k, wrapLibModule(k, v))
        end
    end
    if type(idx) == 'function' then
        rawset(mt, '__index', function(self, k, ...)
            local m = idx(self, k, ...)
            if m ~= nil and not done[k] then
                done[k] = true
                local ok, w = pcall(wrapLibModule, k, m)
                if ok and w ~= nil then
                    m = w
                    rawset(self, k, m)
                end
            end
            return m
        end)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- _G hook: globals created from now on. The resource's own functions (escrowed "=?" or its own files) are wrapped
-- when they are defined; its global namespace tables (Framework...) get the same for functions added to them later
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ownPrefix1, ownPrefix2 = '@@' .. RES .. '/', '@' .. RES .. '/'
local function ownSource(src)
    if src == '=?' then return true end
    if type(src) ~= 'string' then return false end
    if src == SELF_SRC then return false end
    return ssub(src, 1, #ownPrefix1) == ownPrefix1 or ssub(src, 1, #ownPrefix2) == ownPrefix2
end
local function ownFn(fn)
    if not getinfo then return false end
    local i = getinfo(fn, 'S')
    return i ~= nil and i.what == 'Lua' and ownSource(i.source)
end

local SKIP_TABLES = { Config = true, Locale = true, Locales = true, Lang = true, Translations = true, Globals = true,
    Webhooks = true, QBCore = true, lib = true, cache = true, MySQL = true, exports = true, json = true,
    msgpack = true, Citizen = true, GlobalState = true, LocalPlayer = true, promise = true, Wait = true }

-- only these global tables are followed (functions added to them wrapped): any other table may hold objects of other
-- code (ox_lib zones / points) that must stay exactly as they are
local NAMESPACES = { Framework = true, Bridge = true }

local hookTable
local function maybeWrap(kind, name, v, depth)
    if type(v) == 'function' then
        if ownFn(v) then return wrapFunction(kind, name, v) end
    elseif type(v) == 'table' and depth < 1 then
        hookTable(name, v, depth + 1)
    end
    return v
end

-- only namespaces (tables holding functions, or empty ones that get filled later): data tables are left alone
hookTable = function(name, t, depth)
    if getmetatable(t) ~= nil or isFnRef(t) then return end -- a class / proxy: left alone
    local n, hasFn, empty = 0, false, true
    for _, v in next, t do
        empty = false
        n = n + 1
        if type(v) == 'function' then
            hasFn = true
        elseif type(v) == 'table' and not hasFn and getmetatable(v) == nil then
            if next(v) == nil then
                hasFn = true
            else
                for _, x in next, v do
                    if type(x) == 'function' then hasFn = true break end
                end
            end
        end
        if n > 300 then return end -- data, not a namespace
    end
    if not (empty or hasFn) then return end
    local keys = {}
    for k in next, t do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
        if type(k) == 'string' then
            local v = rawget(t, k)
            local w = maybeWrap('F', name .. '.' .. k, v, depth)
            if w ~= v then rawset(t, k, w) end
        end
    end
    setmetatable(t, {
        __newindex = function(tt, k, v)
            if type(k) == 'string' then
                local ok, w = pcall(maybeWrap, 'F', name .. '.' .. k, v, depth)
                if ok then v = w end
            end
            rawset(tt, k, v)
        end,
    })
end

local function onNewGlobal(k, v, info)
    if type(k) ~= 'string' then return v end
    if k == 'lib' then hookLib(v) return v end
    if k == 'ESX' and type(v) == 'table' and hasCallable(v) then wrapObject('ESX', v, 0) return v end
    if type(v) == 'function' then
        if ownFn(v) then
            reg(fmt('R\tglobal\tfn %s\t%s', k, siteStr(info)))
            return wrapFunction('L', k, v)
        end
    elseif type(v) == 'table' and not SKIP_TABLES[k] and info and ownSource(info.source) then
        reg(fmt('R\tglobal\ttable %s\t%s', k, siteStr(info)))
        if NAMESPACES[k] then hookTable(k, v, 0) end
    end
    return v
end

-- a native: defined by FiveM's natives file (server: natives_server.lua, all loaded at start) or loadable by name
-- (client: one native per name, loaded on first use; another resource's wrappers around natives count too)
local function isNative(k, v)
    if getinfo then
        local i = getinfo(v, 'S')
        local src = i and i.source
        if type(src) == 'string' and sfind(src, '/scripting/lua/natives', 1, true) then return true end
    end
    if type(LoadNative) == 'function' then
        local ok, r = pcall(LoadNative, k)
        return ok and r ~= nil and r ~= false
    end
    return false
end

do
    -- natives already there (server: all of them; client: the ones loaded by files before this one): wrapped now
    local names = {}
    for k, v in next, G do
        if type(k) == 'string' and type(v) == 'function' and not SKIP_NATIVE[k] and not nativeDone[k] and isNative(k, v) then
            names[#names + 1] = k
        end
    end
    for _, k in ipairs(names) do rawset(G, k, wrapNative(k, rawget(G, k))) end

    -- server: _G has no metatable (no lazy native loader): one with only __newindex
    local gmt = getmetatable(G)
    if gmt == nil then
        gmt = {}
        setmetatable(G, gmt)
    end
    if type(gmt) == 'table' then
        -- client: the other natives when first asked for
        local prevIndex = rawget(gmt, '__index')
        if type(prevIndex) == 'function' then
            rawset(gmt, '__index', function(t, n)
                local v = prevIndex(t, n)
                if t == G and type(v) == 'function' and type(n) == 'string' and not nativeDone[n] and not SKIP_NATIVE[n] then
                    local w = wrapNative(n, v)
                    rawset(G, n, w)
                    return w
                end
                return v
            end)
        end
        -- new globals
        local prevNew = rawget(gmt, '__newindex')
        rawset(gmt, '__newindex', function(t, k, v)
            if t == G then
                local info = getinfo and getinfo(2, 'Sl')
                local ok, w = pcall(onNewGlobal, k, v, info)
                if ok then v = w end
            end
            if prevNew then return prevNew(t, k, v) end
            rawset(t, k, v)
        end)
    end
end

-- on / off, shipping, counts, client state watch
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function readSwitch()
    INTERNAL = true
    local ok, on = pcall(function()
        if rawGetResourceState(COLLECTOR) ~= 'started' then return false end
        local s = EXPORTS0[COLLECTOR]:switch()
        if type(s) ~= 'table' or s.mode == 'off' then return false end
        if type(s.res) == 'table' and not s.res[RES] then return false end
        if type(s.pass) == 'table' then for name in pairs(s.pass) do PASS_EXTRA[name] = true end end
        if SERVER or s.mode ~= 'players' then return true end
        return s.watched == true
    end)
    INTERNAL = false
    return ok and on or false
end

local ship -- below

local function switch(on)
    if on == ON then return end
    ON = on
    if on then
        emit(fmt('I\ton\t%s\tversion=%s\ttracer=%s\tside=%s\tme=%s', RES, tostring(rawGetResourceMetadata(RES, 'version', 0)),
            TRACER_VERSION, SERVER and 'server' or 'client', SERVER and '-' or tostring(rawGetPlayerServerId(rawPlayerId()))))
        for i = 1, nregs do emit(regs[i]) end
    else
        BURST = false
        emit('I\toff')
        pcall(ship) -- the last lines and the "off" line go out before the buffer is dropped
        buf, nbuf = {}, 0
    end
end

local SHIP_EVENT = COLLECTOR .. (SERVER and ':s' or ':c')
ship = function()
    if nbuf == 0 then return end
    if rawGetResourceState(COLLECTOR) ~= 'started' then return end
    local lines, n = buf, nbuf
    buf, nbuf = {}, 0
    local chunk, size = {}, 0
    for i = 1, n do
        chunk[#chunk + 1] = lines[i]
        size = size + #lines[i] + 1
        if size > 120000 then
            rawTriggerEvent(SHIP_EVENT, RES, now(), concat(chunk, '\n'))
            chunk, size = {}, 0
        end
    end
    if #chunk > 0 then rawTriggerEvent(SHIP_EVENT, RES, now(), concat(chunk, '\n')) end
end

switch(readSwitch())

-- /tracemark (tracer client) and `tracer mark` (server): a marker line in every traced resource's log
rawAddEventHandler(COLLECTOR .. ':mark', function(text)
    if ON then emit('MARK\t' .. (sgsub(tostring(text), '[%c]', ' '))) end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    local lastCounts, tick = now(), 0
    while true do
        switch(readSwitch())
        if ON then
            tick = tick + 1
            if BURST and now() > burstUntil then BURST = false end
            -- call counts every 5 min: what runs how often
            if now() - lastCounts > 300000 then
                lastCounts = now()
                local parts = {}
                for _, st in pairs(stats) do
                    if st.n ~= st.last then
                        parts[#parts + 1] = st.kind .. ':' .. st.name .. '=' .. (st.n - st.last)
                        st.last = st.n
                    end
                end
                if #parts > 0 then emit('C\t' .. concat(parts, ' ')) end
            end
            if tick % (SERVER and 2 or 5) == 0 then ship() end
        else
            buf, nbuf = {}, 0
        end
        Wait(1000)
    end
end)

if not SERVER then
    -- while something happens (burst: every 100 ms) or this resource's own UI / camera is up (every 250 ms, ped moves of
    -- 0.5 m+): the player's ped, vehicle, the camera, the screen fade, NUI focus and the props / peds / vehicles the
    -- resource created, when they changed
    local last, lastEnt = {}, {}
    local function changed(k, s)
        if last[k] == s then return false end
        last[k] = s
        return true
    end
    local function v3(v) return fmt('%.3f,%.3f,%.3f', v.x, v.y, v.z) end
    local function watch()
        local nui = W.IsNuiFocused()
        local cam = W.GetRenderingCam()
        local fine = BURST
        if not (fine or (ownFocus and nui) or ownCams[cam]) then return 500 end
        local ped = W.PlayerPedId()
        local pos = W.GetEntityCoords(ped)
        local h = W.GetEntityHeading(ped)
        local veh = W.GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
        local lp = last.pos
        if not lp or #(lp - pos) > (fine and 0.05 or 0.5) or mabs((last.h or 0) - h) > (fine and 1.0 or 10.0)
            or last.veh ~= veh then
            last.pos, last.h, last.veh = pos, h, veh
            emit(fmt('W\tped\t%s\th=%.2f\tveh=%d\tmodel=%s\tint=%d\tvis=%s\tfrozen=%s', v3(pos), h, veh,
                veh ~= 0 and tostring(W.GetEntityModel(veh)) or '-', W.GetInteriorFromEntity(ped),
                tostring(W.IsEntityVisible(ped)), tostring(W.IsEntityPositionFrozen(ped))))
        end
        local fade = W.IsScreenFadedOut() and 'out' or W.IsScreenFadingOut() and 'fading-out'
            or W.IsScreenFadingIn() and 'fading-in' or 'in'
        if changed('fade', fade) then emit('W\tfade\t' .. fade) end
        if changed('nui', tostring(nui)) then emit('W\tnuifocus\t' .. tostring(nui)) end
        local pause = tostring(W.IsPauseMenuActive())
        if changed('pause', pause) then emit('W\tpause\t' .. pause) end
        if cam ~= -1 then
            local s = fmt('%s\trot=%s\tfov=%.2f', v3(W.GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()), v3(W.GetFinalRenderedCamRot(2)),
                W.GetFinalRenderedCamFov())
            if changed('cam', s) then emit('W\tcam\t' .. cam .. '\t' .. s) end
        elseif changed('cam', 'none') then
            emit('W\tcam\tnone')
        end
        for handle, model in pairs(tracked) do
            if not W.DoesEntityExist(handle) then
                tracked[handle], lastEnt[handle] = nil, nil
                ntracked = ntracked - 1
                emit(fmt('W\tgone\t%d\tmodel=%s', handle, model))
            else
                local p, r = W.GetEntityCoords(handle), W.GetEntityRotation(handle, 2)
                local att = W.IsEntityAttached(handle) and W.GetEntityAttachedTo(handle) or 0
                local s = fmt('%s\trot=%s\tatt=%d\tvis=%s\talpha=%d', v3(p), v3(r), att, tostring(W.IsEntityVisible(handle)),
                    W.GetEntityAlpha(handle))
                if lastEnt[handle] ~= s then
                    lastEnt[handle] = s
                    emit(fmt('W\tent\t%d\tmodel=%s\t%s', handle, model, s))
                end
            end
        end
        return fine and 100 or 250
    end
    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            local wait = 500
            if ON then
                INTERNAL = true
                local ok, w = pcall(watch)
                INTERNAL = false
                wait = ok and w or 2000
            end
            Wait(wait)
        end
    end)
end

-- The move: behind a fade, the car too when they drive one, and onto the ground when no height was given
-- (the world there is streamed in first: GTA only knows the ground of what is loaded).

local busy = false

local function notify(text, kind) exports.whip_core:Notify(text, kind or 'info') end

-- the ground under x, y: tried from high up down, waiting for the collision each time; nil when none was found
local function groundZ(ent, x, y)
    for _, probe in ipairs({ 1000.0, 800.0, 600.0, 400.0, 300.0, 200.0, 150.0, 100.0, 50.0, 25.0, 0.0 }) do
        SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, probe, false, false, false)
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, probe)
        local until_ = GetGameTimer() + 400
        repeat
            local found, z = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, probe, false)
            if found then return z end
            Wait(0)
        until GetGameTimer() > until_
    end
    return nil
end

local function go(x, y, z, heading)
    if busy then return end
    busy = true
    local ped = PlayerPedId()
    local veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    local ent = (veh ~= 0 and GetPedInVehicleSeat(veh, -1) == ped) and veh or ped

    DoScreenFadeOut(250)
    local t = GetGameTimer() + 1000
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() and GetGameTimer() < t do Wait(0) end

    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, true)
    NewLoadSceneStartSphere(x, y, z or 100.0, 80.0, 0)
    local landed = z
    if not landed then
        landed = groundZ(ent, x, y)
        if not landed then notify('No ground found there: you are left high up', 'error') landed = 400.0 end
    else
        RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
        local until_ = GetGameTimer() + 3000
        while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ent) and GetGameTimer() < until_ do
            SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, z, false, false, false)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end
    SetEntityCoordsNoOffset(ent, x, y, landed + (ent == ped and 1.0 or 0.5), false, false, false)
    if heading then SetEntityHeading(ent, heading) end
    NewLoadSceneStop()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ent, false)
    if ent ~= ped then SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(ent) end

    DoScreenFadeIn(300)
    busy = false
end

RegisterNetEvent('devtp:go', function(x, y, z, heading)
    x, y, z, heading = tonumber(x), tonumber(y), tonumber(z), tonumber(heading)
    if x and y then go(x, y, z, heading) end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('devtp:marker', function()
    local blip = GetFirstBlipInfoId(8)   -- the player's own map waypoint
    if not DoesBlipExist(blip) then return notify('Set a waypoint on the map first', 'error') end
    local c = GetBlipInfoIdCoord(blip)
    go(c.x, c.y, nil, nil)
end)
